Name: Bulbasaur
Description: Bulbasaur can be seen napping in bright sunlight. There is a seed on its back. By soaking up the sun's rays, the seed grows progressively larger.
DescriptionEn: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.
DescriptionEs: Una rara semilla le fue plantada en el lomo al nacer. La planta brota y crece con este Pokémon.

Name: Ivysaur
Description: There is a bud on this Pokémon's back. To support its weight, Ivysaur's legs and trunk grow thick and strong. If it starts spending more time lying in the sunlight, it's a sign that the bud will bloom into a large flower soon.
DescriptionEn: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.
DescriptionEs: Este Pokémon tiene un bulbo en el lomo. Dicen que, al absorber nutrientes, el bulbo se transforma en una flor grande.

Name: Venusaur
Description: There is a large flower on Venusaur's back. The flower is said to take on vivid colors if it gets plenty of nutrition and sunlight. The flower's aroma soothes the emotions of people.
DescriptionEn: The plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.
DescriptionEs: Llena su cuerpo de energía con los rayos solares que captan los anchos pétalos de su flor.

Name: Charmander
Description: The flame that burns at the tip of its tail is an indication of its emotions. The flame wavers when Charmander is enjoying itself. If the Pokémon becomes enraged, the flame burns fiercely.
DescriptionEn: Obviously prefers hot places. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.
DescriptionEs: La llama de su cola indica la fuerza vital de Charmander. Será brillante si está sano.

Name: Charmeleon
Description: Charmeleon mercilessly destroys its foes using its sharp claws. If it encounters a strong foe, it turns aggressive. In this excited state, the flame at the tip of its tail flares with a bluish white color.
DescriptionEn: When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the temperature to unbearably high levels.
DescriptionEs: Suele usar la cola para derribar a su rival. Cuando lo tira, se vale de sus afiladas garras para acabar con él.

Name: Charizard
Description: Charizard flies around the sky in search of powerful opponents. It breathes fire of such great heat that it melts anything. However, it never turns its fiery breath on any opponent weaker than itself.
DescriptionEn: It is said that Charizard’s fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.
DescriptionEs: Cuando lanza una descarga de fuego supercaliente, la roja llama de su cola brilla más intensamente.

Name: Squirtle
Description: Squirtle's shell is not merely used for protection. The shell's rounded shape and the grooves on its surface help minimize resistance in water, enabling this Pokémon to swim at high speeds.
DescriptionEn: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. Powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.
DescriptionEs: Se protege con su caparazón y luego contraataca lanzando agua a presión cuando tiene oportunidad.

Name: Wartortle
Description: Its tail is large and covered with a rich, thick fur. The tail becomes increasingly deeper in color as Wartortle ages. The scratches on its shell are evidence of this Pokémon's toughness as a battler.
DescriptionEn: Often hides in water to stalk unwary prey. For swimming fast, it moves its ears to maintain balance.
DescriptionEs: Si es golpeado, esconderá su cabeza. Aun así, su cola puede seguir golpeando.

Name: Blastoise
Description: Blastoise has water spouts that protrude from its shell. The water spouts are very accurate. They can shoot bullets of water with enough accuracy to strike empty cans from a distance of over 160 feet.
DescriptionEn: A brutal Pokémon with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high speed tackles.
DescriptionEs: Para acabar con su enemigo, lo aplasta con el peso de su cuerpo. En momentos de apuro, se esconde en el caparazón.

Name: Caterpie
Description: Caterpie has a voracious appetite. It can devour leaves bigger than its body right before your eyes. From its antenna, this Pokémon releases a terrifically strong odor.
DescriptionEn: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.
DescriptionEs: Para protegerse despide un hedor horrible de sus antenas, con el que repele a sus enemigos.

Name: Metapod
Description: The shell covering this Pokémon's body is as hard as an iron slab. Metapod does not move very much. It stays still because it is preparing its soft innards for evolution inside the hard shell.
DescriptionEn: This Pokémon is vulnerable to attack while its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.
DescriptionEs: Su frágil cuerpo está recubierto de una coraza dura como el acero. Permanece quieto en su desarrollo.

Name: Butterfree
Description: Butterfree has a superior ability to search for delicious honey from flowers. It can even search out, extract, and carry honey from flowers that are blooming over six miles from its nest.
DescriptionEn: In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.
DescriptionEs: Adora el néctar de las flores. Puede localizar hasta las más pequeñas cantidades de polen.

Name: Weedle
Description: Weedle has an extremely acute sense of smell. It is capable of distinguishing its favorite kinds of leaves from those it dislikes just by sniffing with its big red proboscis (nose).
DescriptionEn: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp venomous stinger on its head.
DescriptionEs: Suele habitar bosques y praderas. Tiene un afilado y venenoso aguijón de unos 5 cm encima de la cabeza.

Name: Kakuna
Description: Kakuna remains virtually immobile as it clings to a tree. However, on the inside, it is extremely busy as it prepares for its coming evolution. This is evident from how hot the shell becomes to the touch.
DescriptionEn: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators.
DescriptionEs: Casi incapaz de moverse, este Pokémon solo puede endurecer su caparazón para protegerse.

Name: Beedrill
Description: Beedrill is extremely territorial. No one should ever approach its nest—this is for their own safety. If angered, they will attack in a furious swarm.
DescriptionEn: Flies at high speed and attacks using its large venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.
DescriptionEs: Tiene 3 aguijones venenosos en sus patas y cola. Suelen pinchar a sus enemigos repetidas veces.

Name: Pidgey
Description: Pidgey has an extremely sharp sense of direction. It is capable of unerringly returning home to its nest, however far it may be removed from its familiar surroundings.
DescriptionEn: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.
DescriptionEs: Muy común en bosques y selvas. Aletea al nivel del suelo para levantar la gravilla.

Name: Pidgeotto
Description: Pidgeotto claims a large area as its own territory. This Pokémon flies around, patrolling its living space. If its territory is violated, it shows no mercy in thoroughly punishing the foe with its sharp claws.
DescriptionEn: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.
DescriptionEs: Tiene unas garras desarrolladas. Puede atrapar un Exeggcute y transportarlo desde una distancia de casi 100 km.

Name: Pidgeot
Description: This Pokémon has a dazzling plumage of beautifully glossy feathers. Many Trainers are captivated by the striking beauty of the feathers on its head, compelling them to choose Pidgeot as their Pokémon.
DescriptionEn: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as MAGIKARP.
DescriptionEs: Cuando caza, vuela muy deprisa a ras del agua y sorprende a inocentes presas como Magikarp.

Name: Rattata
Description: Rattata is cautious in the extreme. Even while it is asleep, it constantly listens by moving its ears around. It is not picky about where it lives—it will make its nest anywhere.
DescriptionEn: Living wherever there is food available, it ceaselessly scav­ enges for edibles the entire day.
DescriptionEs: Vive allí donde haya comida disponible. Busca todo el día, sin descanso, algo comestible.

Name: Raticate
Description: Raticate's sturdy fangs grow steadily. To keep them ground down, it gnaws on rocks and logs. It may even chew on the walls of houses.
DescriptionEn: It uses its whis­ kers to maintain its balance. It apparently slows down if they are cut off.
DescriptionEs: Lima sus colmillos royendo objetos duros. Con ellos puede destruir incluso paredes de hormigón.

Name: Spearow
Description: Spearow has a very loud cry that can be heard over half a mile away. If its high, keening cry is heard echoing all around, it is a sign that they are warning each other of danger.
DescriptionEn: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speed to stay airborne.
DescriptionEs: Muy protector de su territorio, mueve sus cortas alas sin descanso para lanzarse a toda velocidad.

Name: Fearow
Description: Fearow is recognized by its long neck and elongated beak. They are conveniently shaped for catching prey in soil or water. It deftly moves its long and skinny beak to pluck prey.
DescriptionEn: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.
DescriptionEs: Con sus enormes y magníficas alas, puede seguir volando sin tener que aterrizar para descansar.

Name: Ekans
Description: Ekans curls itself up in a spiral while it rests. Assuming this position allows it to quickly respond to a threat from any direction with a glare from its upraised head.
DescriptionEn: Moves silently and stealthily. Eats the eggs of birds, such as PIDGEY and SPEAROW, whole.
DescriptionEs: Cuanto más viejo, más crece este Pokémon. Por la noche, descansa en las ramas de los árboles.

Name: Arbok
Description: This Pokémon is terrifically strong in order to constrict things with its body. It can even flatten steel oil drums. Once Arbok wraps its body around its foe, escaping its crushing embrace is impossible.
DescriptionEn: It is rumored that the ferocious warning markings on its belly differ from area to area.
DescriptionEs: El dibujo que tiene en la panza aterroriza. Los rivales más débiles salen huyendo al verlo.

Name: Pikachu
Description: Whenever Pikachu comes across something new, it blasts it with a jolt of electricity. If you come across a blackened berry, it's evidence that this Pokémon mistook the intensity of its charge.
DescriptionEn: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.
DescriptionEs: Levanta su cola para vigilar los alrededores. A veces, puede ser alcanzado por un rayo en esa pose.

Name: Raichu
Description: If the electrical sacs become excessively charged, Raichu plants its tail in the ground and discharges. Scorched patches of ground will be found near this Pokémon's nest.
DescriptionEn: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high voltage power.
DescriptionEs: Cuando se carga de electricidad, sus músculos se tensan y se vuelve más agresivo de lo normal.

Name: Sandshrew
Description: Sandshrew's body is configured to absorb water without waste, enabling it to survive in an arid desert. This Pokémon curls up to protect itself from its enemies.
DescriptionEn: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.
DescriptionEs: Este Pokémon permanece bajo tierra. Si se siente amenazado, se enrosca para defenderse.

Name: Sandslash
Description: Sandslash's body is covered by tough spikes, which are hardened sections of its hide. Once a year, the old spikes fall out, to be replaced with new spikes that grow out from beneath the old ones.
DescriptionEn: Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape.
DescriptionEs: Si cava a gran velocidad, puede que se le caigan las garras y púas. Vuelven a crecerle en un día.

Name: Nidoran
Description: Nidoran♀ has barbs that secrete a powerful poison. They are thought to have developed as protection for this small-bodied Pokémon. When enraged, it releases a horrible toxin from its horn.
DescriptionEn: Although small, its venomous barbs render this Pokémon dangerous. The female has smaller horns.
DescriptionEs: Aunque pequeñas, sus venenosas púas son muy peligrosas. Tienen un cuerno más pequeño que los machos.

Name: Nidorina
Description: When Nidorina are with their friends or family, they keep their barbs tucked away to prevent hurting each other. This Pokémon appears to become nervous if separated from the others.
DescriptionEn: The female's horn develops slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.
DescriptionEs: Tiene un carácter afable. Emite ondas ultrasónicas para confundir al enemigo.

Name: Nidoqueen
Description: Nidoqueen's body is encased in extremely hard scales. It is adept at sending foes flying with harsh tackles. This Pokémon is at its strongest when it is defending its young.
DescriptionEn: Its hard scales provide strong protection. It uses its hefty bulk to execute powerful moves.
DescriptionEs: Usa su cuerpo duro y escamoso para sellar la entrada a su madriguera y protegerse de los depredadores.

Name: Nidoran
Description: Nidoran♂ has developed muscles for moving its ears. Thanks to them, the ears can be freely moved in any direction. Even the slightest sound does not escape this Pokémon's notice.
DescriptionEn: Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger its horns, the more powerful its secreted venom.
DescriptionEs: Saca las orejas por encima de la hierba para explorar el territorio. Le protege su cuerno venenoso.

Name: Nidorino
Description: Nidorino has a horn that is harder than a diamond. If it senses a hostile presence, all the barbs on its back bristle up at once, and it challenges the foe with all its might.
DescriptionEn: An aggressive Pokémon that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.
DescriptionEs: Levanta sus grandes orejas para vigilar. Si detecta algo, atacará de inmediato.

Name: Nidoking
Description: Nidoking's thick tail packs enormously destructive power. With one swing, it can topple a metal transmission tower. Once this Pokémon goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.
DescriptionEn: It uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break the prey's bones.
DescriptionEs: Es fácil reconocerlo por tener una dura piel y un gran cuerno lleno de peligrosísimo veneno.

Name: Clefairy
Description: On every night of a full moon, groups of this Pokémon come out to play. When dawn arrives, the tired Clefairy return to their quiet mountain retreats and go to sleep nestled up against each other.
DescriptionEn: Its magical and cute appeal has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.
DescriptionEs: Se dice que la felicidad llegará a quien vea a un grupo de Clefairy bailando a la luz de la luna llena.

Name: Clefable
Description: Clefable moves by skipping lightly as if it were flying using its wings. Its bouncy step lets it even walk on water. It is known to take strolls on lakes on quiet, moonlit nights.
DescriptionEn: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen. It will run and hide the moment it senses people.
DescriptionEs: Su oído es tan agudo que puede oír una aguja caer a 1 km. Vive en montañas solitarias.

Name: Vulpix
Description: At the time of its birth, Vulpix has one white tail. The tail separates into six if this Pokémon receives plenty of love from its Trainer. The six tails become magnificently curled.
DescriptionEn: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.
DescriptionEs: Cuando nace solo tiene una cola, pero a medida que crece, esta se va dividiendo desde la punta.

Name: Ninetales
Description: Ninetales casts a sinister light from its bright red eyes to gain total control over its foe's mind. This Pokémon is said to live for a thousand years.
DescriptionEn: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1000-year curse.
DescriptionEs: Tiene nueve colas y un pelaje de color dorado. Dicen que este Pokémon llega a vivir 1000 años.

Name: Jigglypuff
Description: Jigglypuff's vocal cords can freely adjust the wavelength of its voice. This Pokémon uses this ability to sing at precisely the right wavelength to make its foes most drowsy.
DescriptionEn: When its huge eyes light up, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.
DescriptionEs: Cautiva con la mirada a su enemigo y hace que se quede profundamente dormido mientras entona una dulce melodía.

Name: Wigglytuff
Description: Wigglytuff has large, saucerlike eyes. The surfaces of its eyes are always covered with a thin layer of tears. If any dust gets in this Pokémon's eyes, it is quickly washed away.
DescriptionEn: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.
DescriptionEs: Su piel es tan suave que si dos de ellos se acurrucan juntos, no querrán separarse nunca.

Name: Zubat
Description: Zubat remains quietly unmoving in a dark spot during the bright daylight hours. It does so because prolonged exposure to the sun causes its body to become slightly burned.
DescriptionEn: It has no eyes. Instead, it relies on its ultrasonic cries for echolocation to flit about in darkness.
DescriptionEs: Aunque carezca de ojos, puede detectar obstáculos con las ondas ultrasónicas que emite su boca.

Name: Golbat
Description: Golbat loves to drink the blood of living things. It is particularly active in the pitch black of night. This Pokémon flits around in the night skies, seeking fresh blood.
DescriptionEn: Once it strikes, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.
DescriptionEs: Cuando ataque, seguirá chupando energía de su víctima, aunque pese tanto que ya no pueda volar.

Name: Oddish
Description: During the daytime, Oddish buries itself in soil to absorb nutrients from the ground using its entire body. The more fertile the soil, the glossier its leaves become.
DescriptionEn: During the day, it keeps its face buried in the ground. At night, it wanders around sowing its seeds.
DescriptionEs: Durante el día, se agazapa en el frío subsuelo huyendo del sol. La luz de la luna le hace crecer mucho.

Name: Gloom
Description: Gloom releases a foul fragrance from the pistil of its flower. When faced with danger, the stench worsens. If this Pokémon is feeling calm and secure, it does not release its usual stinky aroma.
DescriptionEn: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn't drool. It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.
DescriptionEs: ¡Huele bastante mal! De todas formas, una de cada mil personas aprecian su fétido olor.

Name: Vileplume
Description: Vileplume's toxic pollen triggers atrocious allergy attacks. That's why it is advisable never to approach any attractive flowers in a jungle, however pretty they may be.
DescriptionEn: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.
DescriptionEs: Cuanto mayores son sus pétalos, más tóxico es su polen. Le pesa la cabeza y le cuesta mantenerla erguida.

Name: Paras
Description: Paras has parasitic mushrooms growing on its back called tochukaso. They grow large by drawing nutrients from this Bug Pokémon host. They are highly valued as a medicine for extending life.
DescriptionEn: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by draw­ ing nutrients from the bug host.
DescriptionEs: Lleva en el lomo dos setas parásitas llamadas tochukaso, que crecen con él.

Name: Parasect
Description: Parasect is known to infest large trees en masse and drain nutrients from the lower trunk and roots. When an infested tree dies, they move onto another tree all at once.
DescriptionEn: It stays mostly in dark, damp places, the preference not of the bug, but of the big mush­ rooms on its back.
DescriptionEs: Parasect está dominado por una seta parásita mayor que él. Dispersa esporas venenosas.

Name: Venonat
Description: Venonat is said to have evolved with a coat of thin, stiff hair that covers its entire body for protection. It possesses large eyes that never fail to spot even minuscule prey.
DescriptionEn: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.
DescriptionEs: Sus grandes ojos son en realidad grupos de ojos diminutos. Por la noche se siente atraído por la luz.

Name: Venomoth
Description: Venomoth is nocturnal—it is a Pokémon that only becomes active at night. Its favorite prey are small insects that gather around streetlights, attracted by the light in the darkness.
DescriptionEn: The dust-like scales covering its wings are color coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.
DescriptionEs: Tiene las alas cubiertas de un polvillo de escamas que esparce cada vez que las bate.

Name: Diglett
Description: Diglett are raised in most farms. The reason is simple—wherever this Pokémon burrows, the soil is left perfectly tilled for planting crops. This soil is made ideal for growing delicious vegetables.
DescriptionEn: Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears above ground.
DescriptionEs: Vive un metro por debajo del suelo, donde se alimenta de raíces. También aparece en la superficie.

Name: Dugtrio
Description: Dugtrio are actually triplets that emerged from one body. As a result, each triplet thinks exactly like the other two triplets. They work cooperatively to burrow endlessly.
DescriptionEn: A team of DIGLETT triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.
DescriptionEs: En combate, cava la tierra, se esconde y sale de repente para golpear a su rival. Nunca se sabe por dónde puede aparecer.

Name: Meowth
Description: Meowth withdraws its sharp claws into its paws to slinkily sneak about without making any incriminating footsteps. For some reason, this Pokémon loves shiny coins that glitter with light.
DescriptionEn: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.
DescriptionEs: Es de naturaleza nocturna. Le atraen los objetos brillantes.

Name: Persian
Description: Persian has six bold whiskers that give it a look of toughness. The whiskers sense air movements to determine what is in the Pokémon's surrounding vicinity. It becomes docile if grabbed by the whiskers.
DescriptionEn: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.
DescriptionEs: Aunque es muy admirado por el pelo, es difícil de entrenar como mascota, porque es un poco travieso.

Name: Psyduck
Description: Psyduck uses a mysterious power. When it does so, this Pokémon generates brain waves that are supposedly only seen in sleepers. This discovery spurred controversy among scholars.
DescriptionEn: While lulling its enemies with its vacant look, this wily Pokémon will use psychokinetic powers.
DescriptionEs: Padece continuamente dolores de cabeza. Cuando son muy fuertes, empieza a usar misteriosos poderes.

Name: Golduck
Description: The webbed flippers on its forelegs and hind legs and the streamlined body of Golduck give it frightening speed. This Pokémon is definitely much faster than even the most athletic swimmer.
DescriptionEn: Often seen swim­ ming elegantly by lake shores. It is often mistaken for the Japanese monster, Kappa.
DescriptionEs: Aparece en ríos al anochecer. Puede usar poderes telequinéticos si su frente brilla misteriosamente.

Name: Mankey
Description: When Mankey starts shaking and its nasal breathing turns rough, it's a sure sign that it is becoming angry. However, because it goes into a towering rage almost instantly, it is impossible for anyone to flee its wrath.
DescriptionEn: Extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment then thrashing away the next instant.
DescriptionEs: Es peligroso acercarse si se enfada sin razón aparente, ya que no distingue entre amigos y enemigos.

Name: Primeape
Description: When Primeape becomes furious, its blood circulation is boosted. In turn, its muscles are made even stronger. However, it also becomes much less intelligent at the same time.
DescriptionEn: Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until it is caught.
DescriptionEs: Solo se calma cuando nadie está cerca. Llegar a ver ese momento es realmente difícil.

Name: Growlithe
Description: Growlithe has a superb sense of smell. Once it smells anything, this Pokémon won't forget the scent, no matter what. It uses its advanced olfactory sense to determine the emotions of other living things.
DescriptionEn: Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.
DescriptionEs: Es muy agradable y leal. Para ahuyentar al enemigo, se pone a ladrar y a dar bocados.

Name: Arcanine
Description: Arcanine is known for its high speed. It is said to be capable of running over 6,200 miles in a single day and night. The fire that blazes wildly within this Pokémon's body is its source of power.
DescriptionEn: A Pokémon that has been admired since the past for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.
DescriptionEs: Un Pokémon muy admirado desde la antigüedad por su belleza. Corre ágilmente como si tuviera alas.

Name: Poliwag
Description: Poliwag has a very thin skin. It is possible to see the Pokémon's spiral innards right through the skin. Despite its thinness, however, the skin is also very flexible. Even sharp fangs bounce right off it.
DescriptionEn: Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming than trying to stand.
DescriptionEs: Tiene una piel extraordinaria, fina y húmeda, que deja entrever las vísceras que tiene dispuestas en espiral.

Name: Poliwhirl
Description: The surface of Poliwhirl's body is always wet and slick with a slimy fluid. Because of this slippery covering, it can easily slip and slide out of the clutches of any enemy in battle.
DescriptionEn: Capable of living in or out of water. When out of water, it sweats to keep its body slimy.
DescriptionEs: Capaz de vivir dentro o fuera del agua. Fuera del agua suda para mantener baboso su cuerpo.

Name: Poliwrath
Description: Poliwrath's highly developed, brawny muscles never grow fatigued, however much it exercises. It is so tirelessly strong, this Pokémon can swim back and forth across the ocean without effort.
DescriptionEn: An adept swimmer at both the front crawl and breast stroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.
DescriptionEs: Tiene músculos muy desarrollados. Es capaz de nadar en el océano sin descanso.

Name: Abra
Description: Abra sleeps for 18 hours a day. However, it can sense the presence of foes even while it is sleeping. In such a situation, this Pokémon immediately teleports to safety.
DescriptionEn: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and TELEPORT to safety.
DescriptionEs: Duerme 18 horas al día y mientras lo hace es capaz de usar una serie de poderes extrasensoriales.

Name: Kadabra
Description: Kadabra emits a peculiar alpha wave if it develops a headache. Only those people with a particularly strong psyche can hope to become a Trainer of this Pokémon.
DescriptionEn: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches just by being close by.
DescriptionEs: Cuando utiliza su poder psíquico, emite poderosas ondas alfa que pueden destruir dispositivos.

Name: Alakazam
Description: Alakazam's brain continually grows, making its head far too heavy to support with its neck. This Pokémon holds its head up using its psychokinetic power instead.
DescriptionEn: Its brain can out­ perform a super­ computer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5,000.
DescriptionEs: Sus neuronas se multiplican continuamente durante su vida. Por eso, siempre lo recuerda todo.

Name: Machop
Description: Machop's muscles are special—they never get sore no matter how much they are used in exercise. This Pokémon has sufficient power to hurl a hundred adult humans.
DescriptionEn: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.
DescriptionEs: Levanta un Graveler para mantener sus músculos en forma. Domina todas las artes marciales.

Name: Machoke
Description: Machoke's thoroughly toned muscles possess the hardness of steel. This Pokémon has so much strength, it can easily hold aloft a sumo wrestler on just one finger.
DescriptionEn: It happily carries heavy cargo to toughen up. It willingly does hard work for people.
DescriptionEs: Su musculoso cuerpo es tan fuerte que usa un cinto antifuerza para controlar sus movimientos.

Name: Machamp
Description: Machamp has the power to hurl anything aside. However, trying to do any work requiring care and dexterity causes its arms to get tangled. This Pokémon tends to leap into action before it thinks.
DescriptionEn: Using its heavy muscles, it throws powerful punches that can send the victim clear over the horizon.
DescriptionEs: Tiene cuatro brazos tan bien desarrollados que puede dar una serie de 1000 puñetazos en cuestión de dos segundos.

Name: Bellsprout
Description: Bellsprout's thin and flexible body lets it bend and sway to avoid any attack, however strong it may be. From its mouth, this Pokémon spits a corrosive fluid that melts even iron.
DescriptionEn: A carnivorous Pokémon that traps and eats bugs. It uses its root feet to soak up needed moisture.
DescriptionEs: Aunque su cuerpo es extremadamente delgado, es muy rápido a la hora de capturar sus presas.

Name: Weepinbell
Description: Weepinbell has a large hook on its rear end. At night, the Pokémon hooks on to a tree branch and goes to sleep. If it moves around in its sleep, it may wake up to find itself on the ground.
DescriptionEn: A Pokémon that appears to be a plant. It captures unwary prey by dousing them with a toxic powder.
DescriptionEs: Las hojas que tiene actúan como cuchillas en combate. Otra de sus armas es el corrosivo fluido que expulsa.

Name: Victreebel
Description: Victreebel has a long vine that extends from its head. This vine is waved and flicked about as if it were an animal to attract prey. When an unsuspecting prey draws near, this Pokémon swallows it whole.
DescriptionEn: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.
DescriptionEs: Dicen que vive en grandes colonias en el interior de las junglas, aunque nadie ha podido verificarlo.

Name: Tentacool
Description: Tentacool's body is largely composed of water. If it is removed from the sea, it dries up like parchment. If this Pokémon happens to become dehydrated, put it back into the sea.
DescriptionEn: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by its stinging acid.
DescriptionEs: Su cuerpo se compone casi en exclusiva de agua. Lanza extraños rayos con sus ojos cristalinos.

Name: Tentacruel
Description: Tentacruel has large red orbs on its head. The orbs glow before lashing the vicinity with a harsh ultrasonic blast. This Pokémon's outburst creates rough waves around it.
DescriptionEn: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.
DescriptionEs: Cuando caza, extiende los cortos tentáculos que tiene para atrapar e inmovilizar a su presa.

Name: Geodude
Description: The longer a Geodude lives, the more its edges are chipped and worn away, making it more rounded in appearance. However, this Pokémon's heart will remain hard, craggy, and rough always.
DescriptionEn: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.
DescriptionEs: Aparecen en llanos y montañas. Como parecen rocas, la gente se tropieza con ellos o los pisa.

Name: Graveler
Description: Graveler grows by feeding on rocks. Apparently, it prefers to eat rocks that are covered in moss. This Pokémon eats its way through a ton of rocks on a daily basis.
DescriptionEn: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.
DescriptionEs: De naturaleza descuidada y libre, no le importa dañarse cuando baja rodando montañas.

Name: Golem
Description: Golem live up on mountains. If there is a large earthquake, these Pokémon will come rolling down off the mountains en masse to the foothills below.
DescriptionEn: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.
DescriptionEs: Se lanza montaña abajo y deja un surco desde la cima hasta el pie. Es mejor mantenerse alejado.

Name: Ponyta
Description: Ponyta is very weak at birth. It can barely stand up. This Pokémon becomes stronger by stumbling and falling to keep up with its parent.
DescriptionEn: Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything completely flat in little time.
DescriptionEs: Cuando nace, apenas puede tenerse en pie. Pero va fortaleciendo las patas en cuanto empieza a galopar.

Name: Rapidash
Description: Rapidash usually can be seen casually cantering in the fields and plains. However, when this Pokémon turns serious, its fiery manes flare and blaze as it gallops its way up to 150 mph.
DescriptionEn: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.
DescriptionEs: Muy competitivo, este Pokémon perseguirá a todo lo que se mueva rápido e intentará salir airoso.

Name: Slowpoke
Description: Slowpoke uses its tail to catch prey by dipping it in water at the side of a river. However, this Pokémon often forgets what it's doing and often spends entire days just loafing at water's edge.
DescriptionEn: It is always so absent-minded that it won't react, even if its flavorful tail is bitten.
DescriptionEs: Está siempre en su mundo, pero nadie sabe en qué piensa. Suele pescar con la cola.

Name: Slowbro
Description: Slowbro's tail has a Shellder firmly attached with a bite. As a result, the tail can't be used for fishing anymore. This causes Slowbro to grudgingly swim and catch prey instead.
DescriptionEn: The SHELLDER that is latched onto SLOWPOKE's tail is said to feed on the host's left over scraps.
DescriptionEs: Tiene una cola tan apetecible, que el Shellder que va enganchado a ella no se soltará por nada del mundo.

Name: Magnemite
Description: Magnemite attaches itself to power lines to feed on electricity. If your house has a power outage, check your circuit breakers. You may find a large number of this Pokémon clinging to the breaker box.
DescriptionEn: Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses THUNDER WAVE and similar moves.
DescriptionEs: Las unidades a los lados de su cuerpo generan energía antigravitatoria para mantenerlo en el aire.

Name: Magneton
Description: Magneton emits a powerful magnetic force that is fatal to mechanical devices. As a result, large cities sound sirens to warn citizens of large-scale outbreaks of this Pokémon.
DescriptionEn: Formed by several MAGNEMITEs linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.
DescriptionEs: Lo constituye un grupo de Magnemite. Descarga potentes ondas magnéticas de alto voltaje.

Name: Farfetch'd
Description: Farfetch'd is always seen with a stalk from a plant of some sort. Apparently, there are good stalks and bad stalks. This Pokémon has been known to fight with others over stalks.
DescriptionEn: The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. It is used much like a metal sword.
DescriptionEs: El puerro que lleva es su mejor arma. Suele usarlo como espada para cortar cosas.

Name: Doduo
Description: Doduo's two heads never sleep at the same time. Its two heads take turns sleeping, so one head can always keep watch for enemies while the other one sleeps.
DescriptionEn: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.
DescriptionEs: Este Pokémon de dos cabezas es el resultado de una mutación. Cuando corre, puede alcanzar casi 100 km por hora.

Name: Dodrio
Description: Watch out if Dodrio's three heads are looking in three separate directions. It's a sure sign that it is on its guard. Don't go near this Pokémon if it's being wary—it may decide to peck you.
DescriptionEn: Uses its three brains to execute complex plans. While two heads sleep, one head stays awake.
DescriptionEs: Más vale no perder de vista ninguna de las tres cabezas. De lo contrario, el número de picotazos será enorme.

Name: Seel
Description: Seel hunts for prey in the frigid sea underneath sheets of ice. When it needs to breathe, it punches a hole through the ice with the sharply protruding section of its head.
DescriptionEn: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.
DescriptionEs: Este Pokémon vive en icebergs. Nada en el mar y usa el cuerno de su cabeza para romper el hielo.

Name: Dewgong
Description: Dewgong loves to snooze on bitterly cold ice. The sight of this Pokémon sleeping on a glacier was mistakenly thought to be a mermaid by a mariner long ago.
DescriptionEn: Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.
DescriptionEs: Está recubierto de un luminoso pelaje blanco. Este Pokémon aumenta su actividad cuando bajan las temperaturas.

Name: Grimer
Description: Grimer's sludgy and rubbery body can be forced through any opening, however small it may be. This Pokémon enters sewer pipes to drink filthy wastewater.
DescriptionEn: Appears in filthy areas. Thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.
DescriptionEs: Nace de lodo alterado al filtrarse en el agua los rayos X reflejados por la Luna. Se alimenta de sustancias desagradables.

Name: Muk
Description: From Muk's body seeps a foul fluid that gives off a nose-bendingly horrible stench. Just one drop of this Pokémon's body fluid can turn a pool stagnant and rancid.
DescriptionEn: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.
DescriptionEs: Su cuerpo segrega un fluido tóxico que elimina la vida vegetal cuando la toca.

Name: Shellder
Description: At night, this Pokémon uses its broad tongue to burrow a hole in the seafloor sand and then sleep in it. While it is sleeping, Shellder closes its shell, but leaves its tongue hanging out.
DescriptionEn: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.
DescriptionEs: La concha lo protege de cualquier tipo de ataque. Solo es vulnerable cuando se abre.

Name: Cloyster
Description: Cloyster is capable of swimming in the sea. It does so by swallowing water, then jetting it out toward the rear. This Pokémon shoots spikes from its shell using the same system.
DescriptionEn: When attacked, it launches its horns in quick volleys. Its innards have never been seen.
DescriptionEs: A los Cloyster que viven en las fuertes corrientes marinas les crecen largas y afiladas púas en la concha.

Name: Gastly
Description: Gastly is largely composed of gaseous matter. When exposed to a strong wind, the gaseous body quickly dwindles away. Groups of this Pokémon cluster under the eaves of houses to escape the ravages of wind.
DescriptionEn: Almost invisible, this gaseous Pokémon cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.
DescriptionEs: Su etéreo cuerpo está hecho de gas. Puede envolver a un oponente de cualquier tamaño hasta ahogarlo.

Name: Haunter
Description: Haunter is a dangerous Pokémon. If one beckons you while floating in darkness, you must never approach it. This Pokémon will try to lick you with its tongue and steal your life away.
DescriptionEn: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from an­ other dimension.
DescriptionEs: Cuando tienes la sensación de que te están observando, seguro que es porque Haunter está cerca.

Name: Gengar
Description: Sometimes, on a dark night, your shadow thrown by a streetlight will suddenly and startlingly overtake you. It is actually a Gengar running past you, pretending to be your shadow.
DescriptionEn: Under a full moon, this Pokémon likes to mimic the shadows of people and laugh at their fright.
DescriptionEs: Se esconde entre las sombras. Se dice que donde Gengar acecha, la temperatura baja 5 °C.

Name: Onix
Description: Onix has a magnet in its brain. It acts as a compass so that this Pokémon does not lose direction while it is tunneling. As it grows older, its body becomes increasingly rounder and smoother.
DescriptionEn: It burrows through the ground at a speed of 50 mph while feeding on large boulders.
DescriptionEs: Cava a gran velocidad en busca de comida. Los túneles que deja son usados por los Diglett.

Name: Drowzee
Description: If your nose becomes itchy while you are sleeping, it's a sure sign that one of these Pokémon is standing above your pillow and trying to eat your dream through your nostrils.
DescriptionEn: Puts enemies to sleep then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating bad dreams.
DescriptionEs: Adormece a sus enemigos y se come sus sueños. A veces se pone enfermo si come pesadillas.

Name: Hypno
Description: Hypno holds a pendulum in its hand. The arcing movement and glitter of the pendulum lull the foe into a deep state of hypnosis. While this Pokémon searches for prey, it polishes the pendulum.
DescriptionEn: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of PSI moves such as HYPNOSIS and CONFUSION.
DescriptionEs: Lleva un péndulo en la mano. Una vez, hizo desaparecer a un niño al que había hipnotizado.

Name: Krabby
Description: Krabby live on beaches, burrowed inside holes dug into the sand. On sandy beaches with little in the way of food, these Pokémon can be seen squabbling with each other over territory.
DescriptionEn: Its pincers are not only powerful weapons, they are used for balance when walking sideways.
DescriptionEs: Ante el peligro, se camufla con las burbujas que desprende su boca, para parecer más grande.

Name: Kingler
Description: Kingler has an enormous, oversized claw. It waves this huge claw in the air to communicate with others. However, because the claw is so heavy, the Pokémon quickly tires.
DescriptionEn: The large pincer has 10000 hp of crushing power. However, its huge size makes it unwieldy to use.
DescriptionEs: La pinza tan grande que tiene posee una fuerza de 10 000 caballos de potencia. Pero, por su gran tamaño, cuesta moverla.

Name: Voltorb
Description: Voltorb was first sighted at a company that manufactures Poké Balls. The link between that sighting and the fact that this Pokémon looks very similar to a Poké Ball remains a mystery.
DescriptionEn: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a POKé BALL, they have zapped many people.
DescriptionEs: Fue descubierto cuando se crearon las Poké Balls. Se dice que tiene algo que ver con ellas.

Name: Electrode
Description: Electrode eats electricity in the atmosphere. On days when lightning strikes, you can see this Pokémon exploding all over the place from eating too much electricity.
DescriptionEn: It stores electric energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.
DescriptionEs: Explotan a la mínima. Por eso se les tiene mucho miedo. Estos Pokémon reciben el mote de Bomba Ball.

Name: Exeggcute
Description: This Pokémon consists of six eggs that form a closely knit cluster. The six eggs attract each other and spin around. When cracks increasingly appear on the eggs, Exeggcute is close to evolution.
DescriptionEn: Using telepathy only they can receive, they always form a cluster of six EXEGGCUTE.
DescriptionEs: Estos seis huevos se comunican por telepatía. Si se separan, se pueden reunir rápidamente.

Name: Exeggutor
Description: Exeggutor originally came from the tropics. Its heads steadily grow larger from exposure to strong sunlight. It is said that when the heads fall off, they group together to form Exeggcute.
DescriptionEn: Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an EXEGGCUTE.
DescriptionEs: Sus tres cabezas piensan de forma independiente. Sin embargo, son amigas y no suelen discutir nunca.

Name: Cubone
Description: Cubone pines for the mother it will never see again. Seeing a likeness of its mother in the full moon, it cries. The stains on the skull the Pokémon wears are made by the tears it sheds.
DescriptionEn: Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this Pokémon's real face.
DescriptionEs: Lleva puesto el cráneo de su madre. Cuando se siente solo se pone a gritar muy fuerte.

Name: Marowak
Description: Marowak is the evolved form of a Cubone that has overcome its sadness at the loss of its mother and grown tough. This Pokémon's tempered and hardened spirit is not easily broken.
DescriptionEn: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to KO targets.
DescriptionEs: Es pequeño y siempre ha sido muy débil. Cuando empezó a usar huesos, se volvió más violento.

Name: Hitmonlee
Description: Hitmonlee's legs freely contract and stretch. Using these springlike legs, it bowls over foes with devastating kicks. After battle, it rubs down its legs and loosens the muscles to overcome fatigue.
DescriptionEn: When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra long, loping strides.
DescriptionEs: Encoge y estira las patas a su antojo. Cuando las estira, es capaz de propinar una buena patada al enemigo.

Name: Hitmonchan
Description: Hitmonchan is said to possess the spirit of a boxer who had been working toward a world championship. This Pokémon has an indomitable spirit and will never give up in the face of adversity.
DescriptionEn: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.
DescriptionEs: Los potentes golpes de sus brazos pueden pulverizar el hormigón. Descansa tras luchar tres minutos.

Name: Lickitung
Description: Whenever Lickitung comes across something new, it will unfailingly give it a lick. It does so because it memorizes things by texture and by taste. It is somewhat put off by sour things.
DescriptionEn: Its tongue can be extended like a chameleon's. It leaves a tingling sensation when it licks enemies.
DescriptionEs: Su larga lengua, recubierta de saliva pegajosa, se pega a todo, por lo que es muy útil.

Name: Koffing
Description: If Koffing becomes agitated, it raises the toxicity of its internal gases and jets them out from all over its body. This Pokémon may also overinflate its round body, then explode.
DescriptionEn: Because it stores several kinds of toxic gases in its body, it is prone to exploding without warning.
DescriptionEs: Tiene forma de globo y es muy ligero. Está compuesto por gases tóxicos y apesta.

Name: Weezing
Description: Weezing loves the gases given off by rotted kitchen garbage. This Pokémon will find a dirty, unkempt house and make it its home. At night, when the people in the house are asleep, it will go through the trash.
DescriptionEn: Where two kinds of poison gases meet, 2 KOFFINGs can fuse into a WEEZING over many years.
DescriptionEs: Si uno de los gemelos Koffing se infla, el otro se desinfla. Mezclan constantemente sus venenosos gases.

Name: Rhyhorn
Description: Rhyhorn runs in a straight line, smashing everything in its path. It is not bothered even if it rushes headlong into a block of steel. This Pokémon may feel some pain from the collision the next day, however.
DescriptionEn: Its massive bones are 1000 times harder than human bones. It can easily knock a trailer flying.
DescriptionEs: Es muy fuerte, pero no especialmente listo. Es capaz de derribar rascacielos usando Placaje varias veces.

Name: Rhydon
Description: Rhydon's horn can crush even uncut diamonds. One sweeping blow of its tail can topple a building. This Pokémon's hide is extremely tough. Even direct cannon hits don't leave a scratch.
DescriptionEn: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees.
DescriptionEs: La piel le sirve de escudo protector. Puede vivir en lava líquida a 2000 °C de temperatura.

Name: Chansey
Description: Chansey lays nutritionally excellent eggs on an everyday basis. The eggs are so delicious, they are easily and eagerly devoured by even those people who have lost their appetite.
DescriptionEn: A rare and elusive Pokémon that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to get it.
DescriptionEs: Se dice que reparte felicidad. Se caracteriza por su compasión y reparte sus huevos entre la gente herida.

Name: Tangela
Description: Tangela's vines snap off easily if they are grabbed. This happens without pain, allowing it to make a quick getaway. The lost vines are replaced by newly grown vines the very next day.
DescriptionEn: The whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to sea­ weed. Its vines shake as it walks.
DescriptionEs: Se camufla con la multitud de lianas que envuelven su cuerpo y que no dejan de crecer a lo largo de toda su vida.

Name: Kangaskhan
Description: If you come across a young Kangaskhan playing by itself, you must never disturb it or attempt to catch it. The baby Pokémon's parent is sure to be in the area, and it will become violently enraged at you.
DescriptionEn: The infant rarely ventures out of its mother's protective pouch until it is 3 years old.
DescriptionEs: Lleva a su cría en la bolsa de su panza. Solo deja que su cría salga a jugar cuando no siente peligro.

Name: Horsea
Description: Horsea eats small insects and moss off of rocks. If the ocean current turns fast, this Pokémon anchors itself by wrapping its tail around rocks or coral to prevent being washed away.
DescriptionEn: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.
DescriptionEs: Es famoso por derribar a bichos voladores lanzando tinta desde la superficie del agua.

Name: Seadra
Description: Seadra sleeps after wriggling itself between the branches of coral. Those trying to harvest coral are occasionally stung by this Pokémon's poison barbs if they fail to notice it.
DescriptionEn: Capable of swim­ ming backwards by rapidly flapping its wing-like pectoral fins and stout tail.
DescriptionEs: Las afiladas púas que le recubren el cuerpo se le erizan y pueden causar el debilitamiento con solo tocarlo.

Name: Goldeen
Description: Goldeen is a very beautiful Pokémon with fins that billow elegantly in water. However, don't let your guard down around this Pokémon—it could ram you powerfully with its horn.
DescriptionEn: Its tail fin billows like an elegant ballroom dress, giving it the nickname of the Water Queen.
DescriptionEs: Nada a una velocidad de cinco nudos. Si siente peligro, golpea con su afilado cuerno.

Name: Seaking
Description: In the autumn, Seaking males can be seen performing courtship dances in riverbeds to woo females. During this season, this Pokémon's body coloration is at its most beautiful.
DescriptionEn: In autumn, its body becomes more fatty in preparing to propose to a mate. It takes on beautiful colors.
DescriptionEs: En otoño, cuando se reproducen, se les puede ver nadando con energía por ríos y arroyos.

Name: Staryu
Description: Staryu's center section has an organ called the core that shines bright red. If you go to a beach toward the end of summer, the glowing cores of these Pokémon look like the stars in the sky.
DescriptionEn: An enigmatic Pokémon that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.
DescriptionEs: Aunque sus brazos se rompan podrán regenerarse, siempre y cuando su núcleo siga intacto.

Name: Starmie
Description: Starmie's center section—the core—glows brightly in seven colors. Because of its luminous nature, this Pokémon has been given the nickname “the gem of the sea.”
DescriptionEn: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value the core as a gem.
DescriptionEs: Su núcleo central brilla con los colores del arcoíris. Para algunos tiene el valor de una gema.

Name: Mr. Mime
Description: Mr. Mime is a master of pantomime. Its gestures and motions convince watchers that something unseeable actually exists. Once the watchers are convinced, the unseeable thing exists as if it were real.
DescriptionEn: If interrupted while it is miming, it will slap around the offender with its broad hands.
DescriptionEs: Para repeler ataques, solidifica el aire y crea muros invisibles con emanaciones de sus dedos.

Name: Scyther
Description: Scyther is blindingly fast. Its blazing speed enhances the effectiveness of the twin scythes on its forearms. This Pokémon's scythes are so effective, they can slice through thick logs in one wicked stroke.
DescriptionEn: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one.
DescriptionEs: Destroza a su presa con las guadañas que tiene. No es común que use las alas para volar.

Name: Jynx
Description: Jynx walks rhythmically, swaying and shaking its hips as if it were dancing. Its motions are so bouncingly alluring, people seeing it are compelled to shake their hips without giving any thought to what they are doing.
DescriptionEn: It seductively wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.
DescriptionEs: Camina moviendo las caderas de forma llamativa. Puede hacer que la gente baile a su ritmo.

Name: Electabuzz
Description: When a storm arrives, gangs of this Pokémon compete with each other to scale heights that are likely to be stricken by lightning bolts. Some towns use Electabuzz in place of lightning rods.
DescriptionEn: Normally found near power plants, they can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.
DescriptionEs: Por la superficie de su piel corre la electricidad. En la oscuridad, su cuerpo se torna blanquecino.

Name: Magmar
Description: In battle, Magmar blows out intensely hot flames from all over its body to intimidate its opponent. This Pokémon's fiery bursts create heat waves that ignite grass and trees in its surroundings.
DescriptionEn: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.
DescriptionEs: A este Pokémon se lo encontraron cerca de un volcán. Esta criatura ígnea tiene una temperatura corporal de unos 1200 °C.

Name: Pinsir
Description: Pinsir is astoundingly strong. It can grip a foe weighing twice its weight in its horns and easily lift it. This Pokémon's movements turn sluggish in cold places.
DescriptionEn: If it fails to crush the victim in its pincers, it will swing it around and toss it hard.
DescriptionEs: Atrapa presas con sus pinzas hasta que las parte en dos. Lanza lejos lo que no puede quebrar.

Name: Tauros
Description: This Pokémon is not satisfied unless it is rampaging at all times. If there is no opponent for Tauros to battle, it will charge at thick trees and knock them down to calm itself.
DescriptionEn: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.
DescriptionEs: Después de animarse a luchar fustigándose con sus tres colas, carga a toda velocidad.

Name: Magikarp
Description: Magikarp is a pathetic excuse for a Pokémon that is only capable of flopping and splashing. This behavior prompted scientists to undertake research into it.
DescriptionEn: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.
DescriptionEs: No es precisamente rápido ni fuerte. Es el Pokémon más debilucho y simplón de todos los que hay.

Name: Gyarados
Description: When Magikarp evolves into Gyarados, its brain cells undergo a structural transformation. It is said that this transformation is to blame for this Pokémon's wildly violent nature.
DescriptionEn: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.
DescriptionEs: En la literatura antigua se dice que un Gyarados rebosante de violencia arrasó un poblado.

Name: Lapras
Description: People have driven Lapras almost to the point of extinction. In the evenings, this Pokémon is said to sing plaintively as it seeks what few others of its kind still remain.
DescriptionEn: A Pokémon that has been over­ hunted almost to extinction. It can ferry people across the water.
DescriptionEs: Son buenos de corazón. Muchos fueron capturados por ser tan pacíficos. Ahora hay muchos menos.

Name: Ditto
Description: Ditto rearranges its cell structure to transform itself into other shapes. However, if it tries to transform itself into something by relying on its memory, this Pokémon manages to get details wrong.
DescriptionEn: When it spots an enemy, its body transfigures into an almost-perfect copy of its opponent.
DescriptionEs: Puede alterar por completo su estructura celular para emular cualquier objeto que vea.

Name: Eevee
Description: Eevee has an unstable genetic makeup that suddenly mutates due to the environment in which it lives. Radiation from various stones causes this Pokémon to evolve.
DescriptionEn: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element STONEs.
DescriptionEs: Un extraño Pokémon que se adapta a los entornos más hostiles gracias a sus diferentes evoluciones.

Name: Vaporeon
Description: Vaporeon underwent a spontaneous mutation and grew fins and gills that allow it to live underwater. This Pokémon has the ability to freely control water.
DescriptionEn: Lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin which is often mistaken for a mermaid's.
DescriptionEs: Prefiere las bellas costas. Con células parecidas al agua, podría fundirse en la misma.

Name: Jolteon
Description: Jolteon's cells generate a low level of electricity. This power is amplified by the static electricity of its fur, enabling the Pokémon to drop thunderbolts. The bristling fur is made of electrically charged needles.
DescriptionEn: It accumulates negative ions in the atmosphere to blast out 10000- volt lightning bolts.
DescriptionEs: Todos los pelos de su cuerpo se ponen de punta si empieza a cargarse de electricidad.

Name: Flareon
Description: Flareon's fluffy fur has a functional purpose—it releases heat into the air so that its body does not get excessively hot. This Pokémon's body temperature can rise to a maximum of 1,650 degrees Fahrenheit.
DescriptionEn: When storing thermal energy in its body, its temperature could soar to over 1600 degrees.
DescriptionEs: Almacena llamas en su cuerpo, que alcanza una temperatura de 900 °C antes de un combate.

Name: Porygon
Description: Porygon is capable of reverting itself entirely back to program data and entering cyberspace. This Pokémon is copy protected so it cannot be duplicated by copying.
DescriptionEn: A Pokémon that consists entirely of programming code. Capable of moving freely in cyberspace.
DescriptionEs: Pokémon creado por el hombre tras muchas investigaciones. Sus habilidades son básicas.

Name: Omanyte
Description: Omanyte is one of the ancient and long-since-extinct Pokémon that have been regenerated from fossils by people. If attacked by an enemy, it withdraws itself inside its hard shell.
DescriptionEn: Although long extinct, in rare cases, it can be genetically resurrected from fossils.
DescriptionEs: Pokémon prehistórico que vivió en el océano primordial. Para nadar se valía de sus 10 tentáculos.

Name: Omastar
Description: Omastar uses its tentacles to capture its prey. It is believed to have become extinct because its shell grew too large and heavy, causing its movements to become too slow and ponderous.
DescriptionEn: A prehistoric Pokémon that died out when its heavy shell made it impossible to catch prey.
DescriptionEs: Tiene los tentáculos tan desarrollados que le sirven de manos y pies. Con ellos atrapa a su presa y le da un bocado.

Name: Kabuto
Description: Kabuto is a Pokémon that has been regenerated from a fossil. However, in extremely rare cases, living examples have been discovered. The Pokémon has not changed at all for 300 million years.
DescriptionEn: A Pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil found in what was once the ocean floor eons ago.
DescriptionEs: Se cree que habitó las playas hace 300 millones de años. Se protege con una dura concha.

Name: Kabutops
Description: Kabutops swam underwater to hunt for its prey in ancient times. The Pokémon was apparently evolving from being a water dweller to living on land as evident from the beginnings of change in its gills and legs.
DescriptionEn: Kabutops slices its prey apart and sucks out the fluids. The discarded body parts become food for other Pokémon.
DescriptionEs: Repliega sus extremidades en el agua para hacerse más compacto, y mueve su concha para nadar rápido.

Name: Aerodactyl
Description: Aerodactyl is a Pokémon from the age of dinosaurs. It was regenerated from genetic material extracted from amber. It is imagined to have been the king of the skies in ancient times.
DescriptionEn: A ferocious, pre­ historic Pokémon that goes for the enemy's throat with its serrated saw-like fangs.
DescriptionEs: Se regeneró a partir de material genético de un dinosaurio encontrado en ámbar. Cuando vuela emite escandalosos alaridos.

Name: Snorlax
Description: Snorlax's typical day consists of nothing more than eating and sleeping. It is such a docile Pokémon that there are children who use its expansive belly as a place to play.
DescriptionEn: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.
DescriptionEs: No se encuentra satisfecho hasta que no se come 400 kg de comida cada día. Cuando acaba de comer, se queda dormido.

Name: Articuno
Description: Articuno is a Legendary Pokémon that can control ice. The flapping of its wings chills the air. As a result, it is said that when this Pokémon flies, snow will fall.
DescriptionEn: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.
DescriptionEs: Legendario Pokémon pájaro capaz de generar ventiscas congelando la humedad del aire.

Name: Zapdos
Description: Zapdos is a Legendary Pokémon that has the ability to control electricity. It usually lives in thunderclouds. The Pokémon gains power if it is stricken by lightning bolts.
DescriptionEn: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.
DescriptionEs: Es un legendario pájaro Pokémon. Dicen que aparece entre las nubes lanzando enormes rayos brillantes.

Name: Moltres
Description: Moltres is a Legendary Pokémon that has the ability to control fire. If this Pokémon is injured, it is said to dip its body in the molten magma of a volcano to burn and heal itself.
DescriptionEn: Known as the legendary bird of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flash of flames.
DescriptionEs: Es más conocido como el legendario pájaro de fuego. Con cada aleteo crea brillantes llamas.

Name: Dratini
Description: Dratini continually molts and sloughs off its old skin. It does so because the life energy within its body steadily builds to reach uncontrollable levels.
DescriptionEn: Long considered a mythical Pokémon until recently when a small colony was found living underwater.
DescriptionEs: Se le llama el Pokémon Espejismo porque son muy pocos los que lo han visto. Se encontró su muda.

Name: Dragonair
Description: Dragonair stores an enormous amount of energy inside its body. It is said to alter weather conditions in its vicinity by discharging energy from the crystals on its neck and tail.
DescriptionEn: A mystical Pokémon that exudes a gentle aura. Has the ability to change climate conditions.
DescriptionEs: Sus cristalinos orbes parecen darle al Pokémon el poder de controlar el clima libremente.

Name: Dragonite
Description: Dragonite is capable of circling the globe in just 16 hours. It is a kindhearted Pokémon that leads lost and foundering ships in a storm to the safety of land.
DescriptionEn: An extremely rarely seen marine Pokémon. Its intelligence is said to match that of humans.
DescriptionEs: A pesar del tamaño que tiene y de lo pesado que es, puede volar. Es capaz de dar la vuelta al mundo en solo 16 horas.

Name: Mewtwo
Description: Mewtwo is a Pokémon that was created by genetic manipulation. However, even though the scientific power of humans created this Pokémon's body, they failed to endow Mewtwo with a compassionate heart.
DescriptionEn: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene splicing and DNA engineering experiments.
DescriptionEs: Fue creado por un científico tras años de horribles experimentos de ingeniería genética.

Name: Mew
Description: Mew is said to possess the genetic composition of all Pokémon. It is capable of making itself invisible at will, so it entirely avoids notice even if it approaches people.
DescriptionEn: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.
DescriptionEs: Varios científicos lo consideran el antecesor de los Pokémon porque usa todo tipo de movimientos.

Name: Chikorita
Description: In battle, Chikorita waves its leaf around to keep the foe at bay. However, a sweet fragrance also wafts from the leaf, becalming the battling Pokémon and creating a cozy, friendly atmosphere all around.
DescriptionEn: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.
DescriptionEs: Un dulce aroma se desprende de la hoja de su cabeza. Es dócil y le encanta absorber los rayos de sol.

Name: Bayleef
Description: Bayleef's neck is ringed by curled-up leaves. Inside each tubular leaf is a small shoot of a tree. The fragrance of this shoot makes people peppy.
DescriptionEn: The scent of spices comes from around its neck. Somehow, sniffing it makes you want to fight.
DescriptionEs: Emana un aroma picante de su cuello. El aroma actúa como estimulante para recuperar salud.

Name: Meganium
Description: The fragrance of Meganium's flower soothes and calms emotions. In battle, this Pokémon gives off more of its becalming scent to blunt the foe's fighting spirit.
DescriptionEn: The aroma that rises from its petals contains a substance that calms aggressive feelings.
DescriptionEs: El olor que desprenden sus pétalos contiene una sustancia que calma el instinto agresivo.

Name: Cyndaquil
Description: Cyndaquil protects itself by flaring up the flames on its back. The flames are vigorous if the Pokémon is angry. However, if it is tired, the flames splutter fitfully with incomplete combustion.
DescriptionEn: It is timid, and always curls it­ self up in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.
DescriptionEs: Es tímido y siempre se enrosca como una pelota. Si es atacado, enciende su lomo para protegerse.

Name: Quilava
Description: Quilava keeps its foes at bay with the intensity of its flames and gusts of superheated air. This Pokémon applies its outstanding nimbleness to dodge attacks even while scorching the foe with flames.
DescriptionEn: Be careful if it turns its back during battle. It means that it will attack with the fire on its back.
DescriptionEs: Antes de empezar a luchar, se gira ante su rival para alardear del alcance y la fuerza de sus llamas.

Name: Typhlosion
Description: Typhlosion obscures itself behind a shimmering heat haze that it creates using its intensely hot flames. This Pokémon creates blazing explosive blasts that burn everything to cinders.
DescriptionEn: If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot that anything that touches it will instantly go up in flames.
DescriptionEs: Si su furia crece, se calienta tanto que cualquier cosa que toque se prenderá al instante.

Name: Totodile
Description: Despite the smallness of its body, Totodile's jaws are very powerful. While the Pokémon may think it is just playfully nipping, its bite has enough power to cause serious injury.
DescriptionEn: Its well-developed jaws are powerful and capable of crushing anything. Even its trainer must be careful.
DescriptionEs: Es pequeño pero violento. No dudará en morder cualquier cosa que se mueva cerca.

Name: Croconaw
Description: Once Croconaw has clamped its jaws on its foe, it will absolutely not let go. Because the tips of its fangs are forked back like barbed fishhooks, they become impossible to remove when they have sunk in.
DescriptionEn: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.
DescriptionEs: Si pierde un colmillo, le crecerá otro en su lugar. Siempre tiene 48 colmillos en su boca.

Name: Feraligatr
Description: Feraligatr intimidates its foes by opening its huge mouth. In battle, it will kick the ground hard with its thick and powerful hind legs to charge at the foe at an incredible speed.
DescriptionEn: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.
DescriptionEs: Se suele mover lento, pero alcanza velocidades de vértigo al atacar y morder a sus enemigos.

Name: Sentret
Description: When Sentret sleeps, it does so while another stands guard. The sentry wakes the others at the first sign of danger. When this Pokémon becomes separated from its pack, it becomes incapable of sleep due to fear.
DescriptionEn: It has a very nervous nature. It stands up high on its tail so it can scan wide areas.
DescriptionEs: Cuando hace de centinela, avisa del peligro a los demás, chillando y dando golpes al suelo con la cola.

Name: Furret
Description: Furret has a very slim build. When under attack, it can slickly squirm through narrow spaces and get away. In spite of its short limbs, this Pokémon is very nimble and fleet.
DescriptionEn: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other Pokémon to enter.
DescriptionEs: Acurruca a sus crías para que duerman. Acorrala a los enemigos con su enorme velocidad.

Name: Hoothoot
Description: Hoothoot has an internal organ that senses and tracks the earth's rotation. Using this special organ, this Pokémon begins hooting at precisely the same time every day.
DescriptionEn: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.
DescriptionEs: Su percepción del tiempo es exacta. Ocurra lo que ocurra, lleva el ritmo moviendo la cabeza.

Name: Noctowl
Description: Noctowl never fails at catching prey in darkness. This Pokémon owes its success to its superior vision that allows it to see in minimal light, and to its soft, supple wings that make no sound in flight.
DescriptionEn: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.
DescriptionEs: Sus ojos están especialmente adaptados. Concentran la luz para poder ver en la oscuridad.

Name: Ledyba
Description: Ledyba secretes an aromatic fluid from where its legs join its body. This fluid is used for communicating with others. This Pokémon conveys its feelings to others by altering the fluid's scent.
DescriptionEn: It is very timid. It will be afraid to move if it is alone. But it will be active if it is in a group.
DescriptionEs: Cuando llega el frío, se reúnen muchos Ledyba de todas partes para darse calor.

Name: Ledian
Description: It is said that in lands with clean air, where the stars fill the sky, there live Ledian in countless numbers. There is a good reason for this—the Pokémon uses the light of the stars as its energy.
DescriptionEn: When the stars flicker in the night sky, it flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.
DescriptionEs: Cuando parpadean las estrellas en el cielo nocturno, se mece desprendiendo un polvo brillante.

Name: Spinarak
Description: The web spun by Spinarak can be considered its second nervous system. It is said that this Pokémon can determine what kind of prey is touching its web just by the tiny vibrations it feels through the web's strands.
DescriptionEn: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.
DescriptionEs: El veneno de sus colmillos no es demasiado tóxico, pero basta para mantener inmovilizadas a las presas que caen en sus redes.

Name: Ariados
Description: Ariados's feet are tipped with tiny hooked claws that enable it to scuttle on ceilings and vertical walls. This Pokémon constricts the foe with thin and strong silk webbing.
DescriptionEn: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It is hard to tell which end is which.
DescriptionEs: Teje su telaraña desde atrás y desde su boca. Es muy difícil saber dónde está cada cual.

Name: Crobat
Description: If this Pokémon is flying by fluttering only a pair of wings on either the forelegs or hind legs, it's proof that Crobat has been flying a long distance. It switches the wings it uses if it is tired.
DescriptionEn: Having four wings allows it to fly more quickly and quietly so it can sneak up on prey without its noticing.
DescriptionEs: Es tan silencioso cuando vuela en la oscuridad con sus cuatro alas, que cuesta percibirlo cuando se acerca.

Name: Chinchou
Description: Chinchou lets loose positive and negative electrical charges from its two antennas to make its prey faint. This Pokémon flashes its electric lights to exchange signals with others.
DescriptionEn: It shoots positive and negative elec­ tricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.
DescriptionEs: En el oscuro fondo del océano, su único modo de comunicarse es emitiendo luces parpadeantes.

Name: Lanturn
Description: Lanturn is nicknamed “the deep-sea star” for its illuminated antenna. This Pokémon produces light by causing a chemical reaction between bacteria and its bodily fluids inside the antenna.
DescriptionEn: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.
DescriptionEs: La luz de Lanturn se puede ver desde lo más profundo. Se le llama la Estrella de Alta Mar.

Name: Pichu
Description: Pichu charges itself with electricity more easily on days with thunderclouds or when the air is very dry. You can hear the crackling of static electricity coming off this Pokémon.
DescriptionEn: It is not yet skilled at storing electricity. It may send out a jolt if amused or startled.
DescriptionEs: Cuando juegan, se tocan las colas y emiten chispas. Al parecer, es una prueba de valor.

Name: Cleffa
Description: On nights with many shooting stars, Cleffa can be seen dancing in a ring. They dance through the night and stop only at the break of day, when these Pokémon quench their thirst with the morning dew.
DescriptionEn: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.
DescriptionEs: Por su inusual forma estrellada, la gente cree que procede de un meteorito que cayó a la tierra.

Name: Igglybuff
Description: Igglybuff's vocal cords are not sufficiently developed. It would hurt its throat if it were to sing too much. This Pokémon gargles with freshwater from a clean stream.
DescriptionEn: It has a very soft body. If it starts to roll, it will bounce all over and be impossible to stop.
DescriptionEs: Para caminar, en lugar de usar los pies que tiene, opta por dar botes con su cuerpo redondo y blandito.

Name: Togepi
Description: As its energy, Togepi uses the positive emotions of compassion and pleasure exuded by people and Pokémon. This Pokémon stores up feelings of happiness inside its shell, then shares them with others.
DescriptionEn: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.
DescriptionEs: El cascarón parece estar lleno de alegría. Dicen que trae buena suerte si es tratado con cariño.

Name: Togetic
Description: Togetic is said to be a Pokémon that brings good fortune. When the Pokémon spots someone who is pure of heart, it is said to appear and share its happiness with that person.
DescriptionEn: To share its happiness, it flies around the world seeking kind- hearted people.
DescriptionEs: Si no está con gente amable, se entristece. Puede flotar en el aire sin mover las alas.

Name: Natu
Description: Natu cannot fly because its wings are not yet fully grown. If your eyes meet with this Pokémon's eyes, it will stare back intently at you. But if you move even slightly, it will hop away to safety.
DescriptionEn: Because its wings aren't yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always star­ ing at something.
DescriptionEs: Va dando saltitos porque sus alas no han crecido lo suficiente. Siempre está pendiente de algo.

Name: Xatu
Description: Xatu stands rooted and still in one spot all day long. People believe that this Pokémon does so out of fear of the terrible things it has foreseen in the future.
DescriptionEn: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.
DescriptionEs: Cuando se pone a meditar al amanecer, pierde la noción del tiempo. Puede pasarse así todo el día.

Name: Mareep
Description: Mareep's fluffy coat of wool rubs together and builds a static charge. The more static electricity is charged, the more brightly the lightbulb at the tip of its tail glows.
DescriptionEn: If static elec­ tricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.
DescriptionEs: Su pelaje lanudo dobla su volumen al acumular electricidad estática. Tocarlo puede dar calambre.

Name: Flaaffy
Description: Flaaffy's wool quality changes so that it can generate a high amount of static electricity with a small amount of wool. The bare and slick parts of its hide are shielded against electricity.
DescriptionEn: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won't grow.
DescriptionEs: Su esponjosa lana almacena electricidad. Su piel gomosa evita que sea electrocutado.

Name: Ampharos
Description: Ampharos gives off so much light that it can be seen even from space. People in the old days used the light of this Pokémon to send signals back and forth with others far away.
DescriptionEn: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.
DescriptionEs: La punta de su cola reluce brillantemente y puede ser vista desde lejos. Es usado como faro.

Name: Bellossom
Description: When Bellossom gets exposed to plenty of sunlight, the leaves ringing its body begin to spin around. This Pokémon's dancing is renowned in the southern lands.
DescriptionEn: BELLOSSOM gather at times and appear to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.
DescriptionEs: Los Bellossom suelen reunirse para bailar. Dicen que sus danzas son un ritual para invocar al sol.

Name: Marill
Description: Marill's oil-filled tail acts much like a life preserver. If you see just its tail bobbing on the water's surface, it's a sure indication that this Pokémon is diving beneath the water to feed on aquatic plants.
DescriptionEn: The tip of its tail, which con­ tains oil that is lighter than wa­ ter, lets it swim without drowning.
DescriptionEs: Tiene una piel que repele el agua. De hecho, puede pasarse horas jugando en el agua sin mojarse.

Name: Azumarill
Description: Azumarill's long ears are indispensable sensors. By focusing its hearing, this Pokémon can identify what kinds of prey are around, even in rough and fast-running rivers.
DescriptionEn: By keeping still and listening in­ tently, it can tell what is in even wild, fast- moving rivers.
DescriptionEs: Sus largas orejas son sensores que pueden percibir movimientos de seres vivos en el lecho del río.

Name: Sudowoodo
Description: Sudowoodo camouflages itself as a tree to avoid being attacked by enemies. However, because its hands remain green throughout the year, the Pokémon is easily identified as a fake during the winter.
DescriptionEn: Despite appearing to be a tree, its body is closer to rocks and stones. It is very weak to water.
