DescriptionEs: Aunque pretende ser un árbol, en su composición se parece más a una roca que a una planta.

Name: Politoed
Description: The curled hair on Politoed's head is proof of its status as a king. It is said that the longer and more curled the hair, the more respect this Pokémon earns from its peers.
DescriptionEn: If POLIWAG and POLIWHIRL hear its echoing cry, they respond by gather­ ing from far and wide.
DescriptionEs: Cuando tres o más de estos se juntan, emiten un sonido muy fuerte parecido a un bramido.

Name: Hoppip
Description: This Pokémon drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, Hoppip links its leaves with other Hoppip to prepare against being blown away.
DescriptionEn: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters. They do enjoy gentle breezes, though.
DescriptionEs: Su cuerpo es tan ligero, que debe agarrarse bien al suelo con las patas para no irse con el viento.

Name: Skiploom
Description: Skiploom's flower blossoms when the temperature rises above 64 degrees Fahrenheit. How much the flower opens depends on the temperature. For that reason, this Pokémon is sometimes used as a thermometer.
DescriptionEn: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluc­ tuates up and down.
DescriptionEs: La flor de su cabeza se abre y cierra según suba o baje la temperatura.

Name: Jumpluff
Description: Jumpluff rides warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. The Pokémon descends to the ground when it encounters cold air while it is floating.
DescriptionEn: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.
DescriptionEs: Los vientos estacionales lo llevan por todo el mundo, donde va soltando sus esporas.

Name: Aipom
Description: Aipom's tail ends in a hand-like appendage that can be cleverly manipulated. However, because the Pokémon uses its tail so much, its real hands have become rather clumsy.
DescriptionEn: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.
DescriptionEs: Vive en lo alto de los árboles. Cuando salta de rama en rama, usa su cola para equilibrarse.

Name: Sunkern
Description: Sunkern tries to move as little as it possibly can. It does so because it tries to conserve all the nutrients it has stored in its body for its evolution. It will not eat a thing, subsisting only on morning dew.
DescriptionEn: It may drop out of the sky suddenly. If attacked by a SPEAROW, it will violently shake its leaves.
DescriptionEs: Puede caer del cielo de repente. Si le ataca un Spearow, moverá violentamente sus hojas.

Name: Sunflora
Description: Sunflora converts solar energy into nutrition. It moves around actively in the daytime when it is warm. It stops moving as soon as the sun goes down for the night.
DescriptionEn: It converts sun­ light into energy. In the darkness after sunset, it closes its petals and becomes still.
DescriptionEs: A medida que se acerca el verano, va adquiriendo un color más vivo e intenso en los pétalos de la cara.

Name: Yanma
Description: Yanma is capable of seeing 360 degrees without having to move its eyes. It is a great flier that is adept at making sudden stops and turning midair. This Pokémon uses its flying ability to quickly chase down targeted prey.
DescriptionEn: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter win­ dows in the area.
DescriptionEs: Su campo visual es de 360° sin girar la cabeza. Detecta hasta las presas que están a su espalda.

Name: Wooper
Description: Wooper usually lives in water. However, it occasionally comes out onto land in search of food. On land, it coats its body with a gooey, toxic film.
DescriptionEn: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.
DescriptionEs: Este Pokémon vive en aguas frías. Sale del agua para buscar comida cuando refresca el ambiente.

Name: Quagsire
Description: Quagsire hunts for food by leaving its mouth wide open in water and waiting for its prey to blunder in unaware. Because the Pokémon does not move, it does not get very hungry.
DescriptionEn: This carefree Pokémon has an easy-going nature. While swimming, it always bumps into boat hulls.
DescriptionEs: Es un Pokémon bastante perezoso. Para pescar permanece en el fondo del río con la boca abierta.

Name: Espeon
Description: Espeon is extremely loyal to any Trainer it considers to be worthy. It is said that this Pokémon developed its precognitive powers to protect its Trainer from harm.
DescriptionEn: Its fur is so sensitive, it can sense minute shifts in the air and predict the weather.
DescriptionEs: Al predecir el siguiente movimiento de su rival, chasquea el extremo de la cola bífida que tiene.

Name: Umbreon
Description: Umbreon evolved as a result of exposure to the moon's waves. It hides silently in darkness and waits for its foes to make a move. The rings on its body glow when it leaps to attack.
DescriptionEn: When agitated, this Pokémon pro­ tects itself by spraying poisonous sweat from its pores.
DescriptionEs: Creado cuando la luz lunar alteró la estructura genética de Eevee. Busca presas en la oscuridad.

Name: Murkrow
Description: Murkrow was feared and loathed as the alleged bearer of ill fortune. This Pokémon shows strong interest in anything that sparkles or glitters. It will even try to steal rings from women.
DescriptionEn: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.
DescriptionEs: Esconde objetos brillantes en un lugar secreto. Meowth y Murkrow suelen saquear su escondite.

Name: Slowking
Description: Slowking undertakes research every day in an effort to solve the mysteries of the world. However, this Pokémon apparently forgets everything it has learned if the Shellder on its head comes off.
DescriptionEn: It has incredible intellect and in­ tuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.
DescriptionEs: Su intelecto e intuición son increíbles. No pierde la compostura en ninguna situación.

Name: Misdreavus
Description: Misdreavus frightens people with a creepy, sobbing cry. The Pokémon apparently uses its red spheres to absorb the fearful feelings of foes and turn them into nutrition.
DescriptionEn: It likes playing mischievous tricks such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.
DescriptionEs: Se deleita con el miedo, que absorbe con sus esferas rojas. Por el día, duerme en la oscuridad.

Name: Unown
Description: This Pokémon is shaped like ancient writing. It is a mystery as to which came first, the ancient writings or the various Unown. Research into this topic is ongoing but nothing is known.
DescriptionEn: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tab­ lets. It is said that the two are somehow related.
DescriptionEs: Su cuerpo fino y plano aparece siempre en los muros. Su forma parece tener algún significado.

Name: Wobbuffet
Description: If two or more Wobbuffet meet, they will turn competitive and try to outdo each other's endurance. However, they may try to see which one can endure the longest without food. Trainers need to beware of this habit.
DescriptionEn: It hates light and shock. If attack­ ed, it inflates its body to pump up its counter­ strike.
DescriptionEs: Odia la luz y las sacudidas. Si le atacan, infla su cuerpo para aumentar su contraataque.

Name: Girafarig
Description: Girafarig's rear head also has a brain, but it is small. The rear head attacks in response to smells and sounds. Approaching this Pokémon from behind can cause the rear head to suddenly lash out and bite.
DescriptionEn: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent and bite.
DescriptionEs: Cuando duerme, la cabeza de su cola se queda vigilando, ya que ella no necesita dormir.

Name: Pineco
Description: Pineco hangs from a tree branch and patiently waits for prey to come along. If the Pokémon is disturbed while eating by someone shaking its tree, it drops down to the ground and explodes with no warning.
DescriptionEn: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.
DescriptionEs: Le gusta engrosar su coraza añadiendo cortezas de árbol. El aumento de peso no le molesta.

Name: Forretress
Description: Forretress conceals itself inside its hardened steel shell. The shell is opened when the Pokémon is catching prey, but it does so at such a quick pace that the shell's inside cannot be seen.
DescriptionEn: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside the armor is a total mystery.
DescriptionEs: Se protege con su concha de acero de tal manera que solo se pueden ver sus ojos.

Name: Dunsparce
Description: Dunsparce has a drill for its tail. It uses this tail to burrow into the ground backward. This Pokémon is known to make its nest in complex shapes deep under the ground.
DescriptionEn: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backward by furi­ ously boring into the ground with its tail.
DescriptionEs: Este Pokémon escapa hacia atrás perforando el suelo con su cola, si es descubierto.

Name: Gligar
Description: Gligar glides through the air without a sound as if it were sliding. This Pokémon hangs on to the face of its foe using its clawed hind legs and the large pincers on its forelegs, then injects the prey with its poison barb.
DescriptionEn: It flies straight at its target's face then clamps down on the star­ tled victim to inject poison.
DescriptionEs: A veces se sujeta a los precipicios. Cuando divisa una presa, despliega sus alas y planea para atacar.

Name: Steelix
Description: Steelix lives even further underground than Onix. This Pokémon is known to dig toward the earth's core. There are records of this Pokémon reaching a depth of over six-tenths of a mile underground.
DescriptionEn: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.
DescriptionEs: Atraviesa rocas a mordisco limpio. Sus ojos pueden ver en la oscuridad subterránea.

Name: Snubbull
Description: By baring its fangs and making a scary face, Snubbull sends smaller Pokémon scurrying away in terror. However, this Pokémon seems a little sad at making its foes flee.
DescriptionEn: Although it looks frightening, it is actually kind and affectionate. It is very popular among women.
DescriptionEs: Muy travieso por naturaleza, a muchas mujeres les gusta jugar con él porque es muy cariñoso.

Name: Granbull
Description: Granbull has a particularly well-developed lower jaw. The enormous fangs are heavy, causing the Pokémon to tip its head back for balance. Unless it is startled, it will not try to bite indiscriminately.
DescriptionEn: It is actually timid and easily spooked. If at­ tacked, it flails about to fend off its attacker.
DescriptionEs: A pesar de su aspecto, es muy tímido. Sin embargo, cuando se enfada, ataca con sus colmillos.

Name: Qwilfish
Description: Qwilfish sucks in water, inflating itself. This Pokémon uses the pressure of the water it swallowed to shoot toxic quills all at once from all over its body. It finds swimming somewhat challenging.
DescriptionEn: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.
DescriptionEs: Para arrojar sus venenosas púas, infla su cuerpo bebiendo hasta diez litros de agua de una sola vez.

Name: Scizor
Description: Scizor has a body with the hardness of steel. It is not easily fazed by ordinary sorts of attacks. This Pokémon flaps its wings to regulate its body temperature.
DescriptionEn: It swings its eye- patterned pincers up to scare its foes. This makes it look like it has three heads.
DescriptionEs: Las pinzas que posee tienen acero. Con ellas, no hay nada que se le resista. Rompen todo lo que pillan.

Name: Shuckle
Description: Shuckle quietly hides itself under rocks, keeping its body concealed inside its hard shell while eating berries it has stored away. The berries mix with its body fluids to become a juice.
DescriptionEn: The BERRIES it stores in its vase-like shell decompose and become a gooey liquid.
DescriptionEs: Las bayas que almacena en su caparazón con forma de tarro se convierten al final en un espeso zumo.

Name: Heracross
Description: Heracross charges in a straight line at its foe, slips beneath the foe's grasp, and then scoops up and hurls the opponent with its mighty horn. This Pokémon even has enough power to topple a massive tree.
DescriptionEn: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies’ bellies then lifts and throws them.
DescriptionEs: Este fuerte Pokémon clava su preciado cuerno en la tripa del enemigo, lo eleva y luego lo arroja.

Name: Sneasel
Description: Sneasel scales trees by punching its hooked claws into the bark. This Pokémon seeks out unguarded nests and steals eggs for food while the parents are away.
DescriptionEn: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it sud­ denly extends the claws and startles its enemy.
DescriptionEs: Se alimenta de huevos robados en nidos. Clava sus afiladas garras en los puntos débiles de sus rivales.

Name: Teddiursa
Description: This Pokémon likes to lick its palms that are sweetened by being soaked in honey. Teddiursa concocts its own honey by blending fruits and pollen collected by Beedrill.
DescriptionEn: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they are soaked with honey.
DescriptionEs: Si encuentra miel, brillará la marca de su frente. Se lame las garras cuando están llenas de miel.

Name: Ursaring
Description: In the forests inhabited by Ursaring, it is said that there are many streams and towering trees where they gather food. This Pokémon walks through its forest gathering food every day.
DescriptionEn: Although it is a good climber, it prefers to snap trees with its forelegs and eat fallen BERRIES.
DescriptionEs: Capaz de percibir cualquier tipo de aroma, encuentra sin problemas todo alimento enterrado bajo tierra.

Name: Slugma
Description: Molten magma courses throughout Slugma's circulatory system. If this Pokémon is chilled, the magma cools and hardens. Its body turns brittle and chunks fall off, reducing its size.
DescriptionEn: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn’t keep moving, its body will cool and harden.
DescriptionEs: Asiduo a las zonas volcánicas, se desliza lentamente en busca de lugares calientes.

Name: Magcargo
Description: Magcargo's shell is actually its skin that hardened as a result of cooling. Its shell is very brittle and fragile—just touching it causes it to crumble apart. This Pokémon returns to its original size by dipping itself in magma.
DescriptionEn: The shell on its back is just skin that has cooled and hardened. It breaks easily with a slight touch.
DescriptionEs: En ocasiones, su resbaladiza concha lanza intensas llamaradas que recorren todo su cuerpo.

Name: Swinub
Description: Swinub roots for food by rubbing its snout against the ground. Its favorite food is a mushroom that grows under the cover of dead grass. This Pokémon occasionally roots out hot springs.
DescriptionEn: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.
DescriptionEs: Frota su hocico contra el suelo para desenterrar comida. A veces descubre aguas termales.

Name: Piloswine
Description: Piloswine is covered by a thick coat of long hair that enables it to endure the freezing cold. This Pokémon uses its tusks to dig up food that has been buried under ice.
DescriptionEn: Although its legs are short, its rugged hooves prevent it from slipping, even on icy ground.
DescriptionEs: Aunque tiene las patas cortas, las fuertes pezuñas le permiten agarrarse bien al suelo, a pesar del hielo.

Name: Corsola
Description: Corsola's branches glitter very beautifully in seven colors when they catch sunlight. If any branch breaks off, this Pokémon grows it back in just one night.
DescriptionEn: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure for its beauty.
DescriptionEs: Crece y muda continuamente. La parte superior de su cabeza es muy apreciada por su belleza.

Name: Remoraid
Description: Remoraid sucks in water, then expels it at high velocity using its abdominal muscles to shoot down flying prey. When evolution draws near, this Pokémon travels downstream from rivers.
DescriptionEn: It has superb ac­ curacy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.
DescriptionEs: Tiene muy buena puntería. Dispara agua a sus presas, hasta si se están moviendo, a más de 100 metros.

Name: Octillery
Description: Octillery grabs onto its foe using its tentacles. This Pokémon tries to immobilize it before delivering the finishing blow. If the foe turns out to be too strong, Octillery spews ink to escape.
DescriptionEn: It traps enemies with its suction- cupped tentacles then smashes them with its rock-hard head.
DescriptionEs: Tiene querencia por los agujeros. Ataca escupiendo tinta metido en las grietas de rocas o en recipientes.

Name: Delibird
Description: Delibird carries its food bundled up in its tail. There once was a famous explorer who managed to reach the peak of the world's highest mountain, thanks to one of these Pokémon sharing its food.
DescriptionEn: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.
DescriptionEs: Transporta alimentos en su cola enrollada. Le gusta compartir su comida con los montañistas perdidos.

Name: Mantine
Description: On sunny days, schools of Mantine can be seen elegantly leaping over the sea's waves. This Pokémon is not bothered by the Remoraid that hitches rides.
DescriptionEn: As it majestically swims, it doesn't care if REMORAID attach to it for scavenging its leftovers.
DescriptionEs: Acumula velocidad nadando y puede saltar fuera del agua, alcanzando 100 metros de altura, para descender luego planeando.

Name: Skarmory
Description: Skarmory is entirely encased in hard, protective armor. This Pokémon flies at close to 190 mph. It slashes foes with its wings that possess swordlike cutting edges.
DescriptionEn: Its sturdy wings look heavy, but they are actually hollow and light, allowing it to fly freely in the sky.
DescriptionEs: Después de anidar en zarzas, las alas de sus polluelos crecen fortalecidas por los rasguños.

Name: Houndour
Description: Houndour hunt as a coordinated pack. They communicate with each other using a variety of cries to corner their prey. This Pokémon's remarkable teamwork is unparalleled.
DescriptionEn: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.
DescriptionEs: Al amanecer, resuena por la zona su inquietante aullido para anunciar que es su territorio.

Name: Houndoom
Description: In a Houndoom pack, the one with its horns raked sharply toward the back serves a leadership role. These Pokémon choose their leader by fighting among themselves.
DescriptionEn: If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away.
DescriptionEs: Hace mucho, la gente creía que sus horripilantes aullidos eran de la muerte personificada.

Name: Kingdra
Description: Kingdra lives at extreme ocean depths that are otherwise uninhabited. It has long been believed that the yawning of this Pokémon creates spiraling ocean currents.
DescriptionEn: It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.
DescriptionEs: Dicen que suele esconderse en cuevas submarinas. Puede crear torbellinos al bostezar.

Name: Phanpy
Description: For its nest, Phanpy digs a vertical pit in the ground at the edge of a river. It marks the area around its nest with its trunk to let the others know that the area has been claimed.
DescriptionEn: It swings its long snout around play­ fully, but because it is so strong, that can be dan­ gerous.
DescriptionEs: Como muestra de afecto, golpea con su trompa. Aunque es tan fuerte que te mandará lejos.

Name: Donphan
Description: Donphan's favorite attack is curling its body into a ball, then charging at its foe while rolling at high speed. Once it starts rolling, this Pokémon can't stop very easily.
DescriptionEn: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its TACKLE is strong enough to knock down a house.
DescriptionEs: Tiene afilados y duros colmillos, y una gruesa piel. Su Placaje es tan fuerte que puede derribar una casa.

Name: Porygon2
Description: Porygon2 was created by humans using the power of science. The man-made Pokémon has been endowed with artificial intelligence that enables it to learn new gestures and emotions on its own.
DescriptionEn: This upgraded version of PORYGON is designed for space exploration. It can't fly, though.
DescriptionEs: La investigación mejoró sus habilidades. A veces, puede actuar de forma no programada.

Name: Stantler
Description: Stantler's magnificent antlers were traded at high prices as works of art. As a result, this Pokémon was hunted close to extinction by those who were after the priceless antlers.
DescriptionEn: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where real­ ity is distorted.
DescriptionEs: Mirar a su cornamenta provoca una extraña sensación de pérdida de equilibrio.

Name: Smeargle
Description: Smeargle marks the boundaries of its territory using a body fluid that leaks out from the tip of its tail. Over 5,000 different marks left by this Pokémon have been found.
DescriptionEn: A special fluid oozes from the tip of its tail. It paints the fluid everywhere to mark its territory.
DescriptionEs: Marca su territorio usando su cola a modo de pincel. Ha hecho más de 5000 marcas diferentes.

Name: Tyrogue
Description: Tyrogue becomes stressed out if it does not get to train every day. When raising this Pokémon, the Trainer must establish and uphold various training methods.
DescriptionEn: It is always bursting with en­ ergy. To make it­ self stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.
DescriptionEs: Ataca siempre con mucha energía. Para fortalecerse a sí mismo, sigue luchando aunque pierda.

Name: Hitmontop
Description: Hitmontop spins on its head at high speed, all the while delivering kicks. This technique is a remarkable mix of both offense and defense at the same time. The Pokémon travels faster spinning than it does walking.
DescriptionEn: If you become enchanted by its smooth, elegant, dance-like kicks, you may get drilled hard.
DescriptionEs: Gira a gran velocidad al luchar. La fuerza centrífuga multiplica su poder de destrucción por diez.

Name: Smoochum
Description: Smoochum actively runs about, but also falls quite often. Whenever the chance arrives, it will look for its reflection to make sure its face hasn't become dirty.
DescriptionEn: Its lips are the most sensitive parts on its body. It always uses its lips first to examine things.
DescriptionEs: Sus labios son la parte más sensible de su cuerpo. Siempre los usa para examinar las cosas.

Name: Elekid
Description: Elekid stores electricity in its body. If it touches metal and accidentally discharges all its built-up electricity, this Pokémon begins swinging its arms in circles to recharge itself.
DescriptionEn: It rotates its arms to generate electricity, but it tires easily, so it charges up only a little bit.
DescriptionEs: Genera electricidad girando los brazos. No obstante, es incapaz de almacenar la energía creada.

Name: Magby
Description: Magby's state of health is determined by observing the fire it breathes. If the Pokémon is spouting yellow flames from its mouth, it is in good health. When it is fatigued, black smoke will be mixed in with the flames.
DescriptionEn: Each and every time it inhales and exhales, hot embers dribble out of its mouth and nostrils.
DescriptionEs: Es pequeño, pero su cuerpo puede llegar a alcanzar 600 °C. Cuando inspira y espira, expulsa llamas por la nariz y por la boca.

Name: Miltank
Description: Miltank gives over five gallons of milk on a daily basis. Its sweet milk is enjoyed by children and grown-ups alike. People who can't drink milk turn it into yogurt and eat it instead.
DescriptionEn: Its milk is packed with nutrition, making it the ultimate beverage for the sick or weary.
DescriptionEs: Si tiene crías, la leche que produce contiene muchos más nutrientes de lo normal.

Name: Blissey
Description: Blissey senses sadness with its fluffy coat of fur. If it does so, this Pokémon will rush over to a sad person, no matter how far away, to share a Lucky Egg that brings a smile to any face.
DescriptionEn: Anyone who takes even one bite of BLISSEY's egg be­ comes unfailingly caring and pleas­ ant to everyone.
DescriptionEs: Los huevos que pone están llenos de felicidad. Solo con probar un poquito de uno, cualquiera sonríe.

Name: Raikou
Description: Raikou embodies the speed of lightning. The roars of this Pokémon send shock waves shuddering through the air and shake the ground as if lightning bolts had come crashing down.
DescriptionEn: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.
DescriptionEs: Las nubes de lluvia que lleva le permiten lanzar rayos a voluntad. Dicen que apareció con un rayo.

Name: Entei
Description: Entei embodies the passion of magma. This Pokémon is thought to have been born in the eruption of a volcano. It sends up massive bursts of fire that utterly consume all that they touch.
DescriptionEn: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Un­ able to restrain its extreme power, it races headlong around the land.
DescriptionEs: Un Pokémon que corre por la tierra. Dicen que siempre nace uno cuando aparece un nuevo volcán.

Name: Suicune
Description: Suicune embodies the compassion of a pure spring of water. It runs across the land with gracefulness. This Pokémon has the power to purify dirty water.
DescriptionEn: Said to be the reincarnation of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.
DescriptionEs: Recorre el mundo para purificar agua contaminada. Corre veloz con el viento del norte.

Name: Larvitar
Description: Larvitar is born deep under the ground. To come up to the surface, this Pokémon must eat its way through the soil above. Until it does so, Larvitar cannot see its parents.
DescriptionEn: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.
DescriptionEs: Se alimenta de tierra. Después de comer una gran montaña, se duerme y empieza a crecer.

Name: Pupitar
Description: Pupitar creates a gas inside its body that it compresses and forcefully ejects to propel itself like a jet. The body is very durable—it avoids damage even if it hits solid steel.
DescriptionEn: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its THRASHING can topple a mountain.
DescriptionEs: Su cuerpo es duro como la roca. Se autopropulsa como un cohete soltando los gases de su interior.

Name: Tyranitar
Description: Tyranitar is so overwhelmingly powerful, it can bring down a whole mountain to make its nest. This Pokémon wanders about in mountains seeking new opponents to fight.
DescriptionEn: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.
DescriptionEs: En una de sus poderosas garras tiene el poder de hacer temblar la tierra y las montañas.

Name: Lugia
Description: Lugia's wings pack devastating power—a light fluttering of its wings can blow apart regular houses. As a result, this Pokémon chooses to live out of sight deep under the sea.
DescriptionEn: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea because its powers are too strong.
DescriptionEs: Duerme en una dorsal marina. Si bate sus alas, puede causar tormentas de 40 días.

Name: Ho-oh
Description: Ho-Oh's feathers glow in seven colors depending on the angle at which they are struck by light. These feathers are said to bring happiness to the bearers. This Pokémon is said to live at the foot of a rainbow.
DescriptionEn: Legends claim this Pokémon flies the world's skies con­ tinuously on its magnificent seven- colored wings.
DescriptionEs: Cuenta la leyenda que brilla en siete colores. Dicen que deja un arcoíris tras de sí al volar.

Name: Celebi
Description: This Pokémon came from the future by crossing over time. It is thought that so long as Celebi appears, a bright and shining future awaits us.
DescriptionEn: This Pokémon wan­ ders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.
DescriptionEs: Puede viajar en el tiempo, pero se dice que solo aparece en tiempos de paz.

Name: Treecko
Description: Treecko has small hooks on the bottom of its feet that enable it to scale vertical walls. This Pokémon attacks by slamming foes with its thick tail.
DescriptionEn: TREECKO has small hooks on the bottom of its feet that enable it to scale vertical walls. This Pokémon attacks by slamming foes with its thick tail.
DescriptionEs: Escala superficies verticales muy rápido. Con la cola detecta la humedad y prevé el tiempo que va a hacer.

Name: Grovyle
Description: The leaves growing out of Grovyle's body are convenient for camouflaging it from enemies in the forest. This Pokémon is a master at climbing trees in jungles.
DescriptionEn: The leaves growing out of GROVYLE’s body are convenient for camouflaging it from enemies in the forest. This Pokémon is a master at climbing trees in jungles.
DescriptionEs: Los desarrollados músculos que tiene en las extremidades inferiores le hacen ser muy ágil y le permiten dar grandes saltos.

Name: Sceptile
Description: The leaves growing on Sceptile's body are very sharp edged. This Pokémon is very agile—it leaps all over the branches of trees and jumps on its foe from above or behind.
DescriptionEn: The leaves growing on SCEPTILE’s body are very sharp edged. This Pokémon is very agile - it leaps all over the branches of trees and jumps on its foe from above or behind.
DescriptionEs: Las hojas de sus brazos pueden cortar gruesos árboles. Invencible en los combates en la jungla.

Name: Torchic
Description: Torchic sticks with its Trainer, following behind with unsteady steps. This Pokémon breathes fire of over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit, including fireballs that leave the foe scorched black.
DescriptionEn: TORCHIC sticks with its TRAINER, following behind with unsteady steps. This Pokémon breathes fire of over 1,800 degrees F, including fireballs that leave the foe scorched black.
DescriptionEs: En su interior, guarda una llama que arde sin cesar. Si se le abraza, se nota que tiene una temperatura muy alta.

Name: Combusken
Description: Combusken toughens up its legs and thighs by running through fields and mountains. This Pokémon's legs possess both speed and power, enabling it to dole out 10 kicks in one second.
DescriptionEn: COMBUSKEN toughens up its legs and thighs by running through fields and mountains. This Pokémon’s legs possess both speed and power, enabling it to dole out ten kicks in one second.
DescriptionEs: Su habilidad le permite dar diez patadas por segundo. Lanza potentes gritos para intimidar.

Name: Blaziken
Description: In battle, Blaziken blows out intense flames from its wrists and attacks foes courageously. The stronger the foe, the more intensely this Pokémon's wrists burn.
DescriptionEn: Flames spout from its wrists, enveloping its knuckles. Its punches scorch its foes.
DescriptionEs: Puede saltar edificios de 30 plantas. Con sus golpes de fuego quema a sus rivales.

Name: Mudkip
Description: The fin on Mudkip's head acts as highly sensitive radar. Using this fin to sense movements of water and air, this Pokémon can determine what is taking place around it without using its eyes.
DescriptionEn: The fin on MUDKIP’s head acts as highly sensitive radar. Using this fin to sense movements of water and air, this Pokémon can determine what is taking place around it without using its eyes.
DescriptionEs: Tiene una larga cola que le propulsa por el agua con mucha potencia. A pesar de ser pequeño, tiene mucha fuerza.

Name: Marshtomp
Description: The surface of Marshtomp's body is enveloped by a thin, sticky film that enables it to live on land. This Pokémon plays in mud on beaches when the ocean tide is low.
DescriptionEn: The surface of MARSHTOMP’s body is enveloped by a thin, sticky film that enables it to live on land. This Pokémon plays in mud on beaches when the ocean tide is low.
DescriptionEs: Sus piernas robustas impiden que pierda el equilibrio y caiga, incluso en el barro. Duerme bajo la arena.

Name: Swampert
Description: Swampert is very strong. It has enough power to easily drag a boulder weighing more than a ton. This Pokémon also has powerful vision that lets it see even in murky water.
DescriptionEn: SWAMPERT is very strong. It has enough power to easily drag a boulder weighing more than a ton. This Pokémon also has powerful vision that lets it see even in murky water.
DescriptionEs: Con sus brazos duros como el acero puede partir rocas gigantescas en mil pedazos de un solo golpe.

Name: Poochyena
Description: At first sight, Poochyena takes a bite at anything that moves. This Pokémon chases after prey until the victim becomes exhausted. However, it may turn tail if the prey strikes back.
DescriptionEn: At first sight, POOCHYENA takes a bite at anything that moves. This Pokémon chases after prey until the victim becomes exhausted. However, it may turn tail if the prey strikes back.
DescriptionEs: Es muy persistente. Si se fija en una presa, no la dejará hasta que caiga agotada.

Name: Mightyena
Description: Mightyena gives obvious signals when it is preparing to attack. It starts to growl deeply and then flattens its body. This Pokémon will bite savagely with its sharply pointed fangs.
DescriptionEn: It chases down prey in a pack. It will never disobey the commands of a skilled Trainer.
DescriptionEs: Siempre obedece a los buenos Entrenadores. Está acostumbrado a vivir en jaurías en estado salvaje.

Name: Zigzagoon
Description: Zigzagoon restlessly wanders everywhere at all times. This Pokémon does so because it is very curious. It becomes interested in anything that it happens to see.
DescriptionEn: ZIGZAGOON restlessly wanders everywhere at all times. This Pokémon does so because it is very curious. It becomes interested in anything that it happens to see.
DescriptionEs: Se mueve en zigzag. Se le da bien encontrar objetos ocultos en la hierba e incluso enterrados.

Name: Linoone
Description: Linoone always runs full speed and only in straight lines. If facing an obstacle, it makes a right-angle turn to evade it. This Pokémon is very challenged by gently curving roads.
DescriptionEn: LINOONE always runs full speed and only in straight lines. If facing an obstacle, it makes a right-angle turn to evade it. This Pokémon is very challenged by gently curving roads.
DescriptionEs: En línea recta corre a algo más de 100 km/h, pero no es tan hábil si hay curvas de por medio.

Name: Wurmple
Description: Using the spikes on its rear end, Wurmple peels the bark off trees and feeds on the sap that oozes out. This Pokémon's feet are tipped with suction pads that allow it to cling to glass without slipping.
DescriptionEn: Using the spikes on its rear end, WURMPLE peels the bark off trees and feeds on the sap that oozes out. This Pokémon’s feet are tipped with suction pads that allow it to cling to glass without slipping.
DescriptionEs: Le encanta comer hojas. Si le ataca un Starly, se defenderá con sus púas.

Name: Silcoon
Description: Silcoon tethers itself to a tree branch using silk to keep from falling. There, this Pokémon hangs quietly while it awaits evolution. It peers out of the silk cocoon through a small hole.
DescriptionEn: SILCOON tethers itself to a tree branch using silk to keep from falling. There, this Pokémon hangs quietly while it awaits evolution. It peers out of the silk cocoon through a small hole.
DescriptionEs: Se agarra con su seda a las ramas de un árbol y espera su evolución bebiendo agua de lluvia.

Name: Beautifly
Description: Beautifly's favorite food is the sweet pollen of flowers. If you want to see this Pokémon, just leave a potted flower by an open window. Beautifly is sure to come looking for pollen.
DescriptionEn: BEAUTIFLY’s favorite food is the sweet pollen of flowers. If you want to see this Pokémon, just leave a potted flower by an open window. BEAUTIFLY is sure to come looking for pollen.
DescriptionEs: Los dibujos de sus coloridas alas son muy peculiares. Liba el néctar de las flores con su fina trompa.

Name: Cascoon
Description: Cascoon makes its protective cocoon by wrapping its body entirely with a fine silk from its mouth. Once the silk goes around its body, it hardens. This Pokémon prepares for its evolution inside the cocoon.
DescriptionEn: CASCOON makes its protective cocoon by wrapping its body entirely with a fine silk from its mouth. Once the silk goes around its body, it hardens. This Pokémon prepares for its evolution inside the cocoon.
DescriptionEs: Está formado por seda que se endurece poco a poco. Si se resquebraja el capullo, está a punto de evolucionar.

Name: Dustox
Description: Dustox is instinctively drawn to light. Swarms of this Pokémon are attracted by the bright lights of cities, where they wreak havoc by stripping the leaves off roadside trees for food.
DescriptionEn: DUSTOX is instinctively drawn to light. Swarms of this Pokémon are attracted by the bright lights of cities, where they wreak havoc by stripping the leaves off roadside trees for food.
DescriptionEs: Pokémon nocturno. Atraído por las luces de la ciudad, se come las hojas y arbustos de las avenidas.

Name: Lotad
Description: Lotad live in ponds and lakes, where they float on the surface. It grows weak if its broad leaf dies. On rare occasions, this Pokémon travels on land in search of clean water.
DescriptionEn: LOTAD live in ponds and lakes, where they float on the surface. It grows weak if its broad leaf dies. On rare occasions, this Pokémon travels on land in search of clean water.
DescriptionEs: Parece una planta acuática. Hace de ferry para los Pokémon que no saben nadar.

Name: Lombre
Description: Lombre is nocturnal—it will get active after dusk. It is also a mischief maker. When this Pokémon spots anglers, it tugs on their fishing lines from beneath the surface and enjoys their consternation.
DescriptionEn: LOMBRE is nocturnal - it will get active after dusk. It is also a mischief-maker. When this Pokémon spots anglers, it tugs on their fishing lines from beneath the surface and enjoys their consternation.
DescriptionEs: Vive en el agua y, cuando hace sol, se queda en la orilla. De día duerme sobre las algas y de noche entra en acción.

Name: Ludicolo
Description: Ludicolo begins dancing as soon as it hears cheerful, festive music. This Pokémon is said to appear when it hears the singing of children on hiking outings.
DescriptionEn: LUDICOLO begins dancing as soon as it hears cheerful, festive music. This Pokémon is said to appear when it hears the singing of children on hiking outings.
DescriptionEs: Cuando oye música alegre, sus músculos se llenan de energía, y no puede evitar ponerse a bailar.

Name: Seedot
Description: Seedot attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. It sucks moisture from the tree while hanging off the branch. The more water it drinks, the glossier this Pokémon's body becomes.
DescriptionEn: SEEDOT attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. It sucks moisture from the tree while hanging off the branch. The more water it drinks, the glossier this Pokémon’s body becomes.
DescriptionEs: Se cuelga de las ramas con el extremo de su cabeza. A veces se cae cuando soplan vientos fuertes.

Name: Nuzleaf
Description: Nuzleaf live in densely overgrown forests. They occasionally venture out of the forest to startle people. This Pokémon dislikes having its long nose pinched.
DescriptionEn: NUZLEAF live in densely overgrown forests. They occasionally venture out of the forest to startle people. This Pokémon dislikes having its long nose pinched.
DescriptionEs: Cuando usa la hoja de su cabeza como flauta, asusta a la gente. Vive en lo más profundo de los bosques.

Name: Shiftry
Description: Shiftry is a mysterious Pokémon that is said to live atop towering trees dating back over a thousand years. It creates terrific windstorms with the fans it holds.
DescriptionEn: SHIFTRY is a mysterious Pokémon that is said to live atop towering trees dating back over a thousand years. It creates terrific windstorms with the fans it holds.
DescriptionEs: Habita los bosques y se le tiene miedo. Es capaz de leer los pensamientos del rival y actuar en consecuencia.

Name: Taillow
Description: Taillow courageously stands its ground against foes, however strong they may be. This gutsy Pokémon will remain defiant even after a loss. On the other hand, it cries loudly if it becomes hungry.
DescriptionEn: TAILLOW courageously stands its ground against foes, however strong they may be. This gutsy Pokémon will remain defiant even after a loss. On the other hand, it cries loudly if it becomes hungry.
DescriptionEs: Es un Pokémon valiente que no teme a los rivales fuertes. Vuela en busca de climas templados.

Name: Swellow
Description: Swellow flies high above our heads, making graceful arcs in the sky. This Pokémon dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. The hapless prey is tightly grasped by Swellow's clawed feet, preventing escape.
DescriptionEn: SWELLOW flies high above our heads, making graceful arcs in the sky. This Pokémon dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. The hapless prey is tightly grasped by SWELLOW’s clawed feet, preventing escape.
DescriptionEs: Cuando se encuentra bien, pone firmes las plumas de la cola doble que tiene. Remonta el vuelo de forma muy elegante.

Name: Wingull
Description: Wingull has the habit of carrying prey and valuables in its beak and hiding them in all sorts of locations. This Pokémon rides the winds and flies as if it were skating across the sky.
DescriptionEn: WINGULL has the habit of carrying prey and valuables in its beak and hiding them in all sorts of locations. This Pokémon rides the winds and flies as if it were skating across the sky.
DescriptionEs: Sus largas alas aprovechan los vientos marinos para planear. Cuando descansa, las pliega.

Name: Pelipper
Description: Pelipper is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon and eggs inside its massive bill. This Pokémon builds its nest on steep cliffs facing the sea.
DescriptionEn: PELIPPER is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon and eggs inside its massive bill. This Pokémon builds its nest on steep cliffs facing the sea.
DescriptionEs: Hunde su gran pico en el mar para sacar numerosas presas junto con mucha agua.

Name: Ralts
Description: Ralts senses the emotions of people using the horns on its head. This Pokémon rarely appears before people. But when it does, it draws closer if it senses that the person has a positive disposition.
DescriptionEn: RALTS senses the emotions of people using the horns on its head. This Pokémon rarely appears before people. But when it does, it draws closer if it senses that the person has a positive disposition.
DescriptionEs: Si sus cuernos perciben emociones positivas de personas o Pokémon, su cuerpo se calienta un poco.

Name: Kirlia
Description: It is said that a Kirlia that is exposed to the positive emotions of its Trainer grows beautiful. This Pokémon controls psychokinetic powers with its highly developed brain.
DescriptionEn: It is said that a KIRLIA that is exposed to the positive emotions of its TRAINER grows beautiful. This Pokémon controls psychokinetic powers with its highly developed brain.
DescriptionEs: Al percibir la alegría de su Entrenador refuerza sus ataques psicoquinéticos. Cuando está contento, da vueltas y baila.

Name: Gardevoir
Description: Gardevoir has the ability to read the future. If it senses impending danger to its Trainer, this Pokémon is said to unleash its psychokinetic energy at full power.
DescriptionEn: It unleashes psychokinetic energy at full power when protecting a Trainer it has bonded closely with.
DescriptionEs: Para proteger a su Entrenador, emplea todo su poder psíquico en crear un pequeño agujero negro.

Name: Surskit
Description: From the tips of its feet, Surskit secretes an oil that enables it to walk on water as if it were skating. This Pokémon feeds on microscopic organisms in ponds and lakes.
DescriptionEn: From the tips of its feet, SURSKIT secretes an oil that enables it to walk on water as if it were skating. This Pokémon feeds on microscopic organisms in ponds and lakes.
DescriptionEs: Parece que patina sobre el agua. Atrae a las presas con el suave aroma de su cabeza.

Name: Masquerain
Description: Masquerain intimidates enemies with the eyelike patterns on its antennas. This Pokémon flaps its four wings to freely fly in any direction—even sideways and backwards—as if it were a helicopter.
DescriptionEn: MASQUERAIN intimidates enemies with the eyelike patterns on its antennas. This Pokémon flaps its four wings to freely fly in any direction - even sideways and backwards - as if it were a helicopter.
DescriptionEs: Sus antenas tienen dibujos de ojos, mientras que sus alas le permiten volar en cualquier dirección.

Name: Shroomish
Description: Shroomish live in damp soil in the dark depths of forests. They are often found keeping still under fallen leaves. This Pokémon feeds on compost that is made up of fallen, rotted leaves.
DescriptionEn: SHROOMISH live in damp soil in the dark depths of forests. They are often found keeping still under fallen leaves. This Pokémon feeds on compost that is made up of fallen, rotted leaves.
DescriptionEs: Prefiere los sitios húmedos. De día está tranquilamente en el bosque, a la sombra. Expulsa polvo tóxico por la cabeza.

Name: Breloom
Description: Breloom closes in on its foe with light and sprightly footwork, then throws punches with its stretchy arms. This Pokémon's fighting technique puts boxers to shame.
DescriptionEn: BRELOOM closes in on its foe with light and sprightly footwork, then throws punches with its stretchy arms. This Pokémon’s fighting technique puts boxers to shame.
DescriptionEs: Sus cortos brazos se expanden cuando da puñetazos. Tiene una técnica pugilística muy depurada.

Name: Slakoth
Description: Slakoth lolls around for over 20 hours every day. Because it moves so little, it does not need much food. This Pokémon's sole daily meal consists of just three leaves.
DescriptionEn: SLAKOTH lolls around for over twenty hours every day. Because it moves so little, it does not need much food. This Pokémon’s sole daily meal consists of just three leaves.
DescriptionEs: Slakoth se pasa todo el día holgazaneando y solo con verlo a uno le entra mucha pereza.

Name: Vigoroth
Description: Vigoroth is always itching and agitated to go on a wild rampage. It simply can't tolerate sitting still for even a minute. This Pokémon's stress level rises if it can't be moving constantly.
DescriptionEn: VIGOROTH is always itching and agitated to go on a wild rampage. It simply can’t tolerate sitting still for even a minute. This Pokémon’s stress level rises if it can’t be moving constantly.
DescriptionEs: Su corazón palpita a un ritmo frenético, haciendo que su sangre bulla, así que no puede estarse quieto ni un segundo.

Name: Slaking
Description: Slaking spends all day lying down and lolling about. It eats grass growing within its reach. If it eats all the grass it can reach, this Pokémon reluctantly moves to another spot.
DescriptionEn: SLAKING spends all day lying down and lolling about. It eats grass growing within its reach. If it eats all the grass it can reach, this Pokémon reluctantly moves to another spot.
DescriptionEs: El Pokémon más perezoso del mundo. Cambia de lugar para coger la comida al alcance de su mano.

Name: Nincada
Description: Nincada lives underground for many years in complete darkness. This Pokémon absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees. It stays motionless as it waits for evolution.
DescriptionEn: NINCADA lives underground for many years in complete darkness. This Pokémon absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees. It stays motionless as it waits for evolution.
DescriptionEs: Como se ha pasado casi toda la vida viviendo bajo tierra, no ve bien. Las antenas que tiene le ayudan a orientarse.

Name: Ninjask
Description: Ninjask moves around at such a high speed that it cannot be seen, even while its crying can be clearly heard. For that reason, this Pokémon was long believed to be invisible.
DescriptionEn: NINJASK moves around at such a high speed that it cannot be seen, even while its crying can be clearly heard. For that reason, this Pokémon was long believed to be invisible.
DescriptionEs: Escuchar su zumbido de forma continuada provoca jaquecas. Casi no se le ve de lo rápido que es.

Name: Shedinja
Description: Shedinja's hard body doesn't move—not even a twitch. In fact, its body appears to be merely a hollow shell. It is believed that this Pokémon will steal the spirit of anyone peering into its hollow body from its back.
DescriptionEn: SHEDINJA’s hard body doesn’t move - not even a twitch. In fact, its body appears to be merely a hollow shell. It is believed that this Pokémon will steal the spirit of anyone peering into its hollow body from its back.
DescriptionEs: Es el caparazón de un bicho que cobró vida. Si alguien lo mira por la espalda, le robará el alma.

Name: Whismur
Description: Normally, Whismur's voice is very quiet—it is barely audible even if one is paying close attention. However, if this Pokémon senses danger, it starts crying at an earsplitting volume.
DescriptionEn: Normally, WHISMUR’s voice is very quiet - it is barely audible even if one is paying close attention. However, if this Pokémon senses danger, it starts crying at an earsplitting volume.
DescriptionEs: Normalmente murmulla, pero cuando siente que hay peligro se pone a chillar. Solo para cuando se le cierran las orejas.

Name: Loudred
Description: Loudred's bellowing can completely decimate a wood-frame house. It uses its voice to punish its foes. This Pokémon's round ears serve as loudspeakers.
DescriptionEn: LOUDRED’s bellowing can completely decimate a wood-frame house. It uses its voice to punish its foes. This Pokémon’s round ears serve as loudspeakers.
DescriptionEs: Aspira profundamente y luego, usando sus fuertes abdominales, suelta un potente vozarrón.

Name: Exploud
Description: Exploud triggers earthquakes with the tremors it creates by bellowing. If this Pokémon violently inhales from the ports on its body, it's a sign that it is preparing to let loose a huge bellow.
DescriptionEn: EXPLOUD triggers earthquakes with the tremors it creates by bellowing. If this Pokémon violently inhales from the ports on its body, it’s a sign that it is preparing to let loose a huge bellow.
DescriptionEs: Su aullido se puede oír a 10 km. Emite todo tipo de sonidos desde los tubos de su cuerpo.

Name: Makuhita
Description: Makuhita is tenacious—it will keep getting up and attacking its foe however many times it is knocked down. Every time it gets back up, this Pokémon stores more energy in its body for evolving.
DescriptionEn: MAKUHITA is tenacious - it will keep getting up and attacking its foe however many times it is knocked down. Every time it gets back up, this Pokémon stores more energy in its body for evolving.
DescriptionEs: Endurece su cuerpo golpeando grandes árboles sin perder jamás el ánimo.

Name: Hariyama
Description: Hariyama practices its straight-arm slaps in any number of locations. One hit of this Pokémon's powerful, openhanded, straight-arm punches could snap a telephone pole in two.
DescriptionEn: HARIYAMA practices its straight-arm slaps in any number of locations. One hit of this Pokémon’s powerful, openhanded, straight-arm punches could snap a telephone pole in two.
DescriptionEs: Para aumentar su fuerza, da un pisotón en el suelo. Puede lanzar un camión de 10 toneladas por los aires de un puñetazo.

Name: Azurill
Description: Azurill spins its tail as if it were a lasso, then hurls it far. The momentum of the throw sends its body flying, too. Using this unique action, one of these Pokémon managed to hurl itself a record 33 feet.
DescriptionEn: AZURILL spins its tail as if it were a lasso, then hurls it far. The momentum of the throw sends its body flying, too. Using this unique action, one of these Pokémon managed to hurl itself a record 33 feet.
DescriptionEs: Vive cerca del agua. En la tierra se mueve muy rápido botando sobre su gran cola.

Name: Nosepass
Description: Nosepass's magnetic nose is always pointed to the north. If two of these Pokémon meet, they cannot turn their faces to each other when they are close because their magnetic noses repel one another.
DescriptionEn: NOSEPASS’s magnetic nose is always pointed to the north. If two of these Pokémon meet, they cannot turn their faces to each other when they are close because their magnetic noses repel one another.
DescriptionEs: Siempre apunta al norte con su nariz imantada. Con ella reviste su cuerpo de objetos metálicos para protegerse.

Name: Skitty
Description: Skitty has the habit of becoming fascinated by moving objects and chasing them around. This Pokémon is known to chase after its own tail and become dizzy.
DescriptionEn: SKITTY has the habit of becoming fascinated by moving objects and chasing them around. This Pokémon is known to chase after its own tail and become dizzy.
DescriptionEs: No puede evitar ir tras las cosas que se mueven. Hasta corre en círculos persiguiéndose la cola.

Name: Delcatty
Description: Delcatty prefers to live an unfettered existence in which it can do as it pleases at its own pace. Because this Pokémon eats and sleeps whenever it decides, its daily routines are completely random.
DescriptionEn: DELCATTY prefers to live an unfettered existence in which it can do as it pleases at its own pace. Because this Pokémon eats and sleeps whenever it decides, its daily routines are completely random.
DescriptionEs: No soporta los lugares sucios. Le encanta acicalarse el pelaje cuando está a gusto en un sitio.

Name: Sableye
Description: Sableye lead quiet lives deep inside caverns. They are feared, however, because these Pokémon are thought to steal the spirits of people when their eyes burn with a sinister glow in the darkness.
DescriptionEn: SABLEYE lead quiet lives deep inside caverns. They are feared, however, because these Pokémon are thought to steal the spirits of people when their eyes burn with a sinister glow in the darkness.
DescriptionEs: Se oculta en cavernas oscuras. De tanto comer gemas, sus ojos son piedras preciosas.

Name: Mawile
Description: Mawile's huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed. Its docile-looking face serves to lull its foe into letting down its guard. When the foe least expects it, Mawile chomps it with its gaping jaws.
DescriptionEn: MAWHILE’s huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed. Its docile-looking face serves to lull its foe into letting down its guard. When the foe least expects it, MAWHILE chomps it with its gaping jaws.
DescriptionEs: Engaña con su aspecto dócil; hace que el rival se confíe y le da un mordisco con sus enormes e implacables mandíbulas.

Name: Aron
Description: This Pokémon has a body of steel. To make its body, Aron feeds on iron ore that it digs from mountains. Occasionally, it causes major trouble by eating bridges and rails.
DescriptionEn: This Pokémon has a body of steel. To make its body, ARON feeds on iron ore that it digs from mountains. Occasionally, it causes major trouble by eating bridges and rails.
DescriptionEs: Suele vivir en lugares inaccesibles de las montañas, pero el hambre lo empuja a comer raíles y coches.

Name: Lairon
Description: Lairon tempers its steel body by drinking highly nutritious mineral springwater until it is bloated. This Pokémon makes its nest close to springs of delicious water.
DescriptionEn: LAIRON tempers its steel body by drinking highly nutritious mineral springwater until it is bloated. This Pokémon makes its nest close to springs of delicious water.
DescriptionEs: Le encanta comer hierro. Lucha por su territorio embistiendo a sus rivales con su cuerpo de acero.

Name: Aggron
Description: Aggron claims an entire mountain as its own territory. It mercilessly beats up anything that violates its environment. This Pokémon vigilantly patrols its territory at all times.
DescriptionEn: AGGRON claims an entire mountain as its own territory. It mercilessly beats up anything that violates its environment. This Pokémon vigilantly patrols its territory at all times.
DescriptionEs: Hacen de toda una montaña su territorio. Cuantas más cicatrices tienen, más curtidos en disputas. ¡Mucha atención!

Name: Meditite
Description: Meditite undertakes rigorous mental training deep in the mountains. However, whenever it meditates, this Pokémon always loses its concentration and focus. As a result, its training never ends.
DescriptionEn: MEDITITE undertakes rigorous mental training deep in the mountains. However, whenever it meditates, this Pokémon always loses its concentration and focus. As a result, its training never ends.
DescriptionEs: Se entrena en la profundidad de las montañas. Cuando aumenta su poder espiritual con meditación, levita.

Name: Medicham
Description: It is said that through meditation, Medicham heightens energy inside its body and sharpens its sixth sense. This Pokémon hides its presence by merging itself with fields and mountains.
DescriptionEn: It is said that through meditation, MEDICHAM heightens energy inside its body and sharpens its sixth sense. This Pokémon hides its presence by merging itself with fields and mountains.
DescriptionEs: Evita los ataques moviéndose de forma elegante, como si bailara. Ataca dando un golpe devastador y moviéndose igual.

Name: Electrike
Description: Electrike stores electricity in its long body hair. This Pokémon stimulates its leg muscles with electric charges. These jolts of power give its legs explosive acceleration performance.
DescriptionEn: ELECTRIKE stores electricity in its long body hair. This Pokémon stimulates its leg muscles with electric charges. These jolts of power give its legs explosive acceleration performance.
DescriptionEs: Acumula electricidad estática en el pelaje para lanzar descargas. Cuando va a haber tormenta, suelta chispas por todo el cuerpo.

Name: Manectric
Description: Manectric is constantly discharging electricity from its mane. The sparks sometimes ignite forest fires. When it enters a battle, this Pokémon creates thunderclouds.
DescriptionEn: MANECTRIC is constantly discharging electricity from its mane. The sparks sometimes ignite forest fires. When it enters a battle, this Pokémon creates thunderclouds.
DescriptionEs: No suele aparecer ante la gente. Dicen que suele colocar su nido donde caen los rayos.

Name: Plusle
Description: Plusle always acts as a cheerleader for its partners. Whenever a teammate puts out a good effort in battle, this Pokémon shorts out its body to create the crackling noises of sparks to show its joy.
DescriptionEn: PLUSLE always acts as a cheerleader for its partners. Whenever a teammate puts out a good effort in battle, this Pokémon shorts out its body to create the crackling noises of sparks to show its joy.
DescriptionEs: Anima a sus compañeros con pompones de chispas. Roba energía de los postes telefónicos.

Name: Minun
Description: Minun is more concerned about cheering on its partners than its own safety. It shorts out the electricity in its body to create brilliant showers of sparks to cheer on its teammates.
DescriptionEn: MINUN is more concerned about cheering on its partners than its own safety. It shorts out the electricity in its body to create brilliant showers of sparks to cheer on its teammates.
DescriptionEs: La electricidad de Minun y Plusle es buena para la circulación y para desentumecer músculos.

Name: Volbeat
Description: With the arrival of night, Volbeat emits light from its tail. It communicates with others by adjusting the intensity and flashing of its light. This Pokémon is attracted by the sweet aroma of Illumise.
DescriptionEn: With the arrival of night, VOLBEAT emits light from its tail. It communicates with others by adjusting the intensity and flashing of its light. This Pokémon is attracted by the sweet aroma of ILLUMISE.
DescriptionEs: Se comunica con otros iluminando su cola por la noche. Le encanta el suave aroma de Illumise.

Name: Illumise
Description: Illumise attracts a swarm of Volbeat using a sweet fragrance. Once the Volbeat have gathered, this Pokémon leads the lit-up swarm in drawing geometric designs on the canvas of the night sky.
DescriptionEn: ILLUMISE attracts a swarm of VOLBEAT using a sweet fragrance. Once the VOLBEAT have gathered, this Pokémon leads the lit-up swarm in drawing geometric designs on the canvas of the night sky.
DescriptionEs: Con su dulce aroma guía a grupos de Volbeat para que tracen hasta 200 dibujos distintos en el cielo nocturno.

Name: Roselia
Description: Roselia shoots sharp thorns as projectiles at any opponent that tries to steal the flowers on its arms. The aroma of this Pokémon brings serenity to living things.
DescriptionEn: ROSELIA shoots sharp thorns as projectiles at any opponent that tries to steal the flowers on its arms. The aroma of this Pokémon brings serenity to living things.
DescriptionEs: Ataca con sus manos, en las que tiene un tipo de veneno diferente en cada una. Cuanto más aroma, mejor salud tiene.

Name: Gulpin
Description: Virtually all of Gulpin's body is its stomach. As a result, it can swallow something its own size. This Pokémon's stomach contains a special fluid that digests anything.
DescriptionEn: It has a small heart and brain. Its stomach comprises most of its body, with enzymes to dissolve anything.
DescriptionEs: Sus sesos y corazón son diminutos; es casi todo estómago. Sus jugos gástricos disuelven lo que sea.

Name: Swalot
Description: When Swalot spots prey, it spurts out a hideously toxic fluid from its pores and sprays the target. Once the prey has weakened, this Pokémon gulps it down whole with its cavernous mouth.
DescriptionEn: When SWALOT spots prey, it spurts out a hideously toxic fluid from its pores and sprays the target. Once the prey has weakened, this Pokémon gulps it down whole with its cavernous mouth.
DescriptionEs: Se traga cualquier cosa de una pieza. Sus poros segregan fluidos tóxicos que dañan a sus enemigos.

Name: Carvanha
Description: Carvanha's strongly developed jaws and its sharply pointed fangs pack the destructive power to rip out boat hulls. Many boats have been attacked and sunk by this Pokémon.
DescriptionEn: CARVANHA’s strongly developed jaws and its sharply pointed fangs pack the destructive power to rip out boat hulls. Many boats have been attacked and sunk by this Pokémon.
DescriptionEs: Atacan en grupo a los barcos y los hunden a base de bocados. Habitan en los ríos de la jungla.

Name: Sharpedo
Description: Nicknamed “the bully of the sea,” Sharpedo is widely feared. Its cruel fangs grow back immediately if they snap off. Just one of these Pokémon can thoroughly tear apart a supertanker.
DescriptionEn: Nicknamed “the bully of the sea,” SHARPEDO is widely feared. Its cruel fangs grow back immediately if they snap off. Just one of these Pokémon can thoroughly tear apart a supertanker.
DescriptionEs: Con sus colmillos puede atravesar el acero. Nada a 120 km/h. Le llaman el Terror de los Mares.

Name: Wailmer
Description: Wailmer's nostrils are located above its eyes. This playful Pokémon loves to startle people by forcefully snorting out seawater it stores inside its body out of its nostrils.
DescriptionEn: WAILMER’s nostrils are located above its eyes. This playful Pokémon loves to startle people by forcefully snorting out seawater it stores inside its body out of its nostrils.
DescriptionEs: Le gusta botar como una pelota de playa. Cuanta más agua de mar traga, más alto puede llegar.

Name: Wailord
Description: Wailord is the largest of all identified Pokémon up to now. This giant Pokémon swims languorously in the vast open sea, eating massive amounts of food at once with its enormous mouth.
DescriptionEn: WAILORD is the largest of all identified Pokémon up to now. This giant Pokémon swims languorously in the vast open sea, eating massive amounts of food at once with its enormous mouth.
DescriptionEs: Puede dejar fuera de combate a sus oponentes con el impacto de su enorme cuerpo al caer en el agua tras un salto.

Name: Numel
Description: Numel is extremely dull witted—it doesn't notice being hit. However, it can't stand hunger for even a second. This Pokémon's body is a seething cauldron of boiling magma.
DescriptionEn: NUMEL is extremely dull witted - it doesn’t notice being hit. However, it can’t stand hunger for even a second. This Pokémon’s body is a seething cauldron of boiling magma.
DescriptionEs: En su joroba almacena magma ardiente que se enfría cuando llueve y lo ralentiza.

Name: Camerupt
Description: Camerupt has a volcano inside its body. Magma of 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. Occasionally, the humps on this Pokémon's back erupt, spewing the superheated magma.
DescriptionEn: CAMERUPT has a volcano inside its body. Magma of 18,000 degrees F courses through its body. Occasionally, the humps on this Pokémon’s back erupt, spewing the superheated magma.
DescriptionEs: Los volcanes de su joroba entran en erupción cada 10 años o cuando Camerupt se enfada mucho.

Name: Torkoal
Description: Torkoal digs through mountains in search of coal. If it finds some, it fills hollow spaces on its shell with the coal and burns it. If it is attacked, this Pokémon spouts thick black smoke to beat a retreat.
DescriptionEn: TORKOAL digs through mountains in search of coal. If it finds some, it fills hollow spaces on its shell with the coal and burns it. If it is attacked, this Pokémon spouts thick black smoke to beat a retreat.
DescriptionEs: Trabaja sin descanso en minas en desuso localizando y extrayendo carbón.

Name: Spoink
Description: Spoink bounces around on its tail. The shock of its bouncing makes its heart pump. As a result, this Pokémon cannot afford to stop bouncing—if it stops, its heart will stop.
DescriptionEn: SPOINK bounces around on its tail. The shock of its bouncing makes its heart pump. As a result, this Pokémon cannot afford to stop bouncing - if it stops, its heart will stop.
DescriptionEs: Bota continuamente usando su cola como muelle. Salta para mantener el latido de su corazón.

Name: Grumpig
Description: Grumpig uses the black pearls on its body to amplify its psychic power waves for gaining total control over its foe. When this Pokémon uses its special power, its snorting breath grows labored.
DescriptionEn: GRUMPIG uses the black pearls on its body to amplify its psychic power waves for gaining total control over its foe. When this Pokémon uses its special power, its snorting breath grows labored.
DescriptionEs: Las perlas negras aumentan sus poderes psíquicos. Controla las mentes de sus rivales con un extraño baile.

Name: Spinda
Description: All the Spinda that exist in the world are said to have utterly unique spot patterns. The shaky, tottering steps of this Pokémon give it the appearance of dancing.
DescriptionEn: All the SPINDA that exist in the world are said to have utterly unique spot patterns. The shaky, tottering steps of this Pokémon give it the appearance of dancing.
DescriptionEs: No hay dos Spinda que tengan idénticos pelajes. Su tambaleo al bailar confunde a los rivales.

Name: Trapinch
Description: Trapinch's nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit dug in sand. This Pokémon patiently waits for prey to tumble down the pit. Its giant jaws have enough strength to crush even boulders.
DescriptionEn: TRAPINCH’s nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit dug in sand. This Pokémon patiently waits for prey to tumble down the pit. Its giant jaws have enough strength to crush even boulders.
DescriptionEs: Habita desiertos áridos. Cava fosas profundas, en las que espera que caiga su presa.

Name: Vibrava
Description: To make prey faint, Vibrava generates ultrasonic waves by vigorously making its two wings vibrate. This Pokémon's ultrasonic waves are so powerful, they can bring on headaches in people.
DescriptionEn: To make prey faint, VIBRAVA generates ultrasonic waves by vigorously making its two wings vibrate. This Pokémon’s ultrasonic waves are so powerful, they can bring on headaches in people.
DescriptionEs: Al agitar a gran velocidad ambas alas, emite ondas ultrasónicas que provocan fuertes dolores de cabeza.

Name: Flygon
Description: Flygon is nicknamed “the elemental spirit of the desert.” Because its flapping wings whip up a cloud of sand, this Pokémon is always enveloped in a sandstorm while flying.
DescriptionEn: FLYGON is nicknamed “the elemental spirit of the desert.” Because its flapping wings whip up a cloud of sand, this Pokémon is always enveloped in a sandstorm while flying.
DescriptionEs: Su medio es el desierto. Para esconderse, levanta arena con las patas. Tiene los ojos protegidos con mallas rojas.

Name: Cacnea
Description: Cacnea lives in arid locations such as deserts. It releases a strong aroma from its flower to attract prey. When prey comes near, this Pokémon shoots sharp thorns from its body to bring the victim down.
DescriptionEn: CACNEA lives in arid locations such as deserts. It releases a strong aroma from its flower to attract prey. When prey comes near, this Pokémon shoots sharp thorns from its body to bring the victim down.
DescriptionEs: Vive en regiones secas y con pocas lluvias. Una vez al año, le brota una flor amarilla.

Name: Cacturne
Description: During the daytime, Cacturne remains unmoving so that it does not lose any moisture to the harsh desert sun. This Pokémon becomes active at night when the temperature drops.
DescriptionEn: During the daytime, CACTURNE remains unmoving so that it does not lose any moisture to the harsh desert sun. This Pokémon becomes active at night when the temperature drops.
DescriptionEs: Es un Pokémon nocturno. Busca presas agotadas por el calor diurno del desierto.

Name: Swablu
Description: Swablu has light and fluffy wings that are like cottony clouds. This Pokémon is not frightened of people. It lands on the heads of people and sits there like a cotton-fluff hat.
DescriptionEn: SWABLU has light and fluffy wings that are like cottony clouds. This Pokémon is not frightened of people. It lands on the heads of people and sits there like a cotton-fluff hat.
DescriptionEs: Se desconoce el porqué, pero le encanta posarse sobre la cabeza de los humanos y fingir que es un gorro.

Name: Altaria
Description: Altaria dances and wheels through the sky among billowing, cotton-like clouds. By singing melodies in its crystal-clear voice, this Pokémon makes its listeners experience dreamy wonderment.
DescriptionEn: ALTARIA dances and wheels through the sky among billowing, cotton-like clouds. By singing melodies in its crystal-clear voice, this Pokémon makes its listeners experience dreamy wonderment.
DescriptionEs: Vuela pausadamente por el cielo azul. Su hermoso trino cautiva a todo aquel que lo escucha.

Name: Zangoose
Description: Memories of battling its archrival Seviper are etched into every cell of Zangoose's body. This Pokémon adroitly dodges attacks with incredible agility.
DescriptionEn: It has feuded with Seviper for many generations. Its sharp claws are its biggest weapons.
DescriptionEs: Hace muchos años que se enfrenta a Seviper. Su arma más eficaz son sus zarpas afiladas.

Name: Seviper
Description: Seviper shares a generations-long feud with Zangoose. The scars on its body are evidence of vicious battles. This Pokémon attacks using its sword-edged tail.
DescriptionEn: SEVIPER shares a generations-long feud with ZANGOOSE. The scars on its body are evidence of vicious battles. This Pokémon attacks using its sword- edged tail.
DescriptionEs: Hace frente a Zangoose con su agilidad y su afilada cola, que está cargada con un veneno letal.

Name: Lunatone
Description: Lunatone was discovered at a location where a meteoroid fell. As a result, some people theorize that this Pokémon came from space. However, no one has been able to prove this theory so far.
DescriptionEn: LUNATONE was discovered at a location where a meteorite fell. As a result, some people theorize that this Pokémon came from space. However, no one has been able to prove this theory so far.
DescriptionEs: Se piensa que está muy influido por las fases lunares, ya que solo actúa en noches de luna llena.

Name: Solrock
Description: Solrock is a new species of Pokémon that is said to have fallen from space. It floats in air and moves silently. In battle, this Pokémon releases intensely bright light.
DescriptionEn: SOLROCK is a new species of Pokémon that is said to have fallen from space. It floats in air and moves silently. In battle, this Pokémon releases intensely bright light.
DescriptionEs: Usa el sol como fuente de energía, por lo que es más poderoso de día. Brilla al rotar.

Name: Barboach
Description: Barboach's sensitive whiskers serve as a superb radar system. This Pokémon hides in mud, leaving only its two whiskers exposed while it waits for prey to come along.
DescriptionEn: BARBOACH’s sensitive whiskers serve as a superb radar system. This Pokémon hides in mud, leaving only its two whiskers exposed while it waits for prey to come along.
DescriptionEs: Recubre su cuerpo de una película viscosa que le permite escapar si alguien lo agarra.

Name: Whiscash
Description: Whiscash is extremely territorial. Just one of these Pokémon will claim a large pond as its exclusive territory. If a foe approaches it, it thrashes about and triggers a massive earthquake.
DescriptionEn: WHISCASH is extremely territorial. Just one of these Pokémon will claim a large pond as its exclusive territory. If a foe approaches it, it thrashes about and triggers a massive earthquake.
DescriptionEs: Habita en grandes pantanos. Si se acerca un enemigo, se alborota y causa temblores monumentales.

Name: Corphish
Description: Corphish were originally foreign Pokémon that were imported as pets. They eventually turned up in the wild. This Pokémon is very hardy and has greatly increased its population.
DescriptionEn: CORPHISH were originally foreign Pokémon that were imported as pets. They eventually turned up in the wild. This Pokémon is very hardy and has greatly increased its population.
DescriptionEs: Por sucio o contaminado que esté el río, se adaptan rápido y se multiplican. Poseen una gran fuerza vital.

Name: Crawdaunt
Description: Crawdaunt has an extremely violent nature that compels it to challenge other living things to battle. Other life-forms refuse to live in ponds inhabited by this Pokémon, making them desolate places.
DescriptionEn: CRAWDAUNT has an extremely violent nature that compels it to challenge other living things to battle. Other life-forms refuse to live in ponds inhabited by this Pokémon, making them desolate places.
DescriptionEs: Este malandrín usa sus pinzas para atosigar y expulsar a los otros Pokémon que viven en su estanque.

Name: Baltoy
Description: Baltoy moves while spinning around on its one foot. Primitive wall paintings depicting this Pokémon living among people were discovered in some ancient ruins.
DescriptionEn: BALTOY moves while spinning around on its one foot. Primitive wall paintings depicting this Pokémon living among people were discovered in some ancient ruins.
DescriptionEs: Se mueve girando sobre su eje. También se le puede ver girando cabeza abajo.

Name: Claydol
Description: Claydol are said to be dolls of mud made by primitive humans and brought to life by exposure to a mysterious ray. This Pokémon moves about while levitating.
DescriptionEn: CLAYDOL are said to be dolls of mud made by primitive humans and brought to life by exposure to a mysterious ray. This Pokémon moves about while levitating.
DescriptionEs: Este Pokémon es una vieja figurilla de barro que cobró vida mediante la exposición a extraños rayos de luz.

Name: Lileep
Description: Lileep became extinct approximately a hundred million years ago. This ancient Pokémon attaches itself to a rock on the seafloor and catches approaching prey using tentacles shaped like flower petals.
DescriptionEn: It lived on the seafloor 100 million years ago and was reanimated scientifically.
DescriptionEs: Se extinguió hace 100 millones de años. Sus tentáculos parecen pétalos para atraer a sus presas.

Name: Cradily
Description: Cradily roams around the ocean floor in search of food. This Pokémon freely extends its tree trunk-like neck and captures unwary prey using its eight tentacles.
DescriptionEn: CRADILY roams around the ocean floor in search of food. This Pokémon freely extends its tree trunk-like neck and captures unwary prey using its eight tentacles.
DescriptionEs: Vive en el fondo de los mares de aguas templadas. Emerge para cazar cuando baja la marea.

Name: Anorith
Description: Anorith was regenerated from a prehistoric fossil. This primitive Pokémon once lived in warm seas. It grips its prey firmly between its two large claws.
DescriptionEn: ANORITH was regenerated from a prehistoric fossil. This primitive Pokémon once lived in warm seas. It grips its prey firmly between its two large claws.
DescriptionEs: Es una especie de Pokémon predecesor. Estira las pinzas para cazar a sus presas, que se esconden en las rocas del mar.

Name: Armaldo
Description: Armaldo's tough armor makes all attacks bounce off. This Pokémon's two enormous claws can be freely extended or contracted. They have the power to punch right through a steel slab.
DescriptionEn: ARMALDO’s tough armor makes all attacks bounce off. This Pokémon’s two enormous claws can be freely extended or contracted. They have the power to punch right through a steel slab.
DescriptionEs: Ensarta a sus presas con sus gigantescas garras elásticas. Una fuerte coraza cubre su cuerpo.

Name: Feebas
Description: Feebas's fins are ragged and tattered from the start of its life. Because of its shoddy appearance, this Pokémon is largely ignored. It is capable of living in both the sea and in rivers.
DescriptionEn: FEEBAS’s fins are ragged and tattered from the start of its life. Because of its shoddy appearance, this Pokémon is largely ignored. It is capable of living in both the sea and in rivers.
DescriptionEs: Come de todo, por lo que puede vivir en aguas contaminadas. Nadie le presta atención.

Name: Milotic
Description: Milotic is said to be the most beautiful of all the Pokémon. It has the power to becalm such emotions as anger and hostility to quell bitter feuding.
DescriptionEn: MILOTIC is breathtakingly beautiful. Those that see it are said to forget their combative spirits.
DescriptionEs: Milotic es impresionantemente bello. Quienes lo ven, temen perder las ganas de luchar contra él.

Name: Castform
Description: Castform's appearance changes with the weather. This Pokémon gained the ability to use the vast power of nature to protect its tiny body.
DescriptionEn: CASTFORM’s appearance changes with the weather. This Pokémon gained the ability to use the vast power of nature to protect its tiny body.
DescriptionEs: Sus células son muy sensibles a los cambios de temperatura y humedad y se adapta sin problema.

Name: Kecleon
Description: Kecleon is capable of changing its body colors at will to blend in with its surroundings. There is one exception—this Pokémon can't change the zigzag pattern on its belly.
