DescriptionEn: KECLEON is capable of changing its body colors at will to blend in with its surroundings. There is one exception - this Pokémon can’t change the zigzag pattern on its belly.
DescriptionEs: Puede mudar el color de su cuerpo a voluntad, pero el dibujo en zigzag de su panza nunca desaparece.

Name: Shuppet
Description: Shuppet is attracted by feelings of jealousy and vindictiveness. If someone develops strong feelings of vengeance, this Pokémon will appear in a swarm and line up beneath the eaves of that person's home.
DescriptionEn: SHUPPET is attracted by feelings of jealousy and vindictiveness. If someone develops strong feelings of vengeance, this Pokémon will appear in a swarm and line up beneath the eaves of that person’s home.
DescriptionEs: Dicen que con su cuerno se alimenta de sentimientos de celos y envidia. Es muy activo a medianoche.

Name: Banette
Description: Banette generates energy for laying strong curses by sticking pins into its own body. This Pokémon was originally a pitiful plush doll that was thrown away.
DescriptionEn: A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge from being junked. It seeks the child that disowned it.
DescriptionEs: Este muñeco se convirtió en un Pokémon cuando lo tiraron a la basura. Busca a su antiguo dueño.

Name: Duskull
Description: Duskull can pass through any wall no matter how thick it may be. Once this Pokémon chooses a target, it will doggedly pursue the intended victim until the break of dawn.
DescriptionEn: DUSKULL can pass through any wall no matter how thick it may be. Once this Pokémon chooses a target, it will doggedly pursue the intended victim until the break of dawn.
DescriptionEs: Persigue a su presa sin descanso allá donde vaya. No obstante, abandona la caza al amanecer.

Name: Dusclops
Description: Dusclops's body is completely hollow—there is nothing at all inside. It is said that its body is like a black hole. This Pokémon will absorb anything into its body, but nothing will ever come back out.
DescriptionEn: DUSCLOPS’s body is completely hollow - there is nothing at all inside. It is said that its body is like a black hole. This Pokémon will absorb anything into its body, but nothing will ever come back out.
DescriptionEs: Si alguien mira los fuegos fatuos del interior de Dusclops, perderá su alma irremediablemente.

Name: Tropius
Description: The bunches of fruit around Tropius's neck are very popular with children. This Pokémon loves fruit, and eats it continuously. Apparently, its love for fruit resulted in its own outgrowth of fruit.
DescriptionEn: It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of fruit around its neck is delicious. The fruit grows twice a year.
DescriptionEs: Puede volar al agitar sus grandes hojas. Reparte entre los niños la codiciada fruta dulce que crece de su cuello.

Name: Chimecho
Description: Chimecho makes its cries echo inside its hollow body. When this Pokémon becomes enraged, its cries result in ultrasonic waves that have the power to knock foes flying.
DescriptionEn: CHIMECHO makes its cries echo inside its hollow body. When this Pokémon becomes enraged, its cries result in ultrasonic waves that have the power to knock foes flying.
DescriptionEs: Se cuelga de ramas y aleros con la ventosa de su cabeza. Tiene siete tipos de gritos diferentes.

Name: Absol
Description: Every time Absol appears before people, it is followed by a disaster such as an earthquake or a tidal wave. As a result, it came to be known as the disaster Pokémon.
DescriptionEn: Every time ABSOL appears before people, it is followed by a disaster such as an earthquake or a tidal wave. As a result, it came to be known as the disaster Pokémon.
DescriptionEs: Presiente desastres inminentes y se aparece a la gente para advertir del peligro.

Name: Wynaut
Description: Wynaut can always be seen with a big, happy smile on its face. Look at its tail to determine if it is angry. When angered, this Pokémon will be slapping the ground with its tail.
DescriptionEn: WYNAUT can always be seen with a big, happy smile on its face. Look at its tail to determine if it is angry. When angered, this Pokémon will be slapping the ground with its tail.
DescriptionEs: Suelen ir en grupo y a la hora de dormir se resguardan en una cueva.

Name: Snorunt
Description: Snorunt live in regions with heavy snowfall. In seasons without snow, such as spring and summer, this Pokémon steals away to live quietly among stalactites and stalagmites deep in caverns.
DescriptionEn: SNORUNT live in regions with heavy snowfall. In seasons without snow, such as spring and summer, this Pokémon steals away to live quietly among stalactites and stalagmites deep in caverns.
DescriptionEs: Se dice que se reúnen en grupos bajo hojas gigantescas y viven allí en total armonía.

Name: Glalie
Description: Glalie has a body made of rock, which it hardens with an armor of ice. This Pokémon has the ability to freeze moisture in the atmosphere into any shape it desires.
DescriptionEn: GLALIE has a body made of rock, which it hardens with an armor of ice. This Pokémon has the ability to freeze moisture in the atmosphere into any shape it desires.
DescriptionEs: Se protege con una armadura de hielo creada por congelación de la humedad del aire.

Name: Spheal
Description: Spheal is much faster rolling than walking to get around. When groups of this Pokémon eat, they all clap at once to show their pleasure. Because of this, their mealtimes are noisy.
DescriptionEn: SPHEAL is much faster rolling than walking to get around. When groups of this Pokémon eat, they all clap at once to show their pleasure. Because of this, their mealtimes are noisy.
DescriptionEs: Como no saben nadar muy bien, se mueven rápidamente rodando. Cuando están alegres, dan palmadas con las aletas.

Name: Sealeo
Description: Sealeo has the habit of always juggling on the tip of its nose anything it sees for the first time. This Pokémon occasionally entertains itself by balancing and rolling a Spheal on its nose.
DescriptionEn: It has a very sensitive nose. It touches new things with its nose to examine them.
DescriptionEs: Su nariz es muy sensible. Cuando ve algo por primera vez, lo toca con ella para recordarlo después.

Name: Walrein
Description: Walrein's two massively developed tusks can totally shatter blocks of ice weighing 10 tons with one blow. This Pokémon's thick coat of blubber insulates it from subzero temperatures.
DescriptionEn: WALREIN’s two massively developed tusks can totally shatter blocks of ice weighing ten tons with one blow. This Pokémon’s thick coat of blubber insulates it from subzero temperatures.
DescriptionEs: Rompe el hielo con sus colmillos. Su gruesa capa de grasa le protege del frío y de los enemigos.

Name: Clamperl
Description: Clamperl's sturdy shell is not only good for protection—it is also used for clamping and catching prey. A fully grown Clamperl's shell will be scored with nicks and scratches all over.
DescriptionEn: CLAMPERL’s sturdy shell is not only good for protection - it is also used for clamping and catching prey. A fully grown CLAMPERL’s shell will be scored with nicks and scratches all over.
DescriptionEs: Produce durante su vida una sola perla que aumenta los poderes psíquicos al evolucionar.

Name: Huntail
Description: Huntail's presence went unnoticed by people for a long time because it lives at extreme depths in the sea. This Pokémon's eyes can see clearly even in the murky dark depths of the ocean.
DescriptionEn: HUNTAIL’s presence went unnoticed by people for a long time because it lives at extreme depths in the sea. This Pokémon’s eyes can see clearly even in the murky dark depths of the ocean.
DescriptionEs: Vive en los abismos marinos, donde no se filtra la luz. Tiene una cola en forma de pez, que enciende para atraer a su presa.

Name: Gorebyss
Description: Gorebyss lives in the southern seas at extreme depths. Its body is built to withstand the enormous pressure of water at incredible depths. Because of this, this Pokémon's body is unharmed by ordinary attacks.
DescriptionEn: GOREBYSS lives in the southern seas at extreme depths. Its body is built to withstand the enormous pressure of water at incredible depths. Because of this, this Pokémon’s body is unharmed by ordinary attacks.
DescriptionEs: Vive en el fondo del mar. En primavera, su cuerpo rosado adquiere colores más vivos.

Name: Relicanth
Description: Relicanth is a Pokémon species that existed for a hundred million years without ever changing its form. This ancient Pokémon feeds on microscopic organisms with its toothless mouth.
DescriptionEn: RELICANTH is a Pokémon species that existed for a hundred million years without ever changing its form. This ancient Pokémon feeds on microscopic organisms with its toothless mouth.
DescriptionEs: No ha sufrido ningún cambio desde hace 100 millones de años. Fue descubierto durante una expedición marina.

Name: Luvdisc
Description: Luvdisc live in shallow seas in the tropics. This heart-shaped Pokémon earned its name by swimming after loving couples it spotted in the ocean's waves.
DescriptionEn: LUVDISC live in shallow seas in the tropics. This heart-shaped Pokémon earned its name by swimming after loving couples it spotted in the ocean’s waves.
DescriptionEs: Vive en mares cálidos. Se dice que, si una pareja lo encuentra, será bendecida con amor eterno.

Name: Bagon
Description: Bagon has a dream of one day soaring in the sky. In doomed efforts to fly, this Pokémon hurls itself off cliffs. As a result of its dives, its head has grown tough and as hard as tempered steel.
DescriptionEn: BAGON has a dream of one day soaring in the sky. In doomed efforts to fly, this Pokémon hurls itself off cliffs. As a result of its dives, its head has grown tough and as hard as tempered steel.
DescriptionEs: Su desarrollado cuello y su cabeza dura como el acero le permiten reducir a añicos rocas enormes.

Name: Shelgon
Description: Inside Shelgon's armor-like shell, cells are in the midst of transformation to create an entirely new body. This Pokémon's shell is extremely heavy, making its movements sluggish.
DescriptionEn: Inside SHELGON’s armor-like shell, cells are in the midst of transformation to create an entirely new body. This Pokémon’s shell is extremely heavy, making its movements sluggish.
DescriptionEs: Las células han empezado a cambiar dentro de su dura concha, que se separa cuando evoluciona.

Name: Salamence
Description: Salamence came about as a result of a strong, long-held dream of growing wings. It is said that this powerful desire triggered a sudden mutation in this Pokémon's cells, causing it to sprout its magnificent wings.
DescriptionEn: SALAMENCE came about as a result of a strong, long-held dream of growing wings. It is said that this powerful desire triggered a sudden mutation in this Pokémon’s cells, causing it to sprout its magnificent wings.
DescriptionEs: Si se enfada, no hay forma de calmarlo; lo destruye todo lanzando arañazos y llamas.

Name: Beldum
Description: Instead of blood, a powerful magnetic force courses throughout Beldum's body. This Pokémon communicates with others by sending controlled pulses of magnetism.
DescriptionEn: It converses with others by using magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.
DescriptionEs: Los pulsos magnéticos de su cuerpo repelen la gravedad, lo que le permite flotar en el aire.

Name: Metang
Description: When two Beldum fuse together, Metang is formed. The brains of the Beldum are joined by a magnetic nervous system. By linking its brains magnetically, this Pokémon generates strong psychokinetic power.
DescriptionEn: When two BELDUM fuse together, METANG is formed. The brains of the BELDUM are joined by a magnetic nervous system. By linking its brains magnetically, this Pokémon generates strong psychokinetic power.
DescriptionEs: Lo forman dos Beldum unidos. Puede chocarse con un avión sin que su cuerpo de acero sufra ni un rasguño.

Name: Metagross
Description: Metagross has four brains in total. Combined, the four brains can breeze through difficult calculations faster than a supercomputer. This Pokémon can float in the air by tucking in its four legs.
DescriptionEn: METAGROSS has four brains in total. Combined, the four brains can breeze through difficult calculations faster than a supercomputer. This Pokémon can float in the air by tucking in its four legs.
DescriptionEs: Gracias a sus cuatro cerebros, es más inteligente que un superordenador y analiza con precisión al enemigo.

Name: Regirock
Description: Regirock was sealed away by people long ago. If this Pokémon's body is damaged in battle, it is said to seek out suitable rocks on its own to repair itself.
DescriptionEn: REGIROCK was sealed away by people long ago. If this Pokémon’s body is damaged in battle, it is said to seek out suitable rocks on its own to repair itself.
DescriptionEs: Su cuerpo está hecho de roca. Si se astilla durante el combate, emplea piedras para repararlo.

Name: Regice
Description: Regice's body was made during an ice age. The deep-frozen body can't be melted, even by fire. This Pokémon controls frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.
DescriptionEn: REGICE’s body was made during an ice age. The deep-frozen body can’t be melted, even by fire. This Pokémon controls frigid air of minus 328 degrees F.
DescriptionEs: Dicen que ha yacido durmiendo en un glaciar durante milenios. Ni el magma puede derretir su cuerpo.

Name: Registeel
Description: Registeel has a body that is harder than any kind of metal. Its body is apparently hollow. No one has any idea what this Pokémon eats.
DescriptionEn: REGISTEEL has a body that is harder than any kind of metal. Its body is apparently hollow. No one has any idea what this Pokémon eats.
DescriptionEs: Su cuerpo ha estado sometido a la presión subterránea durante miles de años y no puede arañarse.

Name: Latias
Description: Latias is highly sensitive to the emotions of people. If it senses any hostility, this Pokémon ruffles the feathers all over its body and cries shrilly to intimidate the foe.
DescriptionEn: LATIAS is highly sensitive to the emotions of people. If it senses any hostility, this Pokémon ruffles the feathers all over its body and cries shrilly to intimidate the foe.
DescriptionEs: Se comunica por telepatía. Su plumaje refleja la luz, lo que le permite hacerse invisible.

Name: Latios
Description: Latios has the ability to make others see an image of what it has seen or imagines in its head. This Pokémon is intelligent and understands human speech.
DescriptionEn: LATIOS has the ability to make its foe see an image of what it has seen or imagines in its head. This Pokémon is intelligent and understands human speech.
DescriptionEs: Es un Pokémon muy inteligente. Puede adelantar a aviones a reacción plegando las alas.

Name: Kyogre
Description: Through Primal Reversion and with nature's full power, it will take back its true form. It can summon storms that cause the sea levels to rise.
DescriptionEn: KYOGRE has the power to create massive rain clouds that cover the entire sky and bring about torrential downpours. This Pokémon saved people who were suffering from droughts.
DescriptionEs: Pokémon legendario que aumentó los mares con diluvios y maremotos. Fue un enemigo acérrimo de Groudon.

Name: Groudon
Description: Groudon is said to be the personification of the land itself. Legends tell of its many clashes against Kyogre, as each sought to gain the power of nature.
DescriptionEn: GROUDON has long been described in mythology as the Pokémon that raised lands and expanded continents. This Pokémon took to sleep after a cataclysmic battle with KYOGRE.
DescriptionEs: Dicen que aumentó la superficie terrestre evaporando el agua. Fue un enemigo acérrimo de Kyogre.

Name: Rayquaza
Description: Rayquaza is said to have lived for hundreds of millions of years. Legends remain of how it put to rest the clash between Kyogre and Groudon.
DescriptionEn: RAYQUAZA lived for hundreds of millions of years in the earth’s ozone layer, never descending to the ground. This Pokémon appears to feed on water and particles in the atmosphere.
DescriptionEs: Vive en la capa de ozono sobre las nubes y no puede ser visto desde el suelo.

Name: Jirachi
Description: A legend states that Jirachi will make true any wish that is written on notes attached to its head when it awakens. If this Pokémon senses danger, it will fight without awakening.
DescriptionEn: A legend states that JIRACHI will make true any wish that is written on notes attached to its head when it awakens. If this Pokémon senses danger, it will fight without awakening.
DescriptionEs: Desde antaño se dice que concederá los deseos escritos en las notas de su cabeza cuando se despierte.

Name: DeoxysNormal Forme
Description: The DNA of a space virus underwent a sudden mutation upon exposure to a laser beam and resulted in Deoxys. The crystalline organ on this Pokémon's chest appears to be its brain.
DescriptionEn: The DNA of a space virus underwent a sudden mutation upon exposure to a laser beam and resulted in DEOXYS. The crystalline organ on this Pokémon’s chest appears to be its brain.
DescriptionEs: Surgió a raíz de la mutación de ADN de un virus alienígena que cayó a la Tierra en un meteorito.

Name: Turtwig
Description: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.
DescriptionEn: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.
DescriptionEs: Realiza la fotosíntesis al bañarle los rayos de sol. Su concha está formada por tierra endurecida.

Name: Grotle
Description: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.
DescriptionEn: A GROTLE that lives in the forest is said to have its own secret springwater.
DescriptionEs: Vive en los bosques cerca del agua. Por el día, sale a que les dé el sol a las plantas de su espalda.

Name: Torterra
Description: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.
DescriptionEn: Some Pokémon are born on a Torterra’s back and spend their entire life there.
DescriptionEs: Las gentes de antaño creían que el planeta se sustentaba en la espalda de un gran Torterra.

Name: Chimchar
Description: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.
DescriptionEn: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.
DescriptionEs: El gas de su panza alimenta el fuego de su parte trasera, que ni la lluvia puede extinguir.

Name: Monferno
Description: It uses ceilings and walls to launch aerial attacks. Its fiery tail is but one weapon.
DescriptionEn: To intimidate attackers, it stretches the fire on its tail to make itself appear bigger.
DescriptionEs: Controla hábilmente la intensidad del fuego de su cola para mantener al enemigo a una distancia ideal.

Name: Infernape
Description: It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.
DescriptionEn: It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.
DescriptionEs: Su corona de fuego demuestra su naturaleza ígnea. Nadie le gana en velocidad.

Name: Piplup
Description: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.
DescriptionEn: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.
DescriptionEs: No le gusta que lo cuiden. Como no aprecia el apoyo de su Entrenador, le cuesta coger confianza con él.

Name: Prinplup
Description: It lives a solitary life. Its wings deliver wicked blows that can snap even the thickest of trees.
DescriptionEn: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.
DescriptionEs: Vive solo, alejado de los demás. Cada uno piensa que es el más importante.

Name: Empoleon
Description: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.
DescriptionEn: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.
DescriptionEs: Nada tan rápido como un fueraborda. Con los afilados bordes de sus alas puede cortar el hielo.

Name: Starly
Description: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.
DescriptionEn: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.
DescriptionEs: Sobrevuela los campos buscando Pokémon de tipo Bicho. Chilla de forma muy estridente.

Name: Staravia
Description: It lives in forests and fields. Squabbles over territory occur when flocks collide.
DescriptionEn: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.
DescriptionEs: Vive siempre en grandes grupos y las disputas dentro de ellos son muy intensas.

Name: Staraptor
Description: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.
DescriptionEn: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.
DescriptionEs: Sus alas y sus patas son muy fuertes. Puede llevarse volando Pokémon pequeños.

Name: Bidoof
Description: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.
DescriptionEn: A comparison revealed that Bidoof’s front teeth grow at the same rate as Rattata’s.
DescriptionEs: Tiene nervios de acero y nada puede perturbarlo. Es más ágil y activo de lo que aparenta.

Name: Bibarel
Description: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.
DescriptionEn: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.
DescriptionEs: Con sus incisivos roe ramas y raíces y las apila para construir sus madrigueras junto al río.

Name: Kricketot
Description: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.
DescriptionEn: It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone.
DescriptionEs: Hablan entre sí chocando las antenas. Los sonidos producidos son muy característicos.

Name: Kricketune
Description: It signals its emotions with its melodies. Scientists are studying these melodic patterns.
DescriptionEn: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.
DescriptionEs: Los científicos tratan de estudiar sus melodías, que son reflejo de sus emociones.

Name: Shinx
Description: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.
DescriptionEn: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.
DescriptionEs: La extensión y contracción de sus músculos genera electricidad. Brilla cuando está en peligro.

Name: Luxio
Description: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.
DescriptionEn: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.
DescriptionEs: Sus garras emiten electricidad que puede debilitar a sus rivales. Viven en grupos pequeños.

Name: Luxray
Description: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.
DescriptionEn: It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.
DescriptionEs: Cuando sus ojos brillan como el oro, puede ver presas escondidas, incluso detrás de un muro.

Name: Budew
Description: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.
DescriptionEn: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.
DescriptionEs: Vive cerca de aguas cristalinas. Su cabello se abre y esparce polen cuando le bañan los rayos del sol.

Name: Roserade
Description: With the movements of a dancer, it strikes with whips that are densely lined with poison thorns.
DescriptionEn: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.
DescriptionEs: Atrae a sus presas con una dulce fragancia y usa sus cepas venenosas para atenazarlas y acabar con ellas.

Name: Cranidos
Description: Its hard skull is its distinguishing feature. It snapped trees by headbutting them, and then it fed on their ripe berries.
DescriptionEn: It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its skull is as hard as iron.
DescriptionEs: Fue recreado a partir de un fósil con forma esférica. Derriba a las presas a cabezazos.

Name: Rampardos
Description: This ancient Pokémon used headbutts skillfully. Its brain was really small, so some theories suggest that its stupidity led to its extinction.
DescriptionEn: Its powerful head butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.
DescriptionEs: Tiene sesos pequeños porque su duro cráneo, que soporta cualquier golpe, les impide desarrollarse.

Name: Shieldon
Description: Although its fossils can be found in layers of primeval rock, nothing but its face has ever been discovered.
DescriptionEn: A Pokémon that lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its facial hide is extremely hard.
DescriptionEs: Se abrillanta la cara frotándola contra los árboles. Es vulnerable a los ataques por la espalda.

Name: Bastiodon
Description: This Pokémon is from roughly 100 million years ago. Its terrifyingly tough face is harder than steel.
DescriptionEn: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.
DescriptionEs: Se alineaban y creaban una barrera que ningún enemigo podía cruzar. Así protegían a sus crías.

Name: Burmy
Description: If its cloak is broken in battle, it quickly remakes the cloak with materials nearby.
DescriptionEn: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.
DescriptionEs: Para protegerse de los vientos fríos invernales, se cubre con un caparazón de ramas y hojas.

Name: WormadamPlant Cloak
Description: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.
DescriptionEn: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.
DescriptionEs: Su apariencia varía según dónde evolucione. Los materiales que haya pasan a formar parte de su cuerpo.

Name: Mothim
Description: It flutters around at night and steals honey from the Combee hive.
DescriptionEn: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by COMBEE.
DescriptionEs: Le encanta la miel de las flores y roba la que recoge Combee.

Name: Combee
Description: It collects and delivers honey to its colony. At night, they cluster to form a beehive and sleep.
DescriptionEn: A Pokémon formed by three others. It busily carries sweet floral honey to VESPIQUEN.
DescriptionEs: El trío se forma al nacer y se pasa la vida recogiendo miel de las flores para satisfacer a Vespiquen.

Name: Vespiquen
Description: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by Combee.
DescriptionEn: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by COMBEE.
DescriptionEs: Cría larvas en los panales de su cuerpo. Segrega diversas feromonas de su cuerpo con las cuales controla a sus crías.

Name: Pachirisu
Description: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.
DescriptionEn: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.
DescriptionEs: Crea bolas de pelo que crepitan con electricidad estática. Las almacena en agujeros de árboles.

Name: Buizel
Description: It inflates the flotation sac around its neck and pokes its head out of the water to see what is going on.
DescriptionEn: It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.
DescriptionEs: Nada rotando sus dos colas a modo de tornillo. Cuando bucea, el flotador se pliega.

Name: Floatzel
Description: Its flotation sac developed as a result of pursuing aquatic prey. It can double as a rubber raft.
DescriptionEn: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.
DescriptionEs: Nada gracias a su flotador. Ayuda en los rescates de gente que se está ahogando.

Name: Cherubi
Description: It evolves by sucking the energy out of the small ball where it had been storing nutrients.
DescriptionEn: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.
DescriptionEs: Bajo la luz solar es rojo. La esfera pequeña pierde sus nutrientes y se seca para anunciar la evolución.

Name: Cherrim
Description: If it senses strong sunlight, it opens its folded petals to absorb the sun's rays with its whole body.
DescriptionEn: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.
DescriptionEs: Cuando los rayos de sol inundan su capullo, abre de par en par sus pétalos y se vuelve muy dinámico.

Name: Shellos
Description: When it senses danger, a purple liquid oozes out of it. The liquid is thought to be something like greasy sweat.
DescriptionEn: Its colors and shapes differ from region to region. In the Sinnoh region, two types are confirmed.
DescriptionEs: No hay que apretarle muy fuerte, ya que, si lo haces, secreta un misterioso fluido morado.

Name: Gastrodon
Description: Their shape and color change, depending on their environment and diet. There are many of them at beaches where the waves are calm.
DescriptionEn: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.
DescriptionEs: Si se ve amenazado por sus enemigos naturales, segrega un líquido morado y huye rápidamente.

Name: Ambipom
Description: It uses its tails for everything. If it wraps both of its tails around you and gives you a squeeze, that's proof it really likes you.
DescriptionEn: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.
DescriptionEs: Habitan en grandes colonias y forman anillos uniendo sus colas, aparentemente en signo de amistad.

Name: Drifloon
Description: Wandering souls gathered together to form this Pokémon. When trying to make friends with children, Drifloon grabs them by the hand.
DescriptionEn: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.
DescriptionEs: Está formado por los espíritus de personas y Pokémon. Le encantan las estaciones húmedas.

Name: Drifblim
Description: The raw material for the gas inside its body is souls. When its body starts to deflate, it's thought to carry away people and Pokémon.
DescriptionEn: It’s drowzy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.
DescriptionEs: Transporta a gente y a Pokémon volando, pero, como se deja llevar, puede acabar en cualquier sitio.

Name: Buneary
Description: The reason it keeps one ear rolled up is so it can launch a swift counterattack if it's attacked by an enemy.
DescriptionEn: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.
DescriptionEs: Lleva las orejas enrolladas. Cuando las extiende, golpea con tal fuerza que incluso puede romper rocas.

Name: Lopunny
Description: It's notably wary and has a dislike of fighting, but at the same time, it can deliver powerful kicks with its lithe legs.
DescriptionEn: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.
DescriptionEs: Este Pokémon resulta muy precavido. Si siente peligro, escapa corriendo a grandes saltos.

Name: Mismagius
Description: Its muttered curses can cause awful headaches or terrifying visions that torment others.
DescriptionEn: Its cries sound like incantations. Those hearing it are tormented by headaches and hallucinations.
DescriptionEs: Recita cánticos. Algunos de ellos atormentan a sus rivales, mientras que otros producen felicidad.

Name: Honchkrow
Description: Its goons take care of most of the fighting for it. The only time it dirties its own hands is in delivering a final blow to finish off an opponent.
DescriptionEn: Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous MURKROW in tow.
DescriptionEs: Si uno lanza un grito profundo, los demás acuden. Por eso se le llama también Invocador de la Noche.

Name: Glameow
Description: When it's happy, Glameow demonstrates beautiful movements of its tail, like a dancing ribbon.
DescriptionEn: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.
DescriptionEs: Araña cuando está enfadado y ronronea cuando está cariñoso. Su imprevisibilidad es famosa.

Name: Purugly
Description: To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with its twin tails.
DescriptionEn: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon’s nest and claims it as its own.
DescriptionEs: Si se siente a gusto, no tiene ningún reparo en apropiarse de las moradas de otros Pokémon.

Name: Chingling
Description: There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops, the orb bounces all over and makes a ringing sound.
DescriptionEn: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.
DescriptionEs: Emite un tintineo cada vez que salta. Ensordece a sus rivales con sonidos de alta frecuencia.

Name: Stunky
Description: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.
DescriptionEn: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.
DescriptionEs: Expulsa un fluido maloliente por sus cuartos traseros. El hedor repele Pokémon en un radio de 2 km.

Name: Skuntank
Description: It sprays a stinky fluid from its tail. The fluid smells worse the longer it is allowed to fester.
DescriptionEn: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.
DescriptionEs: Para atacar, emite un fluido maloliente por la punta de su cola que puede llegar a más de 50 m.

Name: Bronzor
Description: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.
DescriptionEn: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.
DescriptionEs: Antaño se creía que en los dibujos de su parte posterior residía una fuerza misteriosa.

Name: Bronzong
Description: Ancient people believed that petitioning Bronzong for rain was the way to make crops grow.
DescriptionEn: One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.
DescriptionEs: Desde antaño se adora a este Pokémon para que propicie lluvias abundantes. A veces se esconde bajo tierra.

Name: Bonsly
Description: If its body gets too damp, it will die. So, in a process reminiscent of sweating, its eyes expel moisture.
DescriptionEn: It looks as if it is always crying. It is actually adjusting its body’s fluid levels by eliminating excess.
DescriptionEs: Prefiere entornos áridos. Sus ojos expulsan agua para ajustar los niveles de fluido corporal.

Name: Mime Jr.
Description: When this gifted mimic surprises an opponent, Mime Jr. feels so happy that it ends up forgetting it was imitating something.
DescriptionEn: In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy’s movements. Then it wastes no time in making itself scarce!
DescriptionEs: Desconcierta a sus rivales imitando sus movimientos a la perfección y aprovecha para darse a la fuga.

Name: Happiny
Description: When it sees something round and white, Happiny puts it into the pouch on its stomach. It sometimes becomes overloaded and can't move.
DescriptionEn: It loves round white things. It carries an egg-shaped rock in imitation of CHANSEY.
DescriptionEs: Les da a sus amigos una roca con forma de huevo que transporta en la bolsa de su panza.

Name: Chatot
Description: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.
DescriptionEn: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.
DescriptionEs: Imita los sonidos de sus rivales, haciéndoles creer que son amigos e impidiendo que le ataquen.

Name: Spiritomb
Description: It was bound to a fissure in an odd keystone as punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago.
DescriptionEn: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.
DescriptionEs: Se formó a partir de 108 espíritus. Está unido a la fisura de una piedra angular mística.

Name: Gible
Description: Its original home is an area much hotter than Alola. If you're planning to live with one, your heating bill will soar.
DescriptionEn: It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.
DescriptionEs: Vive en agujeros en las cuevas, al amparo del calor geotérmico. Si se acerca un enemigo, le muerde.

Name: Gabite
Description: It sheds its skin and gradually grows larger. Its scales can be ground into a powder and used as raw materials for traditional medicine.
DescriptionEn: There is a long-held belief that medicine made from its scales will heal even incurable illnesses.
DescriptionEs: Le gustan las cosas brillantes. Busca tesoros en cuevas y se lleva el botín a su nido.

Name: Garchomp
Description: Its fine scales don't just reduce wind resistance—their sharp edges also cause injury to any opponent who attacks it.
DescriptionEn: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.
DescriptionEs: Cuando despliega su cuerpo y sus alas, parece un avión a reacción. Vuela a velocidad sónica.

Name: Munchlax
Description: Anything that looks edible, Munchlax will go on and swallow whole. Its stomach is tough enough to handle it even if the food has gone rotten.
DescriptionEn: It wolfs down its weight in food once a day, swallowing food whole with almost no chewing.
DescriptionEs: Esconde comida bajo el largo pelo de su cuerpo, pero más tarde lo olvida.

Name: Riolu
Description: It uses waves called auras to communicate with others of its kind. It doesn't make any noise during this time, so its enemies can't detect it.
DescriptionEn: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.
DescriptionEs: Se comunica con los suyos mediante la emisión de unas ondas que cambian de forma en función de los sentimientos.

Name: Lucario
Description: Lucario reads its opponent's feelings with its aura waves. It finds out things it would rather not know, so it gets stressed out easily.
DescriptionEn: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.
DescriptionEs: Puede leer los pensamientos y movimientos de su adversario a través de su aura.

Name: Hippopotas
Description: It enshrouds itself with sand to protect itself from germs. It does not enjoy getting wet.
DescriptionEn: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.
DescriptionEs: Vive en zonas áridas. En lugar de sudar, su cuerpo expulsa granos de arena.

Name: Hippowdon
Description: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.
DescriptionEn: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.
DescriptionEs: Hace gala de su fuerza abriendo su enorme boca. Para atacar levanta gran cantidad de arena.

Name: Skorupi
Description: It burrows under the sand to lie in wait for prey. Its tail claws can inject its prey with a savage poison.
DescriptionEn: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.
DescriptionEs: Agarra a sus presas con las pinzas de la cola y les inyecta veneno. Espera hasta que hace efecto.

Name: Drapion
Description: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.
DescriptionEn: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.
DescriptionEs: Aunque sabe que puede aplastar al rival con su gran fuerza, le gusta dar el golpe de gracia con su virulento veneno.

Name: Croagunk
Description: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.
DescriptionEn: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.
DescriptionEs: Tiene bolsas venenosas en las mejillas. Pilla desprevenidos a sus rivales para pincharles.

Name: Toxicroak
Description: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.
DescriptionEn: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.
DescriptionEs: Almacena veneno en una bolsa de la garganta. Cuando croa, este se agita para lograr mayor potencia.

Name: Carnivine
Description: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.
DescriptionEn: It attracts prey with its sweet- smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.
DescriptionEs: Atrae a sus presas con saliva de olor dulce y las mastica. Tarda todo un día en comérselas.

Name: Finneon
Description: It lures in prey with its shining tail fins. It stays near the surface during the day and moves to the depths when night falls.
DescriptionEn: After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.
DescriptionEs: La línea que le recorre el costado puede almacenar luz solar. Brilla con mucha fuerza por la noche.

Name: Lumineon
Description: They traverse the deep waters as if crawling over the seafloor. The fantastic lights of its fins shine like stars in the night sky.
DescriptionEn: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.
DescriptionEs: Vive en las profundidades marinas. Atrae a sus presas con parpadeos del dibujo de sus cuatro aletas.

Name: Mantyke
Description: Mantyke are friendly toward people and will approach boats closely. The patterns on their backs differ depending on their habitat.
DescriptionEn: A friendly Pokémon that captures the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.
DescriptionEs: Los símbolos de su espalda cambian según la región. A veces se mezcla con bancos de Remoraid y nada junto a ellos.

Name: Snover
Description: In the spring, it grows berries with the texture of frozen treats around its belly.
DescriptionEn: It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.
DescriptionEs: En las estaciones frías baja al pie de la montaña, pero regresa a las cimas nevadas en primavera.

Name: Abomasnow
Description: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.
DescriptionEn: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.
DescriptionEs: Genera ventiscas con las que cubre de nieve grandes áreas. Se le llama el Monstruo de Hielo.

Name: Weavile
Description: Thanks to its increased intelligence, scrapping over food is a thing of the past. A scratch from its claws will give you a case of frostbite!
DescriptionEn: They communicate by clawing signs in boulders and work together to surround enemies.
DescriptionEs: Vive en zonas nevadas. Deja marcas en los árboles con sus garras para comunicarse con sus compañeros.

Name: Magnezone
Description: There are still people who believe that this Pokémon came from outer space. It emanates a powerful magnetic field.
DescriptionEn: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.
DescriptionEs: Emiten campos magnéticos tan potentes que se atraen entre sí e incluso pueden llegar a inmovilizarse.

Name: Lickilicky
Description: It uses its tongue much more skillfully than its hands or its feet. It can deftly pick up a single small bean with its tongue.
DescriptionEn: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.
DescriptionEs: Agarra cosas con su lengua extensible. Si te acercas mucho, te deja lleno de babas.

Name: Rhyperior
Description: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. Geodude are shot at rare times.
DescriptionEn: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. GEODUDE are shot at rare times.
DescriptionEs: Lanza Geodude por los agujeros de las manos. Gracias a Protector resiste erupciones volcánicas.

Name: Tangrowth
Description: Its vines grow so profusely that, in the warm season, you can't even see its eyes.
DescriptionEn: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.
DescriptionEs: Atrapa a su presa desplegando las ramas de sus brazos, que no le importa perder ante depredadores.

Name: Electivire
Description: A single Electivire can provide enough electricity for all the buildings in a big city for a year.
DescriptionEn: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.
DescriptionEs: Al almacenar mucha electricidad, desprende chispas de una claridad increíble entre sus dos cuernos.

Name: Magmortar
Description: Magmortar takes down its enemies by shooting fireballs, which burn them to a blackened crisp. It avoids this method when hunting prey.
DescriptionEn: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.
DescriptionEs: Sus brazos disparan bolas de fuego de más de 2000 °C. Vive en cráteres volcánicos.

Name: Togekiss
Description: It shares many blessings with people who respect one another's rights and avoid needless strife.
DescriptionEn: It will never appear where there is strife. Its sightings have become rare recently.
DescriptionEs: Se dice que aparece en zonas pacíficas y las bendice con sus dones.

Name: Yanmega
Description: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.
DescriptionEn: By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.
DescriptionEs: Su técnica favorita consiste en volar a gran velocidad y despedazar con su mandíbula a su oponente en un instante.

Name: Leafeon
Description: It gets its nutrition from photosynthesis. It lives a quiet life deep in forests where clean rivers flow.
DescriptionEn: Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.
DescriptionEs: En días soleados duerme y hace la fotosíntesis, emitiendo aire puro a su alrededor.

Name: Glaceon
Description: It can instantaneously freeze any moisture that's around it, creating ice pellets to shoot at its prey.
DescriptionEn: As a protective technique, it can completely freeze its fur to make its hairs stand like needles.
DescriptionEs: Controla su temperatura corporal para congelar el ambiente y causar ráfagas de nieve en polvo.

Name: Gliscor
Description: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey... Then its elongated fangs do the rest.
DescriptionEn: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!
DescriptionEs: Espera a sus presas colgado de una rama bocabajo. Cuando llega su oportunidad, se lanza en picado.

Name: Mamoswine
Description: Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The population thinned when it turned warm after the ice age.
DescriptionEn: Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The population thinned when it turned warm after the ice age.
DescriptionEs: Ya existía en la antigüedad. Se encontró uno bajo hielo de hace más de 10 000 años.

Name: Porygon-Z
Description: A faulty update was added to its programming. Its behavior is noticeably strange, so the experiment may have been a failure.
DescriptionEn: Additional software was installed to make it a better Pokémon. It began acting oddly, however.
DescriptionEs: Se le instaló un software para mejorarlo. Sin embargo, comenzó a comportarse de manera extraña.

Name: Gallade
Description: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.
DescriptionEn: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.
DescriptionEs: Puede presentir los movimientos de sus rivales y por eso ataca siempre antes que ellos.

Name: Probopass
Description: It uses three small units to catch prey and battle enemies. The main body mostly just gives orders.
DescriptionEn: It freely controls three units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.
DescriptionEs: Emana un fuerte magnetismo. Controla tres pequeñas unidades llamadas mininarices.

Name: Dusknoir
Description: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.
DescriptionEn: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.
DescriptionEs: Se dice que recoge en su cuerpo flexible a los espíritus extraviados y los guía hasta casa.

Name: Froslass
Description: It's said that on nights of terrible blizzards, it comes down to human settlements. If you hear it knocking at your door, do not open it!
DescriptionEn: It freezes foes with an icy breath nearly -60 degrees F. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.
DescriptionEs: Congela a sus enemigos con un aliento gélido de -50 °C. Su cuerpo está hueco.

Name: Rotom
Description: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.
DescriptionEn: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.
DescriptionEs: Desde hace mucho tiempo se estudia su singular motor como fuente de energía motriz.

Name: Uxie
Description: It is said that its emergence gave humans the intelligence to improve their quality of life.
DescriptionEn: Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.
DescriptionEs: Se le conoce como el Ser de la Sabiduría. Se dice que puede borrar la memoria con una mirada.

Name: Mesprit
Description: It sleeps at the bottom of a lake. Its spirit is said to leave its body to fly on the lake's surface.
DescriptionEn: Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.
DescriptionEs: Se le conoce como el Ser de la Emoción. Enseñó a los humanos la nobleza del dolor y la alegría.

Name: Azelf
Description: It is thought that Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf all came from the same egg.
DescriptionEn: It is thought that Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf all came from the same egg.
DescriptionEs: Se le conoce como el Ser de la Voluntad. Duerme en el fondo de un lago para equilibrar el mundo.

Name: Dialga
Description: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.
DescriptionEn: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.
DescriptionEs: Un Pokémon de leyenda. Se dice que el tiempo comenzó a avanzar cuando Dialga nació.

Name: Palkia
Description: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.
DescriptionEn: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.
DescriptionEs: Se dice que vive en una dimensión espacial paralela. Aparece en la mitología.

Name: Heatran
Description: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.
DescriptionEn: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.
DescriptionEs: Habita cuevas volcánicas. Cava con sus pies en forma de cruz para trepar por techos y paredes.

Name: Regigigas
Description: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.
DescriptionEn: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.
DescriptionEs: Se dice que usó rocas, magma y un hielo especial de montaña para crear Pokémon con su aspecto.

Name: GiratinaAltered Forme
Description: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.
DescriptionEn: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.
DescriptionEs: Vive en el Mundo Distorsión, un mundo opuesto al nuestro y cuyas leyes desafían el sentido común.

Name: Cresselia
Description: Those who sleep holding Cresselia's feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.
DescriptionEn: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.
DescriptionEs: Sus alas emiten un velo de partículas brillantes. Se dice que representa un cuarto lunar.

Name: Phione
Description: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.
DescriptionEn: A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates the flotation sac on its head to drift and search for food.
DescriptionEs: Si sube la temperatura del mar, infla el flotador de su cabeza y flota en grupo en la superficie.

Name: Manaphy
Description: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.
DescriptionEn: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.
DescriptionEs: Posee un poder singular que hace que entable amistad con casi cualquier Pokémon.

Name: Darkrai
Description: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.
DescriptionEn: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.
DescriptionEs: Defiende su territorio de personas y Pokémon haciéndoles dormir y provocándoles pesadillas.

Name: ShayminLand Forme
Description: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.
DescriptionEn: It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.
DescriptionEs: Puede disolver las toxinas del aire para transformar tierra yerma en campos de flores.

Name: Arceus
Description: It is told in mythology that this Pokémon was born before the universe even existed.
DescriptionEn: It is said to have emerged from an egg in a place where there was nothing, then shaped the world.
DescriptionEs: Según la mitología de Sinnoh, Arceus surgió de un huevo y después creó todo el mundo.

Name: Victini
Description: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.
DescriptionEn: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.
DescriptionEs: Pokémon que atrae la victoria. Dicen que el Entrenador que lo lleve saldrá vencedor de cualquier batalla.

Name: Snivy
Description: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.
DescriptionEn: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.
DescriptionEs: Cuando recibe los rayos de sol, se mueve mucho más rápido que de costumbre. Usa mejor sus lianas que sus manos.

Name: Servine
Description: When it gets dirty, its leaves can't be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.
DescriptionEn: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.
DescriptionEs: Parece que se desliza al correr. Engaña a sus rivales con su velocidad y los fustiga con su látigo.

Name: Serperior
Description: It can stop its opponents' movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.
DescriptionEn: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.
DescriptionEs: Tan solo muestra su verdadero poder a quienes no se amedrentan ante su noble pero inquisitoria mirada.

Name: Tepig
Description: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.
DescriptionEn: It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.
DescriptionEs: Evita con agilidad los ataques enemigos. Lanza bolas de fuego por su hocico y tuesta bayas del bosque para comer.

Name: Pignite
Description: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.
DescriptionEn: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.
DescriptionEs: Cuanto más come, más combustible tiene en su interior para avivar sus llamas, con lo que también aumenta su poder.

Name: Emboar
Description: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.
DescriptionEn: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.
DescriptionEs: Calienta sus puños con las llamas de su barbilla para propinar puñetazos ardientes. Es muy fiel a sus compañeros.

Name: Oshawott
Description: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.
DescriptionEn: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.
DescriptionEs: La vieira de su ombligo no solo sirve como arma, sino también como instrumento para cortar las bayas que estén duras.

Name: Dewott
Description: As a result of strict training, each Dewott learns different forms for using the scalchops.
DescriptionEn: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.
DescriptionEs: Gran espadachín. Utiliza sus dos vieiras con soltura al ejecutar las técnicas que aprende con una disciplina espartana.

Name: Samurott
Description: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.
DescriptionEn: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.
DescriptionEs: En un abrir y cerrar de ojos, puede desenvainar y envainar los sables que hay en sus patas delanteras.

Name: Patrat
Description: Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won't notice a foe coming from behind.
DescriptionEn: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.
DescriptionEs: Almacena víveres en unas bolsas en sus mofletes y vigila durante días. Hace señales con la cola a sus compañeros.

Name: Watchog
Description: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.
DescriptionEn: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.
DescriptionEs: Los componentes luminiscentes de su interior hacen que sus ojos y su cuerpo brillen, y así intimida a sus rivales.

Name: Lillipup
Description: This Pokémon is popular with beginners because it's intelligent, obedient to its Trainer's commands, and easy to raise.
DescriptionEn: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.
DescriptionEs: Los mechones que cubren su cara actúan como un magnífico radar para detectar con precisión lo que hay a su alrededor.

Name: Herdier
Description: It has been living with people for so long that portrayals of it can be found on the walls of caves from long, long ago.
DescriptionEn: It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.
DescriptionEs: Este Pokémon es muy leal. No solo ayuda a Entrenadores, sino que también se preocupa por otros Pokémon.

Name: Stoutland
Description: Its fur is long and thick. A long time ago in cold regions, every household kept a Stoutland.
DescriptionEn: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.
DescriptionEs: Socorre a humanos perdidos en montañas azotadas por ventiscas. Su largo pelaje le protege del frío.

Name: Purrloin
Description: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can't help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.
DescriptionEn: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can’t help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.
DescriptionEs: Distrae a su oponente con movimientos gráciles y sustrae sus pertenencias. Cuando se enfada, ataca con las garras.

Name: Liepard
Description: Stealthily, it sneaks up on its target, striking from behind before its victim has a chance to react.
DescriptionEn: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.
DescriptionEs: Su bella y grácil silueta le viene dada por su desarrollada musculatura, que le permite andar de noche sin hacer ruido.

Name: Pansage
Description: It's good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It's kind enough to share them with friends.
DescriptionEn: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.
DescriptionEs: Comparte las hojas de su cabeza con Pokémon agotados. Posee la facultad de aliviar el cansancio.

Name: Simisage
Description: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.
DescriptionEn: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.
DescriptionEs: Ataca estampando las espinas de su cola en el enemigo. Es un Pokémon con mucho temperamento.

Name: Pansear
Description: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.
DescriptionEn: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.
DescriptionEs: Pokémon muy inteligente que tiene la costumbre de tostar las bayas antes de comérselas. Ayuda mucho a los humanos.

Name: Simisear
Description: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.
DescriptionEn: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.
DescriptionEs: Achicharra a sus enemigos desprendiendo llamas por la cola y la cabeza, fruto de su desmesurado calor interno.

Name: Panpour
Description: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.
DescriptionEn: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.
DescriptionEs: El agua acumulada en su mata de pelo es rica en nutrientes. Usa su cola para regar plantas con esa misma agua.

Name: Simipour
Description: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.
DescriptionEn: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.
DescriptionEs: Cuando lanza agua a alta presión con su cola, puede incluso resquebrajar una pared de cemento.

Name: Munna
Description: It eats the dreams of people and Pokémon. When it eats a pleasant dream, it expels pink-colored mist.
DescriptionEn: Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.
DescriptionEs: Cuando un humano o un Pokémon sufre una pesadilla, Munna se aparece ante ellos y la engulle.

Name: Musharna
Description: The dream mist coming from its forehead changes into many different colors depending on the dream that was eaten.
DescriptionEn: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.
DescriptionEs: Multitud de sueños de humanos y Pokémon se encuentran atrapados en el humo que despide por su frente.

Name: Pidove
Description: These Pokémon live in cities. They are accustomed to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.
DescriptionEn: Each follows its Trainer’s orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.
DescriptionEs: Es un Pokémon muy despistado. Aunque reciba órdenes de su Entrenador, se le olvidan, y se queda esperando.

Name: Tranquill
Description: No matter where in the world it goes, it knows where its nest is, so it never gets separated from its Trainer.
DescriptionEn: It can return to its Trainer’s location regardless of the distance separating them.
DescriptionEs: Según los rumores, en lo más profundo del bosque donde mora Tranquill, hay un mundo pacífico y exento de luchas.

Name: Unfezant
Description: Males have plumage on their heads. They will never let themselves feel close to anyone other than their Trainers.
DescriptionEn: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females’ flying abilities surpass those of the males.
DescriptionEs: El macho amenaza al enemigo meciendo el adorno de su cabeza. Al volar, la hembra es mucho más diestra que el macho.

Name: Blitzle
Description: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.
DescriptionEn: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.
DescriptionEs: Aparece cuando nubes envueltas en rayos encapotan el cielo. Atrapa rayos con su crin y almacena electricidad.

Name: Zebstrika
Description: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.
DescriptionEn: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.
DescriptionEs: Es un Pokémon con mucho temperamento. Cuando se enoja, lanza rayos desde su crin en todas direcciones.

Name: Roggenrola
Description: It was found in a fissure in a layer of exposed rock. The material that makes up its body is dirt from several hundred years ago.
DescriptionEn: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.
DescriptionEs: Su oreja tiene forma hexagonal. Su cuerpo fue comprimido bajo tierra. Por eso, es duro como el acero.

Name: Boldore
Description: Its orange crystals are lumps of powerful energy. They're valuable, so Boldore is sometimes targeted for them.
DescriptionEn: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.
DescriptionEs: La energía que no puede contener en el interior de su cuerpo se escapa formando cristales naranjas.

Name: Gigalith
Description: It absorbs rays of sunlight and shoots out energy. It's usually lurking deep beneath the surface.
DescriptionEn: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.
DescriptionEs: Absorbe los rayos solares, procesa esa energía en su núcleo y lanza poderosas bolas de luz a sus enemigos.

Name: Woobat
Description: The heart-shaped mark left on a body after a Woobat has been attached to it is said to bring good fortune.
DescriptionEn: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.
DescriptionEs: Vive en bosques oscuros y cavernas. Emite ultrasonidos por la nariz para saber todo lo que pasa a su alrededor.

Name: Swoobat
Description: Anyone who comes into contact with the ultrasonic waves emitted by a courting male experiences a positive mood shift.
DescriptionEn: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.
DescriptionEs: Cuando emite ondas ultrasónicas, que incluso pueden reventar el cemento, agita su cola con vehemencia.

Name: Drilbur
Description: By spinning its body, it can dig straight through the ground at a speed of 30 mph.
DescriptionEn: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.
DescriptionEs: Cuando junta las garras y comienza a dar vueltas frenéticas, avanza bajo tierra a gran velocidad.

Name: Excadrill
Description: More than 300 feet below the surface, they build mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to subway tunnels.
DescriptionEn: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.
DescriptionEs: Su taladro ha evolucionado y es capaz de atravesar una lámina de hierro. Es muy útil para construir túneles.

Name: Audino
Description: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.
DescriptionEn: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.
DescriptionEs: Con las antenas de sus oídos, perciben el estado de un rival o predicen cuándo va a eclosionar un Huevo Pokémon.

Name: Timburr
Description: Always carrying squared logs, they help out with construction. As they grow, they carry bigger logs.
DescriptionEn: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.
DescriptionEs: Siempre lleva vigas de madera. Normalmente ayuda en obras de construcción.

Name: Gurdurr
Description: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.
DescriptionEn: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.
DescriptionEs: Gracias a su entrenada musculatura, puede blandir vigas de acero sin problema para así derribar edificios enteros.

Name: Conkeldurr
Description: Rather than rely on force, they master moves that utilize the centrifugal force of spinning concrete.
DescriptionEn: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.
DescriptionEs: Se cree que Conkeldurr enseñó a los humanos la técnica para elaborar cemento hace más de 2000 años.

Name: Tympole
Description: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.
DescriptionEn: They warn others of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.
DescriptionEs: Emite sonidos imperceptibles para los humanos con la vibración de sus mejillas y advierte de algún peligro a los suyos.

Name: Palpitoad
Description: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to immobilize its opponents.
DescriptionEn: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.
DescriptionEs: Cuando hace vibrar el bulto de su cabeza, no solo se embravece el mar, sino que la tierra también tiembla.

Name: Seismitoad
Description: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.
DescriptionEn: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.
DescriptionEs: Aumenta la potencia de sus puñetazos haciendo vibrar sus puños. Es capaz de quebrar una roca de un solo golpe.

Name: Throh
Description: When it encounters a foe bigger than itself, it wants to throw it. It changes belts as it gets stronger.
DescriptionEn: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.
DescriptionEs: Aumenta su potencia si se aprieta el cinturón. Un Throh salvaje teje su propio cinturón usando lianas.

Name: Sawk
Description: Tying their belts gets them pumped and makes their punches more destructive. Disturbing their training angers them.
DescriptionEn: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.
DescriptionEs: Para lograr dominar las técnicas de kárate más letales, se retiran a las montañas y entrenan día y noche.

Name: Sewaddle
Description: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.
DescriptionEn: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.
DescriptionEs: Recorta hojas y las teje con el líquido viscoso que segrega por la boca para hacerse su propia ropa.

Name: Swadloon
Description: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.
DescriptionEn: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.
DescriptionEs: La vegetación abunda en los bosques que habita. Este Pokémon transforma las hojas caídas en nutrientes.

Name: Leavanny
Description: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.
DescriptionEn: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.
DescriptionEs: Si se encuentra con un Pokémon joven, segrega por la boca hilos pegadizos con los que le teje una prenda de ropa.

Name: Venipede
Description: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.
DescriptionEn: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.
DescriptionEs: Percibe su entorno con su sentido del tacto, residente en su cabeza y cola. Su carácter es violento por naturaleza.

Name: Whirlipede
Description: It is usually motionless, but when attacked, it rotates at high speed and then crashes into its opponent.
DescriptionEn: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.
DescriptionEs: Lo protege un duro caparazón. Gira como una rueda y realiza brutales placajes contra sus enemigos.

Name: Scolipede
Description: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.
DescriptionEn: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.
DescriptionEs: Atenaza a sus presas con las garras que sobresalen de su cuello hasta que no se pueden mover y las remata con veneno.

Name: Cottonee
Description: When attacked, it expels cotton from its body to create a diversion. The cotton it loses grows back in quickly.
DescriptionEn: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.
DescriptionEs: Despide motas de algodón cuando lo atacan para confundir a los enemigos y poner pies en polvorosa.

Name: Whimsicott
Description: Whimsicott doesn't live in a fixed location. It floats around on whirling winds, appearing all over the place to perform its mischief.
DescriptionEn: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.
DescriptionEs: Aparecen en medio de un torbellino y entran en las casas para descolocar los muebles o esparcir algodón por doquier.

Name: Petilil
Description: They prefer clean water and soil. When the environment they live in turns bad, the whole bunch will up and move to a new area.
DescriptionEn: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.
DescriptionEs: Mordisquear las hojas de su cabeza permite recuperar toda la vitalidad, a pesar de que están muy amargas.

Name: Lilligant
Description: It's well liked by other Pokémon because of its beauty. The flower on its head needs constant care, or it will soon wither and rot.
DescriptionEn: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.
DescriptionEs: El aroma de la flor de su tocado relaja a cualquiera a su alrededor. Hay que cuidarle mucho para que no se marchite.

Name: Basculin
Description: When a school of Basculin appears in a lake, everything else disappears, except for Corphish and Crawdaunt. That's how violent Basculin are.
DescriptionEn: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they’ll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.
DescriptionEs: Los de color azul y los de color rojo siempre se pelean. Son muy violentos, pero su sabor es excepcional.

Name: Sandile
Description: Sandile's still not good at hunting, so it mostly eats things that have collapsed in the desert. It's called “the cleaner of the desert."
DescriptionEn: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.
DescriptionEs: Se desplaza hundido en la arena, dejando al descubierto solo los ojos y la nariz. Una membrana negra le protege los ojos.

Name: Krokorok
Description: It buries some of its prey in the sand to use as emergency meals when its hunts are unsuccessful.
DescriptionEn: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.
DescriptionEs: Viven en manadas. La membrana que cubre sus ojos los protege de la arena.

Name: Krookodile
Description: It conceals itself in sandstorms that Flygon whip up and waits patiently for prey to appear.
DescriptionEn: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.
DescriptionEs: Un Pokémon bastante violento. Ataca todo lo que se mueva delante de él con sus mortíferas mandíbulas.

Name: Darumaka
Description: When it sleeps, it pulls its limbs into its body and its internal fire goes down to 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit.
DescriptionEn: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.
DescriptionEs: Como sus excrementos están muy calientes, la gente de antaño se los metía en los bolsillos para calentarse.

Name: DarmanitanStandard Mode
Description: Its internal fire burns at 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.
DescriptionEn: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.
DescriptionEs: Cuando resulta gravemente herido, se endurece como una piedra y medita para agudizar la mente.

Name: Maractus
Description: Arid regions are their habitat. They move rhythmically, making a sound similar to maracas.
DescriptionEn: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.
DescriptionEs: Espanta a los Pokémon pájaro con un baile rápido y haciendo ruido para evitar que picoteen las semillas de sus flores.

Name: Dwebble
Description: When it finds a stone of a suitable size, it secretes a liquid from its mouth to open up a hole to crawl into.
DescriptionEn: This Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.
DescriptionEs: Abre un agujero en la roca y vive en él. Si la roca se resquebraja, no se queda tranquilo hasta que no encuentra otra.

Name: Crustle
Description: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.
DescriptionEn: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.
DescriptionEs: Su inmensa capacidad motriz le permite desplazarse cargando a sus espaldas rocas enormes durante días.

Name: Scraggy
Description: It stretches its saggy skin up to its neck to protect itself. The saggier their skin, the more respect they garner.
DescriptionEn: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.
DescriptionEs: Se sube la piel hasta el cuello para defenderse. Su elasticidad, similar a la de una goma, reduce el daño recibido.

Name: Scrafty
