Description: It taunts its opponents by spitting. It has a certain territory that it never leaves its whole life long.
DescriptionEn: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.
DescriptionEs: Se protege de los ataques con la muda de su piel mientras reparte patadas. Cuanto mayor es su cresta, más se le respeta.

Name: Sigilyph
Description: The guardians of an ancient city, they always fly the same route while keeping watch for invaders.
DescriptionEn: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.
DescriptionEs: Fue la deidad protectora de una ciudad milenaria. Ataca con su poder psíquico a los enemigos que invaden su territorio.

Name: Yamask
Description: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.
DescriptionEn: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.
DescriptionEs: Almas de humanos sepultados en tumbas que han adquirido forma de Pokémon. Recuerdan su vida antes de la muerte.

Name: Cofagrigus
Description: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies.
DescriptionEn: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.
DescriptionEs: Se comenta que engulle a todo humano que se le acerca y lo momifica. Su comida favorita son las pepitas de oro.

Name: Tirtouga
Description: Its hunting grounds encompassed a broad area, from the land to more than half a mile deep in the ocean.
DescriptionEn: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.
DescriptionEs: Ya pululaba por las aguas hace 100 millones de años. También va a tierra a veces en busca de alimento.

Name: Carracosta
Description: Carracosta eats every last bit of the prey it catches, even the shells and bones, to further strengthen its sturdy shell.
DescriptionEn: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.
DescriptionEs: Vive en el mar y en la superficie. Sus garras pueden abrir un agujero en el fondo de un petrolero.

Name: Archen
Description: Restored from a fossil, this ancient bird Pokémon has wings but can't yet fly.
DescriptionEn: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.
DescriptionEs: Pokémon que renació de un fósil. Dicen que es el antepasado de todos los Pokémon pájaro.

Name: Archeops
Description: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, the muscles it uses to flap its wings are still weak, so it needs a long runway in order to take off.
DescriptionEn: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.
DescriptionEs: Levanta el vuelo tras coger carrerilla. Coopera con sus compañeros de bandada para atrapar a sus presas.

Name: Trubbish
Description: If a young Pokémon or child breathes in the toxic gas that Trubbish belches out, it could be a life-threatening situation.
DescriptionEn: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.
DescriptionEs: Pokémon nacido de la reacción química entre una bolsa de basura y residuos industriales.

Name: Garbodor
Description: Some say the reason Garbodor in Alola are a little stronger than their counterparts elsewhere is the presence of Muk, their natural enemy.
DescriptionEn: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.
DescriptionEs: Apresa a su rival con el brazo izquierdo y le da el golpe de gracia exhalando por la boca un apestoso gas venenoso.

Name: Zorua
Description: If a normally talkative child suddenly stops talking, it may have been replaced by Zorua.
DescriptionEn: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.
DescriptionEs: Adopta la apariencia de su enemigo para engañarlo vilmente y aprovecha su estupor para poner tierra por medio.

Name: Zoroark
Description: If it thinks humans are going to discover its den, Zoroark shows them visions that make them wander around in the woods.
DescriptionEn: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.
DescriptionEs: Tiene la facultad de confundir a muchos humanos a la vez. Protege su guarida creando un paisaje ilusorio.

Name: Minccino
Description: When its tail has gotten dirty from self-cleaning or from cleaning its nest, Minccino spends a whole day washing its tail in clean spring water.
DescriptionEn: They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.
DescriptionEs: Se saludan entre sí frotándose con la cola y limpiándose a conciencia.

Name: Cinccino
Description: The oil that seeps from its body is really smooth. For people troubled by bad skin, this oil is an effective treatment.
DescriptionEn: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.
DescriptionEs: El pelo que cubre su cuerpo proporciona una agradable sensación al tocarlo. No acumula ni polvo ni electricidad estática.

Name: Gothita
Description: They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, they are looking at something that only Gothita can see.
DescriptionEn: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.
DescriptionEs: Amplifica su poder psíquico con sus antenitas en forma de lazo. Siempre está mirando algo fijamente.

Name: Gothorita
Description: According to many old tales, it creates friends for itself by controlling sleeping children on starry nights.
DescriptionEn: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.
DescriptionEs: La luz de las estrellas origina su poder. De noche, marca su posición haciendo levitar piedras con su poder psíquico.

Name: Gothitelle
Description: They can predict the future from the placement and movement of the stars. They can see Trainers' life spans.
DescriptionEn: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.
DescriptionEs: Su inmenso poder psíquico distorsiona el espacio y le permite reflejar incluso estrellas a años luz de distancia.

Name: Solosis
Description: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.
DescriptionEn: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.
DescriptionEs: Gracias a la sustancia viscosa que envuelve su cuerpo, permanece tranquilo por dura o rigurosa que sea la situación.

Name: Duosion
Description: When their two divided brains think the same thoughts, their psychic power is maximized.
DescriptionEn: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.
DescriptionEs: Dado que su cerebro está dividido en dos, a veces tiene conflictos a la hora de decidir qué hacer.

Name: Reuniclus
Description: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.
DescriptionEn: They use psychic power to control their arms, which are made of a special liquid. They can crush boulders psychically.
DescriptionEs: Hacen gala de su poder psíquico y mueven sus brazos compuestos de líquido para controlar rocas y hacerlas añicos.

Name: Ducklett
Description: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.
DescriptionEn: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food--peat moss.
DescriptionEs: Cuando se ve atacado, las plumas que lo recubren despiden ráfagas de agua que lo ayudan a escapar.

Name: Swanna
Description: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.
DescriptionEn: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.
DescriptionEs: Aunque no lo parezca por su grácil elegancia, puede batir con fuerza las alas y volar durante miles de kilómetros.

Name: Vanillite
Description: When the morning sun hit an icicle, it wished not to melt, and thus Vanillite was born. At night, it buries itself in snow to sleep.
DescriptionEn: The temperature of their breath is -58° F. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.
DescriptionEs: Lanza un aliento de -50 °C. Crea bloques de nieve y es capaz de lograr que nieve a su alrededor.

Name: Vanillish
Description: This hearty Pokémon survived the Ice Age. It's incredibly popular in very hot regions.
DescriptionEn: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon’s habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.
DescriptionEs: Enfrían el aire a su alrededor y crean partículas de hielo mediante las cuales congelan a sus oponentes.

Name: Vanilluxe
Description: Vanilluxe is born when two Vanillish, half-melted by the day's light, stick to each other and freeze together in the cold return of night.
DescriptionEn: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and attack their foes with violent blizzards.
DescriptionEs: Si sus dos cabezas se irritan al mismo tiempo, genera una ventisca desde su cuerno cubriendo su entorno con nieve.

Name: Deerling
Description: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon's fur. People use it to mark the seasons.
DescriptionEn: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.
DescriptionEs: El color de su cuerpo cambia no solo con las estaciones, sino también con los cambios de humedad y temperatura.

Name: Sawsbuck
Description: They migrate according to the seasons, so some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers of spring.
DescriptionEn: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck’s horns.
DescriptionEs: Cambia de morada dependiendo de las estaciones. Observando sus cuernos, la gente sabe cuándo estas van a cambiar.

Name: Emolga
Description: As it flies, it scatters electricity around, so bird Pokémon keep their distance. That's why Emolga can keep all its food to itself.
DescriptionEn: The energy made in its cheeks’ electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.
DescriptionEs: Vive en la copa de los árboles. Produce descargas mientras vuela con el interior de la membrana que hace de capa.

Name: Karrablast
Description: For some reason they evolve when they receive electrical energy while they are attacking Shelmet.
DescriptionEn: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.
DescriptionEs: Si recibe un estímulo eléctrico al estar en contacto con un Shelmet, evoluciona.

Name: Escavalier
Description: These Pokémon evolve by wearing the shell covering of a Shelmet. The steel armor protects their whole body.
DescriptionEn: They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears. Even when in trouble, they face opponents bravely.
DescriptionEs: Se defienden de los ataques con el caparazón que roban a los Shelmet. Atacan con sus dos mortíferas lanzas.

Name: Foongus
Description: It lures Pokémon with its pattern that looks just like a Poké Ball, then releases poison spores.
DescriptionEn: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.
DescriptionEs: Gracias a su misterioso parecido a una Poké Ball, atrae a sus presas y lanza rápidamente esporas de veneno.

Name: Amoonguss
Description: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.
DescriptionEn: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.
DescriptionEs: Aunque intenta pasar por parte superior de una Poké Ball para atraer a sus presas, consigue engañar a pocos.

Name: Frillish
Description: Using the invisible poison spikes on its veillike arms and legs, it paralyzes its enemies and causes them to drown.
DescriptionEn: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.
DescriptionEs: Paraliza a sus presas con veneno y las lleva a su morada, que se encuentra a 8000 m en el fondo del mar.

Name: Jellicent
Description: Fishermen are terrified of Jellicent. It's rumored to drag them into the sea and steal their lives away.
DescriptionEn: The fate of the ships and crew that wander into Jellicent’s habitat: all sunken, all lost, all vanished.
DescriptionEs: Su cuerpo se compone de agua salada. Dicen que ha construido un palacio en el fondo del mar con restos de barcos.

Name: Alomomola
Description: The reason it helps Pokémon in a weakened condition is that any Pokémon coming after them may also attack Alomomola.
DescriptionEn: The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.
DescriptionEs: Vive flotando a la deriva en mar abierto. Siempre que encuentra un Pokémon herido, lo abraza y lo lleva a la costa.

Name: Joltik
Description: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.
DescriptionEn: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.
DescriptionEs: No puede generar electricidad por sí mismo, así que se encarama a Pokémon grandes y absorbe su energía estática.

Name: Galvantula
Description: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.
DescriptionEn: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.
DescriptionEs: Pone trampas con hilos electrificados. De este modo, electrocuta a sus enemigos y los inmoviliza por completo.

Name: Ferroseed
Description: It absorbs the iron it finds in the rock while clinging to the ceiling. It shoots spikes when in danger.
DescriptionEn: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.
DescriptionEs: Lanza numerosas púas al detectar peligro. En cuanto tiene ocasión, echa a rodar y se escapa.

Name: Ferrothorn
Description: They attach themselves to cave ceilings, firing steel spikes at targets passing beneath them.
DescriptionEn: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.
DescriptionEs: Azota al enemigo con sus tres tentáculos y después dispara púas hasta que no deja ni rastro del rival.

Name: Klink
Description: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.
DescriptionEn: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.
DescriptionEs: Genera la energía vital que necesita haciendo girar sus dos cuerpos.

Name: Klang
Description: A minigear and big gear comprise its body. If the minigear it launches at a foe doesn't return, it will die.
DescriptionEn: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.
DescriptionEs: Muestra sus sentimientos cambiando la dirección de su giro. Cuanto más se enfade, más rápido girará.

Name: Klinklang
Description: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.
DescriptionEn: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.
DescriptionEs: Recarga su energía rápidamente haciendo girar con gran celeridad el engranaje equipado con un núcleo rojo.

Name: Tynamo
Description: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.
DescriptionEn: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.
DescriptionEs: La electricidad de uno solo es diminuta, pero, si multitud de Tynamo se conectan, consiguen la potencia de un rayo.

Name: Eelektrik
Description: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.
DescriptionEn: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.
DescriptionEs: Se enrolla alrededor de su presa, la paraliza con la electricidad de sus marcas circulares y le asesta mordiscos.

Name: Eelektross
Description: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.
DescriptionEn: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.
DescriptionEs: Pega la ventosa de su boca en su presa y la electrocuta con sus colmillos.

Name: Elgyem
Description: This Pokémon is shrouded in mystery. It's said to have appeared from a UFO that fell from the sky about 50 years ago.
DescriptionEn: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent’s brain, causing unendurable headaches.
DescriptionEs: Posee un gran poder psíquico. Lo usa para comprimir el cerebro del enemigo y ocasionarle dolores de cabeza.

Name: Beheeyem
Description: It has strong psychic powers. Using its fingers that flash three different colors, it controls its opponents and rewrites their memories.
DescriptionEn: It can manipulate an opponent’s memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three different-colored fingers.
DescriptionEs: Parece que se comunica haciendo brillar sus dedos tricolores, pero nadie ha conseguido descifrar aún su patrón.

Name: Litwick
Description: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.
DescriptionEn: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.
DescriptionEs: Finge ser una luz guía en el camino, pero en realidad solo quiere absorber la energía vital de quien lo sigue.

Name: Lampent
Description: It arrives near the moment of death and steals spirit from the body.
DescriptionEn: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.
DescriptionEs: Al absorber almas, su llama se enciende. Espera a que la gente fallezca, así que suele deambular por los hospitales.

Name: Chandelure
Description: The spirits burned up in its ominous flame lose their way and wander this world forever.
DescriptionEn: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.
DescriptionEs: Sus llamas absorben el alma del enemigo y la abrasan, dejando solo su cuerpo inerte.

Name: Axew
Description: They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. If a tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly.
DescriptionEn: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.
DescriptionEs: Usa sus colmillos para romper las bayas que come. Estos se regeneran una y otra vez, por eso son tan fuertes y afilados.

Name: Fraxure
Description: A broken tusk will not grow back, so it diligently sharpens its tusks on river rocks after the end of a battle.
DescriptionEn: Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they’ve been fighting.
DescriptionEs: Sus colmillos pueden hacer añicos rocas inmensas. Las luchas territoriales de los Fraxure son encarnizadas.

Name: Haxorus
Description: Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams. These Pokémon are covered in hard armor.
DescriptionEn: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.
DescriptionEs: Es gentil, pero no perdona a todo el que ose invadir su territorio. Su mayor baza son sus colmillos, que cortan el acero.

Name: Cubchoo
Description: Their snot is a barometer of health. When healthy, their snot is sticky and the power of their ice moves increases.
DescriptionEn: When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.
DescriptionEs: Siempre está con mucosidades colgando. Las aspira para hacer un movimiento, ya que son su materia prima para esto.

Name: Beartic
Description: It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice to fight with. Cold northern areas are its habitat.
DescriptionEn: It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.
DescriptionEs: Adoran los mares gélidos del norte. Congelan su aliento para crear sendas por las que caminar sobre las aguas.

Name: Cryogonal
Description: They are composed of ice crystals. They capture prey with chains of ice, freezing the prey at -148 degrees Fahrenheit.
DescriptionEn: When its body temperature goes up, it turns into steam and vanishes. When its temperature lowers, it returns to ice.
DescriptionEs: Nació entre nubes de nieve. Atrapa a sus presas con una cadena hecha de hielo cristalizado.

Name: Shelmet
Description: It evolves when bathed in an electric-like energy along with Karrablast. The reason is still unknown.
DescriptionEn: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It can spit a sticky, poisonous liquid.
DescriptionEs: Si está junto a Karrablast, y ambos reciben una descarga eléctrica, evolucionan los dos a la vez.

Name: Accelgor
Description: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.
DescriptionEn: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.
DescriptionEs: Se siente ligero una vez liberado de su caparazón. Lucha y se mueve como un ninja.

Name: Stunfisk
Description: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity.
DescriptionEn: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.
DescriptionEs: Ni un pisotón de un luchador de sumo lo aplastaría gracias a su piel sólida. Sonríe al soltar descargas eléctricas.

Name: Mienfoo
Description: They seclude themselves in the mountains and devote themselves to training. The form of their kicks and chops differs from pack to pack.
DescriptionEn: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.
DescriptionEs: La velocidad de sus ataques es su gran orgullo. Lo que le falta de fuerza bruta lo compensa en cantidad de golpes.

Name: Mienshao
Description: When Mienshao lets out a bizarre wail, you're in danger. A flurry of kicks and chops too fast to see is about to be unleashed!
DescriptionEn: It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.
DescriptionEs: Usa el pelaje de sus brazos a manera de látigos. Sus ataques alcanzan velocidades de vértigo.

Name: Druddigon
Description: It infiltrates tunnels that Pokémon like Diglett and Dugtrio have dug and quietly waits for prey to pass through.
DescriptionEn: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.
DescriptionEs: Corre por estrechas cavernas y atrapa a sus presas con sus afiladas garras. La piel de la cara es más dura que una roca.

Name: Golett
Description: Although ancient people apparently built it by working with clay, the source of its energy is unclear.
DescriptionEn: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.
DescriptionEs: Se mueve gracias a la energía que quema dentro de su cuerpo, pero el origen de esta energía es incierto.

Name: Golurk
Description: When the seal on its chest is removed, it rages indiscriminately, turning the whole town around it into a mountain of rubble.
DescriptionEn: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.
DescriptionEs: Al parecer, aquel que antaño lo creó le ordenó proteger a los Pokémon y a los humanos.

Name: Pawniard
Description: It follows Bisharp's orders to a tee when it attacks enemies. After slashing an opponent, Pawniard clangs both of its blades together.
DescriptionEn: Blades comprise this Pokémon’s entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.
DescriptionEs: Su cuerpo está provisto de hojas afiladas. Cuando se desgastan, las afila con cantos rodados a la orilla del río.

Name: Bisharp
Description: It leads a group of Pawniard. Bisharp doesn't even change its expression when it deals the finishing blow to an opponent.
DescriptionEn: It leads a group of Pawniard. It battles to become the boss, but will be driven from the group if it loses.
DescriptionEs: Un Pokémon temible que remata a su presa una vez que su séquito de Pawniard la ha debilitado e inmovilizado.

Name: Bouffalant
Description: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.
DescriptionEn: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.
DescriptionEs: Embiste con la cabeza sin distinción. Su potencia es capaz de hacer descarrilar un tren en marcha.

Name: Rufflet
Description: Known as a natural-born warrior, soon after its hatching, it will challenge its parent to a fight in order to gain their acceptance.
DescriptionEn: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.
DescriptionEs: Quiebra bayas con sus extremidades. Se enfrenta con valentía a todo enemigo por fuerte que este sea.

Name: Braviary
Description: Known as “the hero of the skies," this Pokémon is so proud and so brave that it will never retreat, even when it's injured.
DescriptionEn: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.
DescriptionEs: Un valiente guerrero del cielo que no duda en luchar por sus compañeros por graves que sean sus heridas.

Name: Vullaby
Description: Its healthy appetite leads to visible growth spurts. It often has to replace the bones it wears as its size increases.
DescriptionEn: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.
DescriptionEs: No puede volar porque sus alas son muy pequeñas. Cuando va a evolucionar, se deshace de su calavera.

Name: Mandibuzz
Description: It's always searching for food for Vullaby. When it finds a weak Pokémon, Mandibuzz swoops it right off to its nest.
DescriptionEn: It makes a nest out of bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.
DescriptionEs: Vuela en círculos. Cuando avista una presa, la ataca y la transporta a su nido con suma facilidad.

Name: Heatmor
Description: It draws in air through its tail, transforms it into fire, and uses it like a tongue. It melts Durant and eats them.
DescriptionEn: It breathes through a hole in its tail while it burns with an internal fire. Durant is its prey.
DescriptionEs: Usa su lengua de fuego para derretir la armadura de acero de los Durant y llegar así hasta su interior.

Name: Durant
Description: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.
DescriptionEn: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.
DescriptionEs: Actúan en grupo para expulsar de sus colonias a los Heatmor, sus depredadores naturales.

Name: Deino
Description: Lacking sight, it's unaware of its surroundings, so it bumps into things and eats anything that moves.
DescriptionEn: It tends to bite everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.
DescriptionEs: No ve, por eso va haciendo placajes y dando mordiscos a diestro y siniestro. Su cuerpo está plagado de heridas.

Name: Zweilous
Description: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.
DescriptionEn: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.
DescriptionEs: Sus dos cabezas se llevan fatal, y la que consigue comer más que la otra es la que lleva la voz cantante.

Name: Hydreigon
Description: It responds to movement by attacking. This scary, three-headed Pokémon devours everything in its path!
DescriptionEn: This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on its six wings. Anything that moves seems like a foe to it, triggering its attack.
DescriptionEs: Las cabezas de sus dos brazos no tienen cerebro. Con sus tres cabezas destruye y devora todo a su paso.

Name: Larvesta
Description: It protects itself with flame. Long years ago, people believed Larvesta had a nest on the sun.
DescriptionEn: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.
DescriptionEs: Se dice que nació del sol. Al evolucionar, cubre su cuerpo con llamas que brotan de sus cuernos.

Name: Volcarona
Description: According to legends, it was hatched from a flaming cocoon to save people and Pokémon that were suffering from the cold.
DescriptionEn: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona’s fire provided a replacement for the sun.
DescriptionEs: Cuando combate, despide escamas ardientes de sus seis alas y genera un mar ígneo a su alrededor.

Name: Cobalion
Description: It has a body and heart of steel. It worked with its allies to punish people when they hurt Pokémon.
DescriptionEn: This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.
DescriptionEs: Posee un cuerpo y un corazón de acero. Basta una mirada suya para que Pokémon violentos le obedezcan.

Name: Terrakion
Description: Spoken of in legend, this Pokémon used its phenomenal power to destroy a castle in its effort to protect Pokémon.
DescriptionEn: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.
DescriptionEs: Su potencia al embestir es capaz de derribar las murallas de un castillo. Las leyendas hablan de sus proezas.

Name: Virizion
Description: Legends say this Pokémon confounded opponents with its swift movements.
DescriptionEn: This Pokémon fought humans in order to protect its friends. Legends about it continue to be passed down.
DescriptionEs: Sus cuernos son hojas afiladas. Sacude a sus enemigos con sus relampagueantes movimientos y los reduce.

Name: Tornadus
Description: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power is great enough to blow houses away.
DescriptionEn: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.
DescriptionEs: La parte inferior de su cuerpo, similar a una nube, está recubierta de un campo de energía. Vuela a 300 km/h.

Name: Thundurus
Description: As it flies around, it shoots lightning all over the place and causes forest fires. It is therefore disliked.
DescriptionEn: Countless charred remains mar the landscape of places through which Thundurus has passed.
DescriptionEs: Lanza descargas eléctricas por las púas de su cola. Sobrevuela Teselia dejando caer rayos.

Name: Reshiram
Description: When Reshiram's tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world's weather.
DescriptionEn: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.
DescriptionEs: Pokémon legendario capaz de abrasar el mundo con sus llamas. Ayuda a quienes persiguen un mundo veraz.

Name: Zekrom
Description: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.
DescriptionEn: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.
DescriptionEs: Pokémon legendario capaz de chamuscar el mundo con sus rayos. Ayuda a quienes persiguen un mundo de ideales.

Name: Landorus
Description: From the forces of lightning and wind, it creates energy to give nutrients to the soil and make the land abundant.
DescriptionEn: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”
DescriptionEs: Lo consideran una deidad de las cosechas porque los cultivos crecen en abundancia en las tierras por las que pasa.

Name: Kyurem
Description: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.
DescriptionEn: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.
DescriptionEs: Pokémon legendario que aguarda al héroe que compense el vacío de su cuerpo de hielo con verdad e ideales.

Name: Keldeo
Description: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.
DescriptionEn: By blasting water from its hooves, it can glide across water. It excels at using leg moves while battling.
DescriptionEs: Corre por mares, ríos o cualquier superficie acuática de todo el mundo. Aparece en aguas límpidas.

Name: Meloetta
Description: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.
DescriptionEn: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.
DescriptionEs: Las melodías que canta Meloetta tienen el poder de hacer sentir felicidad a los Pokémon que hay a su alrededor.

Name: Genesect
Description: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.
DescriptionEn: Over 300 million years ago, it was feared as the strongest of hunters. It has been modified by Team Plasma.
DescriptionEs: Pokémon de tipo Bicho de la antigüedad, modificado por el Equipo Plasma. El cañón de su lomo ha sido mejorado.

Name: Chespin
Description: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.
DescriptionEn: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.
DescriptionEs: Cuando acumula energía, las suaves púas de su cabeza se vuelven tan duras y afiladas que hasta pueden atravesar rocas.

Name: Quilladin
Description: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators' attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.
DescriptionEn: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators’ attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.
DescriptionEs: Desvía los ataques de los enemigos con la robusta coraza que cubre su cuerpo y contraataca con sus dos afilados cuernos.

Name: Chesnaught
Description: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.
DescriptionEn: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.
DescriptionEs: Su fuerza es tal que, de un empellón, puede hacer volcar un tanque de 50 toneladas. Protege a sus aliados cuando hace de escudo.

Name: Fennekin
Description: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.
DescriptionEn: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.
DescriptionEs: Tras masticar e ingerir pequeñas ramas se siente pletórico y expulsa aire caliente por sus grandes orejas a temperaturas superiores a los 200 ºC.

Name: Braixen
Description: It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.
DescriptionEn: It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.
DescriptionEs: Tiene una rama enredada en la cola. Cuando la saca, la rama prende fuego al hacer fricción con su pelaje y se lanza al ataque con ella.

Name: Delphox
Description: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.
DescriptionEn: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.
DescriptionEs: Fija la mirada en la llama que arde en la punta de su bastón para concentrarse y prever sucesos que tienen lugar en el futuro.

Name: Froakie
Description: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.
DescriptionEn: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.
DescriptionEs: Secreta burbujas tanto por la espalda como por el pecho. Gracias a la elasticidad de estas, puede parar ataques y reducir el daño recibido.

Name: Frogadier
Description: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.
DescriptionEn: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.
DescriptionEs: Puede lanzar piedras envueltas en burbujas con tal puntería, que acierta latas vacías a 30 metros de distancia.

Name: Greninja
Description: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.
DescriptionEn: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.
DescriptionEs: Comprime el agua y crea estrellas ninja con las que ataca al enemigo. Cuando las hace girar a gran velocidad cortan en dos hasta el metal.

Name: Bunnelby
Description: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.
DescriptionEn: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.
DescriptionEs: Usa sus grandes orejas para excavar en la tierra y así crear madrigueras. Puede pasarse una noche entera cavando sin parar.

Name: Diggersby
Description: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.
DescriptionEn: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.
DescriptionEs: Sus grandes orejas tienen tal fuerza que con ellas puede levantar con facilidad rocas de más de una tonelada. Es de una ayuda inestimable en las obras.

Name: Fletchling
Description: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.
DescriptionEn: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.
DescriptionEs: Es muy amigable y se comunica con sus aliados mediante melodiosos gorjeos y el movimiento de su cola y sus gráciles alas.

Name: Fletchinder
Description: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.
DescriptionEn: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.
DescriptionEs: Lanza chispas por su pico y prende fuego a la hierba alta para así sorprender a sus presas y atraparlas cuando intentan escapar.

Name: Talonflame
Description: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.
DescriptionEn: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.
DescriptionEs: Si se exalta durante un combate reñido, arroja chispas y ascuas de los intersticios entre su plumaje mientras vuela.

Name: Scatterbug
Description: When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.
DescriptionEn: When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.
DescriptionEs: Cuando recibe el ataque de un Pokémon pájaro, expulsa unas escamas negras que provocan parálisis si se entra en contacto con ellas.

Name: Spewpa
Description: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.
DescriptionEn: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.
DescriptionEs: Habita en la sombra de la espesura. Si percibe alguna amenaza, su pelaje se eriza y se vuelve muy afilado para así intimidar al enemigo.

Name: Vivillon
Description: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.
DescriptionEn: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.
DescriptionEs: En el mundo existen Vivillon con diferentes motivos en sus alas. El clima de cada región influye en sus rasgos.

Name: Litleo
Description: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.
DescriptionEn: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.
DescriptionEs: Cuanto más poderoso es el enemigo al que se enfrenta, más calor desprende su mechón y más energía recorre todo su cuerpo.

Name: Pyroar
Description: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.
DescriptionEn: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.
DescriptionEs: El macho con la melena de fuego más grande de toda la manada es el líder de sus compañeros.

Name: Flabébé
Description: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.
DescriptionEn: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.
DescriptionEs: Puede controlar el poder oculto de las flores. La flor que lleva consigo es como si formara parte de su cuerpo.

Name: Floette
Description: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.
DescriptionEn: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.
DescriptionEs: Revolotea alrededor de campos de flores y cuida de aquellas que empiezan a marchitarse. Usa en combate el poder oculto de las flores.

Name: Florges
Description: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.
DescriptionEn: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.
DescriptionEs: Habita en preciosos jardines floridos. Absorbe la energía que emiten las plantas y la convierte en su fuente de poder.

Name: Skiddo
Description: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.
DescriptionEn: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.
DescriptionEs: Se dice que fue la primera especie de Pokémon que se acostumbró a vivir con los seres humanos. Tiene una naturaleza muy afable.

Name: Gogoat
Description: It can tell how its Trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathic sense lets them run as if one being.
DescriptionEn: It can tell how its Trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathic sense lets them run as if one being.
DescriptionEs: Percibe los sentimientos del Entrenador por la forma en la que agarra sus cuernos, aunque sean variaciones sutiles, y así avanzan como si fueran un solo ente.

Name: Pancham
Description: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.
DescriptionEn: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.
DescriptionEs: Se esfuerza mucho para que el enemigo no lo menosprecie, pero su mirada no intimida demasiado. Se caracteriza por mascar siempre una hoja.

Name: Pangoro
Description: Although it possesses a violent temperament, it won't put up with bullying. It uses the leaf in its mouth to sense the movements of its enemies.
DescriptionEn: From the slight twitches of its bamboo leaf, it deduces its opponent’s movements. It’s eager to tussle but kindhearted toward its companions.
DescriptionEs: Es muy temperamental, pero no permite que nadie se meta con los débiles. Mediante su hoja, predice los movimientos del enemigo.

Name: Furfrou
Description: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.
DescriptionEn: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.
DescriptionEs: Cuando le esquilan su mullido pelaje, no solo mejora su apariencia, sino que aumenta su agilidad.

Name: Espurr
Description: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.
DescriptionEn: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.
DescriptionEs: Protege con las orejas el órgano con el que irradia su intenso poder psíquico para evitar que este se escape al exterior.

Name: Meowstic
Description: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.
DescriptionEn: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.
DescriptionEs: Cuando percibe peligro, yergue sus orejas y desata un poder psíquico capaz de levantar un camión de unas 10 toneladas.

Name: Honedge
Description: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.
DescriptionEn: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.
DescriptionEs: Cuentan que este Pokémon nace cuando el espíritu de un difunto toma posesión de una espada antigua. Se aferra a las personas y absorbe su energía.

Name: Doublade
Description: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords, which cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.
DescriptionEn: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords, which cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.
DescriptionEs: Al evolucionar se divide en dos espadas. Se comunican entre sí mediante telepatía y coordinan los ataques para rebanar al enemigo.

Name: Aegislash
Description: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.
DescriptionEn: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.
DescriptionEs: Han permanecido junto a estirpes de reyes durante generaciones. Mediante su poder espectral pueden controlar a humanos y a Pokémon.

Name: Spritzee
Description: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.
DescriptionEn: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.
DescriptionEs: Su cuerpo emana una fragancia que embelesa a quien la huele. La fragancia es diferente según los alimentos que ingiere.

Name: Aromatisse
Description: It devises various scents, pleasant and unpleasant, and emits scents that its enemies dislike in order to gain an edge in battle.
DescriptionEn: It devises various scents, pleasant and unpleasant, and emits scents that its enemies dislike in order to gain an edge in battle.
DescriptionEs: Puede producir multitud de olores diferentes y, en combate, secreta los que le resultan molestos al enemigo para así contar con cierta ventaja.

Name: Swirlix
Description: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.
DescriptionEn: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.
DescriptionEs: Escupe hebras pegajosas de color blanco y textura parecida a la del algodón de azúcar, con las que envuelve al enemigo y le impide que se mueva.

Name: Slurpuff
Description: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.
DescriptionEn: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.
DescriptionEs: Puede rastrear hasta el más débil de los olores. Hace uso de su fino olfato para ayudar a los pasteleros más exquisitos.

Name: Inkay
Description: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.
DescriptionEn: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.
DescriptionEs: La luz intermitente que emite aplaca el ánimo de lucha del enemigo. Aprovecha la ocasión para esconderse.

Name: Malamar
Description: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.
DescriptionEn: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.
DescriptionEs: Tiene a su disposición los poderes hipnóticos más poderosos de entre todos los Pokémon. Controla al enemigo a su voluntad.

Name: Binacle
Description: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.
DescriptionEn: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.
DescriptionEs: Dos Binacle conviven en la misma roca, pero cuando se produce un altercado entre ambos, uno de ellos se muda a otra.

Name: Barbaracle
Description: When they evolve, two Binacle multiply into seven. They fight with the power of seven Binacle.
DescriptionEn: When they evolve, two Binacle multiply into seven. They fight with the power of seven Binacle.
DescriptionEs: Al evolucionar, los dos Binacle se dividen y dan lugar a siete criaturas que se aglomeran formando un Barbaracle y suman su poder al combatir.

Name: Skrelp
Description: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, they spray liquid poison on prey that approaches unawares and then finish it off.
DescriptionEn: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, they spray liquid poison on prey that approaches unawares and then finish it off.
DescriptionEs: Adopta la apariencia de algas podridas y lanza un líquido venenoso a las presas desprevenidas que pasan cerca.

Name: Dragalge
Description: Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker, and they spit it indiscriminately at anything that enters their territory.
DescriptionEn: Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker, and they spit it indiscriminately at anything that enters their territory.
DescriptionEs: Ataca de manera indiscriminada a quien ose adentrarse en su territorio, escupiéndole un virulento veneno que puede corroer hasta el casco de un petrolero.

Name: Clauncher
Description: They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.
DescriptionEn: They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.
DescriptionEs: Abate a enemigos voladores disparando agua a presión con su enorme pinza como si de una pistola se tratara.

Name: Clawitzer
Description: Their enormous claws launch cannonballs of water powerful enough to pierce tanker hulls.
DescriptionEn: Their enormous claws launch cannonballs of water powerful enough to pierce tanker hulls.
DescriptionEs: Posee una enorme pinza que dispara bolas de agua que podrían atravesar incluso el casco de un petrolero.

Name: Helioptile
Description: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.
DescriptionEn: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.
DescriptionEs: Habita en los desiertos y, cuando toma el sol, acumula energía, lo que le permite vivir sin la necesidad de ingerir alimentos.

Name: Heliolisk
Description: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.
DescriptionEn: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.
DescriptionEs: Extiende su gorguera y genera energía eléctrica suficiente para cubrir el consumo de electricidad de un rascacielos entero.

Name: Tyrunt
Description: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn't like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.
DescriptionEn: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn’t like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.
DescriptionEs: Pokémon recreado a partir de fósiles. Cuando sucede algo que no es de su agrado, se enfurece y se vuelve violento.

Name: Tyrantrum
Description: Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.
DescriptionEn: Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.
DescriptionEs: En el mundo antiguo en el que habitaba no tenía rivales gracias a sus mandíbulas, con las que podría despedazar con facilidad gruesas placas de acero.

Name: Amaura
Description: This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years.
DescriptionEn: This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years.
DescriptionEs: Pokémon que ha sido regenerado a partir de un trozo de su antiguo cuerpo, que quedó congelado hace unos 100 millones de años.

Name: Aurorus
Description: The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as -240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.
DescriptionEn: The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as -240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.
DescriptionEs: Expulsa un gas gélido a temperaturas inferiores a los -150 ºC a través de sus cristales romboides y congela así a su enemigo.

Name: Sylveon
Description: It sends a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to calm fights.
DescriptionEn: It sends a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to calm fights.
DescriptionEs: A través de sus apéndices sensitivos con forma de cinta, emite unas ondas tranquilizadoras mediante las cuales detiene los combates.

Name: Hawlucha
Description: Although its body is small, its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama.
DescriptionEn: Although its body is small, its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama.
DescriptionEs: A pesar de ser un Pokémon de pequeña estatura, su pericia en el combate le permite plantar cara a Pokémon como Machamp o Hariyama.

Name: Dedenne
Description: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.
DescriptionEn: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.
DescriptionEs: Sus bigotes hacen la función de antenas, por lo que puede enviar y recibir ondas eléctricas para comunicarse a grandes distancias.

Name: Carbink
Description: Born from the temperatures and pressures deep underground, it fires beams from the stone in its head.
DescriptionEn: Born from the temperatures and pressures deep underground, it fires beams from the stone in its head.
DescriptionEs: Nace en las profundidades subterráneas, a altas temperaturas y a gran presión. Irradia energía por la roca que tiene en la cabeza.

Name: Goomy
Description: The weakest Dragon-type Pokémon, it lives in damp, shady places, so its body doesn't dry out.
DescriptionEn: The weakest Dragon-type Pokémon, it lives in damp, shady places, so its body doesn’t dry out.
DescriptionEs: Es el Pokémon de tipo Dragón más débil. Habita en zonas oscuras y húmedas para evitar que su viscoso cuerpo se seque.

Name: Sliggoo
Description: It drives away opponents by excreting a sticky liquid that can dissolve anything. Its eyes devolved, so it can't see anything.
DescriptionEn: It drives away opponents by excreting a sticky liquid that can dissolve anything. Its eyes devolved, so it can’t see anything.
DescriptionEs: Segrega una mucosidad que corroe todo lo que toca y consigue así ahuyentar al enemigo. Sus ojos han involucionado, por lo que no puede ver.

Name: Goodra
Description: This very friendly Dragon-type Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.
DescriptionEn: This very friendly Dragon-type Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.
DescriptionEs: Pokémon de tipo Dragón muy afable al que le gusta abrazar con efusión a su Entrenador, aunque después lo deja totalmente pringado.

Name: Klefki
Description: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.
DescriptionEn: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.
DescriptionEs: Tiene el hábito de coleccionar llaves. Cuando un enemigo lo ataca, las hace tintinear como método de intimidación.

Name: Phantump
Description: These Pokémon are created when spirits possess rotten tree stumps. They prefer to live in abandoned forests.
DescriptionEn: These Pokémon are created when spirits possess rotten tree stumps. They prefer to live in abandoned forests.
DescriptionEs: Se cree que con las hojillas verdes que le crecen se puede preparar una infusión capaz de curar cualquier enfermedad.

Name: Trevenant
Description: It can control trees at will. It will trap people who harm the forest, so they can never leave.
DescriptionEn: It can control trees at will. It will trap people who harm the forest, so they can never leave.
DescriptionEs: Es amable con los seres que habitan los bosques, pero se cuenta que devora a quienes los mancillan.

Name: Pumpkaboo
Description: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.
DescriptionEn: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.
DescriptionEs: En el interior de la calabaza reside un espíritu que ha permanecido atrapado en este mundo. Entra en acción al caer la noche.

Name: Gourgeist
Description: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.
DescriptionEn: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.
DescriptionEs: En las noches de luna nueva deambula por las calles de las ciudades y emite espeluznantes alaridos que maldicen a quienes los oyen.

Name: Bergmite
Description: It blocks opponents' attacks with the ice that shields its body. It uses cold air to repair any cracks with new ice.
DescriptionEn: It blocks opponents’ attacks with the ice that shields its body. It uses cold air to repair any cracks with new ice.
DescriptionEs: Envuelve su cuerpo en una capa de hielo que le permite evitar los ataques del enemigo. Si se resquebraja, la recompone con aire gélido.

Name: Avalugg
Description: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.
DescriptionEn: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.
DescriptionEs: Su cuerpo, cubierto de hielo, es tan duro como el propio acero. Su abultada figura le permite arramblar con todo lo que se encuentra a su paso.

Name: Noibat
Description: They live in pitch-black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.
DescriptionEn: They live in pitch-black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.
DescriptionEs: Habita en cuevas donde reina la más absoluta oscuridad y emite ondas ultrasónicas de 200 000 Hz a través de sus enormes orejas.

Name: Noivern
Description: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.
DescriptionEn: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.
DescriptionEs: Surca el cielo nocturno cuando ni siquiera la luna brilla y ataca a presas incautas. Es imbatible en combates que tienen lugar a oscuras.

Name: Xerneas
Description: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.
DescriptionEn: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.
DescriptionEs: Según las leyendas, puede compartir el secreto de la vida eterna. Ha despertado tras dormir durante mil años bajo la apariencia de un árbol.

Name: Yveltal
Description: When this legendary Pokémon's wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.
DescriptionEn: When this legendary Pokémon’s wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.
DescriptionEs: Pokémon legendario que, al extender sus alas y las plumas de la cola, emite un brillo carmesí que absorbe la energía vital de su enemigo.

Name: Zygarde
Description: When the Kalos region's ecosystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.
DescriptionEn: When the Kalos region’s ecosystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.
DescriptionEs: Cuando el ecosistema de Kalos se encuentra en peligro, aparece y revela su poder secreto.

Name: Diancie
Description: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.
DescriptionEn: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.
DescriptionEs: Es una transformación súbita de Carbink. Se dice que su cuerpo, que irradia destellos rosados, es lo más bonito de este mundo.

Name: Hoopa
Description: In its true form, it possess a huge amount of power. Legends of its avarice tell how it once carried off an entire castle to gain the treasure hidden within.
DescriptionEn: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.
DescriptionEs: Este problemático Pokémon envía cualquier objeto a lugares remotos mediante unos anillos que deforman el espacio.

Name: Volcanion
Description: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It's said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.
DescriptionEn: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It’s said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.
DescriptionEs: Expulsa vapor y desaparece entre la densa niebla. Dicen que habita en montañas solitarias.

Name: Rowlet
Description: It feels relaxed in tight, dark places and has been known to use its Trainer's pocket or bag as a nest.
DescriptionEn: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.
DescriptionEs: Es cauteloso, desconfiado y de naturaleza nocturna. Durante el día acumula energía mediante la fotosíntesis.

Name: Dartrix
Description: Supremely sensitive to the presence of others, it can detect opponents standing behind it, flinging its sharp feathers to take them out.
DescriptionEn: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.
DescriptionEs: Es un poco coqueto, por lo que, cuando puede, se acicala las alas. En ocasiones se niega a combatir por temor a mancharse las plumas.

Name: Decidueye
Description: Decidueye can nock and fire an arrow at an enemy in a tenth of a second, so its battles are decided in the blink of an eye.
DescriptionEn: It fires arrow quills from its wings with such precision, they can pierce a pebble at distances over a hundred yards.
DescriptionEs: Las plumas de sus alas le sirven de flechas con las que puede acertar a un guijarro a 100 m.

Name: Litten
Description: Its coat regrows twice a year. When the time comes, Litten sets its own body on fire and burns away the old fur.
DescriptionEn: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.
DescriptionEs: Prende las bolas de pelo que se forman en su estómago tras acicalarse. Las llamas que escupe tienen formas variopintas.

Name: Torracat
Description: When its mane is standing on end, you can tell it's feeling good. When it isn't feeling well, its fur will lie down flat.
DescriptionEn: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.
DescriptionEs: Luce al cuello un cascabel incandescente que tintinea con fuerza cuando desprende llamas.

Name: Incineroar
Description: When its fighting spirit is set alight, the flames around its waist become especially intense.
DescriptionEn: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it’s not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer’s orders with complete nonchalance.
DescriptionEs: Posee un carácter rudo y egoísta. Si un Entrenador no le cae en gracia, ignora sus órdenes con total impasibilidad.

Name: Popplio
Description: Popplio gets on top of its bouncy water balloons to jump higher. It's quite the acrobatic fighter!
DescriptionEn: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It’s famous for being a hard worker.
DescriptionEs: Se le conoce por su diligencia y predisposición. Segrega agua por la nariz para hinchar globos con los que golpea a sus rivales.

Name: Brionne
Description: It attacks by smacking its enemies with the exploding water balloons that it creates.
DescriptionEn: A skillful dancer, it creates a sequence of water balloons as it dances, and briskly bombards its enemies.
DescriptionEs: Un bailarín consumado. Crea globos de agua con los que golpea a sus rivales una y otra vez sin dejar de bailar.

Name: Primarina
Description: Also known as a songstress, it has a fantastical look on moonlit nights when it leads its colony in song.
DescriptionEn: It controls its water balloons with song. The melody is learned from others of its kind and is passed down from one generation to the next.
DescriptionEs: Es capaz de controlar globos de agua mediante un canto cuya melodía se ha transmitido entre los suyos de generación en generación.

Name: Pikipek
Description: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!
DescriptionEn: It can peck at a rate of 16 times a second to drill holes in trees. It uses the holes for food storage and for nesting.
DescriptionEs: Hace agujeros en los árboles a una velocidad de 16 picotazos por segundo y los utiliza como despensa o como su nido.

Name: Trumbeak
Description: From its mouth, it fires the seeds of berries it has eaten. The scattered seeds give rise to new plants.
DescriptionEn: It eats berries and stores their seeds in its beak. When it encounters enemies or prey, it fires off all the seeds in a burst.
DescriptionEs: Almacena en su pico las semillas de las bayas de las que se alimenta para usarlas como arma contra enemigos y posibles presas.

Name: Toucannon
Description: Known for forming harmonious couples, this Pokémon is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.
DescriptionEn: When it battles, its beak heats up. The temperature can easily exceed 212 degrees Fahrenheit, causing severe burns when it hits.
DescriptionEs: Cuando va a combatir, calienta su pico hasta temperaturas que superan los 100 °C, lo que puede causar graves quemaduras al contacto.

Name: Yungoos
Description: Although it will eat anything, it prefers fresh living things, so it marches down streets in search of prey.
DescriptionEn: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It did not originally live in Alola but was imported from another region.
DescriptionEs: Sus afilados colmillos lo atraviesan todo. No es autóctono de Alola, sino que proviene de otra región.

Name: Gumshoos
Description: Patient by nature, this Pokémon loses control of itself and pounces when it spots its favorite meal—Rattata!
DescriptionEn: When it finds a trace of its prey, it patiently stakes out the location...but it’s always snoozing by nightfall.
DescriptionEs: Al detectar el rastro de una presa, la acecha con tenacidad, pero al ponerse el sol le vence el sueño.

Name: Grubbin
Description: It spits a sticky thread to stop opponents in their tracks, and then it grabs them in its sharp, sturdy mandibles to take them down.
DescriptionEn: Its strong jaw enables it to scrape trees and slurp out the sap. It normally lives underground.
DescriptionEs: Con sus duras mandíbulas arranca la corteza de los árboles y sorbe la savia. Suele habitar bajo tierra.

Name: Charjabug
Description: Its stout shell provides excellent defense from attacks. It uses electricity on persistent opponents.
DescriptionEn: Its body is capable of storing electricity. On camping trips, people are grateful to have one around.
DescriptionEs: Almacena electricidad en su cuerpo, lo que puede resultar útil en numerosas situaciones, como al salir de acampada.

Name: Vikavolt
Description: Vikavolt flusters opponents with acrobatic flying maneuvers. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electric beam attack.
DescriptionEn: It zips around, on sharp lookout for an opening. It concentrates electrical energy within its large jaws and uses it to zap its enemies.
DescriptionEs: Sobrevuela un área en busca de presas. Puede concentrar una potente carga eléctrica entre sus mandíbulas para atacar a sus rivales.

Name: Crabrawler
Description: Crabrawler has been known to mistake Exeggutor for a coconut tree and climb it. The enraged Exeggutor shakes it off and stomps it.
DescriptionEn: While guarding its weak points with its pincers, it looks for an opening and unleashes punches. When it loses, it foams at the mouth and faints.
DescriptionEs: Protege sus puntos débiles con las pinzas y propina puñetazos en cuanto tiene ocasión. Cuando pierde, llora lágrimas espumosas.

Name: Crabominable
Description: Before it stops to think, it just starts pummeling. There are records of its turning back avalanches with a flurry of punches.
DescriptionEn: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokémon evolved and grew fur.
DescriptionEs: Tras perderse intentando coronar una alta montaña, desarrolló una capa de pelo para protegerse del frío.

Name: Oricorio
Description: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.
DescriptionEn: It beats its wings together to create fire. As it moves in the steps of its beautiful dance, it bathes opponents in intense flames.
DescriptionEs: Junta las alas y lanza voraces llamas al rival. Su ataque se asemeja a una elaborada coreografía de fuego.

Name: Cutiefly
Description: Cutiefly can pick up the auras of living things. It skillfully reads those auras to predict its foes' movements and make fools of them.
DescriptionEn: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it’s able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.
DescriptionEs: Se alimenta de néctar y polen. Es capaz de detectar los capullos que están a punto de abrirse.

Name: Ribombee
Description: It can predict the weather from moisture levels and wind direction. Ribombee only reveals itself when there are a few clear days in a row.
DescriptionEn: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.
DescriptionEs: Fabrica varios tipos de bolas de polen. Algunas se usan como alimento y otras para el combate.

Name: Rockruff
Description: When it rubs the rocks on its neck against you, that's proof of its love for you. However, the rocks are sharp, so the gesture is quite painful!
DescriptionEn: It’s considered to be a good Pokémon for beginners because of its friendliness, but its disposition grows rougher as it grows up.
DescriptionEs: Su carácter amigable lo convierte en el Pokémon ideal para Entrenadores novatos. Sin embargo, al crecer suele volverse un poco agresivo.

Name: Lycanroc
Description: The rocks in its mane are sharper than a knife. Fragments that break off are treasured as good luck charms.
DescriptionEn: Its quick movements confuse its enemies. Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.
DescriptionEs: Su velocidad desconcierta a sus rivales. Ataca con garras, colmillos y con las piedras afiladas de su melena.

Name: Wishiwashi
Description: When it's in a jam, its shining eyes attract others of its kind. The light from its eyes is visible almost 25 miles away.
DescriptionEn: When it’s in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.
DescriptionEs: Al sentirse amenazado, sus ojos emiten cierto brillo, algo que atrae a otros miembros de su especie, y juntos luchan como un mismo ente.

Name: Mareanie
Description: Aside from its head, its body parts regenerate quickly if they're cut off. After a good night's sleep, Mareanie is back to normal.
DescriptionEn: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.
DescriptionEs: Aturde a su presa con los aguijones venenosos de la cabeza. Cuando esta se debilita, la rodea con sus diez extremidades y la remata.

Name: Toxapex
Description: With its 12 legs, it creates a dome to shelter within. The flow of the tides doesn't affect Toxapex in there, so it's very comfortable.
DescriptionEn: Toxapex crawls along the ocean floor on its 12 legs. It leaves a trail of Corsola bits scattered in its wake.
DescriptionEs: Se arrastra por el lecho marino con sus doce extremidades. Deja siempre una estela de restos de Corsola por donde pasa.

Name: Mudbray
Description: Possessing mighty power, Mudbray can be loaded with 50 times its own body weight and will be totally fine.
DescriptionEn: The mud stuck to Mudbray’s hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.
DescriptionEs: El lodo que impregna sus patas le otorga una fuerte tracción, lo que le permite alcanzar altas velocidades al correr.

Name: Mudsdale
Description: It can trudge mountain roads without rest for three days and three nights, all the while dragging a 10-ton load.
DescriptionEn: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.
DescriptionEs: El lodo que segrega por la boca se vuelve impermeable al secarse, por lo que solía usarse como capa aislante en las paredes de las casas.

Name: Dewpider
Description: It can only breathe oxygen that has dissolved in water, so it wears a water bubble on its head when it walks around on land.
DescriptionEn: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.
DescriptionEs: Emerge a la superficie para alimentarse. La burbuja con la que se rodea le sirve para respirar y proteger su delicada cabeza.

Name: Araquanid
Description: It has a habit of storing things it values in its water bubble. If its Trainer doesn't watch out, Araquanid will try to put them in its bubble!
DescriptionEn: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.
DescriptionEs: Propina cabezazos con su burbuja. Los Pokémon de menor tamaño quedan atrapados en su interior y perecen ahogados.

Name: Fomantis
Description: It loves the sunshine. When it basks in the sunlight regularly, it grows up with vivid coloration.
DescriptionEn: During the day, it sleeps and soaks up light. When night falls, it walks around looking for a safer place to sleep.
DescriptionEs: Mientras que de día duerme tranquilamente a la luz del sol, al caer la noche busca un sitio más seguro para dormir.

Name: Lurantis
Description: As it slashes into its enemies, it looks like it's dancing. Its elegant appearance has led some to call it the most glamorous Grass Pokémon.
DescriptionEn: It requires a lot of effort to maintain Lurantis’s vivid coloring, but some collectors enjoy this work and treat it as their hobby.
DescriptionEs: Dedica mucho tiempo y esfuerzo a acicalarse y preservar sus vivos colores. A algunos ejemplares incluso les lleva todo el día.

Name: Morelull
Description: It likes damp dark places. When night falls, the spores filling the caps of its mushrooms glow.
DescriptionEn: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.
DescriptionEs: Cuando titila, esparce esporas luminosas a su alrededor. Todo aquel que ve esta luz cae en un profundo sueño.

Name: Shiinotic
Description: When it starts fighting for territory with Parasect, the entire area gets completely coated in spores!
DescriptionEn: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.
DescriptionEs: Es peligroso adentrarse por la noche en un bosque habitado por Shiinotic. Su luz confunde a los caminantes, que terminan perdiéndose.

Name: Salandit
Description: It weakens opponents and sends them reeling with its poisonous gas. Salandit doesn't deal well with Spinda, since it's always reeling.
DescriptionEn: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.
DescriptionEs: Aturde a sus oponentes con un gas venenoso que produce al quemar sus fluidos corporales y luego se abalanza sobre ellos.

Name: Salazzle
Description: It punishes Salandit that couldn't bring it food with a fierce slap of its flame-spewing palm.
DescriptionEn: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.
DescriptionEs: Por algún motivo desconocido, solo hay hembras. Suele formarse su propio harén compuesto por Salandit machos.

Name: Stufful
Description: Stufful hates to be hugged or touched in any way. It will squirm, thrash, and resist with amazing power.
DescriptionEn: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.
