DescriptionEs: Pese a su aspecto encantador, cuando se enoja, sus pataletas son tan feroces que pueden derribar hasta a un luchador profesional.

Name: Bewear
Description: It boasts tremendous physical strength. Many people call it the most dangerous Pokémon in the Alola region.
DescriptionEn: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.
DescriptionEs: Es un Pokémon muy peligroso por su fuerza descomunal. Normalmente, se desaconseja penetrar en su hábitat.

Name: Bounsweet
Description: It tries to resist being swallowed by a bird Pokémon by spinning the sepals on its head. It's usually a fruitless attempt.
DescriptionEn: A delectable aroma pours from its body. They are often swallowed whole by Toucannon lured by that wafting deliciousness.
DescriptionEs: Atraídos por el apetitoso aroma que desprende su cuerpo, los Toucannon los engullen con avidez sin ni siquiera masticar.

Name: Steenee
Description: It bounces around, swinging the sepals on its head with abandon. They're quite painful when they smack you!
DescriptionEn: The sepals on its head developed to protect its body. These are quite hard, so even if pecked by bird Pokémon, this Pokémon is totally fine.
DescriptionEs: El cáliz de su cabeza se ha desarrollado y le protege todo el cuerpo. Es tan duro que no le importa que lo picoteen los Pokémon pájaro.

Name: Tsareena
Description: A Pokémon with an aggressive personality and a mastery of kicking, it cackles every time it kicks an opponent.
DescriptionEn: Its long, striking legs aren’t just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.
DescriptionEs: Propinar patadas implacables es su especialidad. Patea a sus oponentes derrotados y proclama su victoria con una gran carcajada.

Name: Comfey
Description: It picks flowers and sticks them to its body with fluids it produces. The aroma that wafts from its petals has a healing effect.
DescriptionEn: It attaches flowers to its highly nutritious vine. This revitalizes the flowers, and they give off an aromatic scent.
DescriptionEs: Prende flores en su tallo, que es muy rico en nutrientes. Las flores se revitalizan y desprenden una agradable fragancia.

Name: Oranguru
Description: Oranguru don't get along with each other, so they're always engaging in battles of wits to decide which one is superior.
DescriptionEn: Known for its extreme intelligence, this Pokémon will look down on inexperienced Trainers, so it’s best suited to veteran Trainers.
DescriptionEs: Es un Pokémon famoso por su astucia e ingenio. Desprecia a los Entrenadores novatos y prefiere a los más veteranos.

Name: Passimian
Description: Berries are its weapons as well as the staple of its diet. The one that can throw a berry the farthest is the boss of the troop.
DescriptionEn: They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable—they will never let down a comrade.
DescriptionEs: Suele ir en grupos de unos veinte ejemplares. Sus miembros permanecen siempre unidos y nunca se abandonan unos a otros.

Name: Wimpod
Description: An astonishingly cowardly Pokémon, Wimpod will whir its legs at high speeds to run away if anything comes near it.
DescriptionEn: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.
DescriptionEs: Cuando se asusta, huye despavorido moviendo rápidamente sus múltiples patas. Deja el suelo limpio y pulido allí por donde pasa.

Name: Golisopod
Description: Its claws, which it can extend and retract at will, are its greatest weapons. Golisopod is sometimes accompanied by Wimpod.
DescriptionEn: With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater—or even air—right in two.
DescriptionEs: Gracias a su destreza y sus enormes y afiladas garras, puede cortar hasta el aire y el agua de un solo tajo.

Name: Sandygast
Description: If you build sand mounds when you're playing, destroy them before you go home, or they may get possessed and become Sandygast.
DescriptionEn: Born from a sand mound playfully built by a child, this Pokémon embodies the grudges of the departed.
DescriptionEs: Surgió cuando una persona murió abandonada en plena calle y su resentimiento poseyó un montículo de arena apilado por un niño.

Name: Palossand
Description: Once it has whipped up a sandstorm to halt its opponents in their tracks, this terrifying Pokémon snatches away their vitality.
DescriptionEn: Possessed people controlled by this Pokémon transformed its sand mound into a castle. As it evolved, its power to curse grew ever stronger.
DescriptionEs: Manipulando a la gente ha conseguido transformarse en todo un castillo de arena, lo que ha aumentado su poder maligno.

Name: Pyukumuku
Description: Its entire body is covered in its own slime. If you accidentally step on one, you'll slip, and it will get mad and smack you!
DescriptionEn: It lives in shallow seas, such as areas near a beach. It can eject its internal organs, which it uses to engulf its prey or battle enemies.
DescriptionEs: Vive en las playas y en aguas poco profundas. Expulsa sus entrañas para engañar a sus depredadores y librarse de ellos.

Name: Type: Null
Description: There's danger of its going on a rampage, so its true power is sealed away beneath its control mask.
DescriptionEn: The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its intrinsic capabilities. This Pokémon has some hidden special power.
DescriptionEs: La pesada máscara le impide liberar toda su fuerza, que se cree que es extraordinaria.

Name: Silvally
Description: Through the bond it formed with its Trainer, its will was strengthened, and it was able to destroy its control mask.
DescriptionEn: Its trust in its partner is what awakens it. This Pokémon is capable of changing its type, a flexibility that is well displayed in battle.
DescriptionEs: La confianza con su Entrenador ha despertado su potencial. Ahora es capaz de cambiar de tipo a voluntad durante el combate.

Name: Minior
Description: Although its outer shell is uncommonly durable, the shock of falling to the ground smashes the shell to smithereens.
DescriptionEn: Originally making its home in the ozone layer, it hurtles to the ground when the shell enclosing its body grows too heavy.
DescriptionEs: Vive en la capa de ozono hasta que su caparazón se hace demasiado pesado y cae sin remisión a tierra firme.

Name: Komala
Description: It remains asleep from birth to death as a result of the sedative properties of the leaves that form its diet.
DescriptionEn: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.
DescriptionEs: Pasa la vida entera sumido en un profundo sueño. Toda su actividad parece reflejar los sueños que tiene en ese momento.

Name: Turtonator
Description: Its exploding shell poses a real danger but is sensitive to moisture. On rainy days, Turtonator takes silent refuge in caves.
DescriptionEn: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.
DescriptionEs: Posee un caparazón que estalla al contacto. El orificio que se aprecia en su vientre es su punto débil.

Name: Togedemaru
Description: Its capacity to produce electricity is somewhat limited, so it gets charged up by letting lightning strike it!
DescriptionEn: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokémon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.
DescriptionEs: Cuando se siente amenazado, eriza las púas de su lomo para pinchar a quien ose atacarlo.

Name: Mimikyu
Description: A gust of wind revealed what hides under this Pokémon's rag to a passing Trainer, who went home and died painfully that very night.
DescriptionEn: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.
DescriptionEs: Su verdadero aspecto es un misterio total. Un investigador que intentó mirar dentro del saco recibió, literalmente, un susto de muerte.

Name: Bruxish
Description: Its skin is thick enough to fend off Mareanie's spikes. With its robust teeth, Bruxish crunches up the spikes and eats them.
DescriptionEn: When it unleashes its psychic power from the protuberance on its head, the grating sound of grinding teeth echoes through the area.
DescriptionEs: Cuando la protuberancia que tiene en la cabeza emite poderes psíquicos, se escucha como un ruido de dientes rechinando muy molesto.

Name: Drampa
Description: It appears in towns and plays with the children. Drampa will protect kids when they're in danger, so their moms don't have to worry.
DescriptionEn: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it completely destroys its surroundings with its intense breath.
DescriptionEs: Es de naturaleza mansa, pero si se le provoca y monta en cólera, destruye todo lo que le rodea con su aliento devastador.

Name: Dhelmise
Description: Its chain-like green seaweed can stretch outward for hundreds of yards. For some reason, it gets along well with Skrelp.
DescriptionEn: Swinging its massive anchor, it can KO Wailord in a single blow. What appears to be green seaweed is actually its body.
DescriptionEs: Los giros de su enorme ancla son capaces de noquear al mismísimo Wailord de un solo golpe. El alga verde es su verdadero cuerpo.

Name: Jangmo-o
Description: It will never show an enemy its back in battle. Ancient warriors liked Jangmo-o for its valiant disposition and made it one of their own.
DescriptionEn: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.
DescriptionEs: Comunica sus sentimientos haciendo sonar sus escamas. El ruido metálico producido reverbera en las altas montañas donde habita.

Name: Hakamo-o
Description: The scales it sheds can be molded and processed to make pots and pans. They conduct heat well, so they're a popular item.
DescriptionEn: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.
DescriptionEs: Se lanza sobre su presa entonando un grito de guerra. Golpea al enemigo y lo hace trizas con sus escamas.

Name: Kommo-o
Description: It battles valiantly with its fists, which are armored in steel scales. Kommo-o specializes in uppercuts.
DescriptionEn: When it spots enemies, it threatens them by jingling the scales on its tail. Weak opponents will crack and flee in panic.
DescriptionEs: Al avistar a su enemigo, lo intimida con el tintineo que producen las escamas de su cola. Los más débiles se asustan y huyen.

Name: Tapu Koko
Description: The lightning-wielding guardian deity of Melemele, Tapu Koko is brimming with curiosity and appears before people from time to time.
DescriptionEn: This guardian deity of Melemele is brimming with curiosity. It summons thunderclouds and stores their lightning inside its body.
DescriptionEs: El espíritu guardián de Melemele, curioso e inquisitivo. Invoca nubes de tormenta y acumula el poder de los rayos en su cuerpo.

Name: Tapu Lele
Description: Although called a guardian deity, Tapu Lele is devoid of guilt about its cruel disposition and can be described as nature incarnate.
DescriptionEn: This guardian deity of Akala is guilelessly cruel. The fragrant aroma of flowers is the source of its energy.
DescriptionEs: El espíritu guardián de Akala, tan inocente como cruel. La fragancia de las flores constituye su fuente de energía.

Name: Tapu Bulu
Description: It makes ringing sounds with its tail to let others know where it is, avoiding unneeded conflicts. This guardian deity of Ula'ula controls plants.
DescriptionEn: It pulls large trees up by the roots and swings them around. It causes vegetation to grow, and then it absorbs energy from the growth.
DescriptionEs: Arranca de cuajo árboles grandes para hacerlos girar. Vuelve exuberante la vegetación y luego absorbe su energía.

Name: Tapu Fini
Description: Although it's called a guardian deity, terrible calamities sometimes befall those who recklessly approach Tapu Fini.
DescriptionEn: The dense fog it creates brings the downfall and destruction of its confused enemies. Ocean currents are the source of its energy.
DescriptionEs: Desconcierta al enemigo provocando una espesa niebla que se convierte en su perdición. Las corrientes marinas son su fuente de energía.

Name: Cosmog
Description: Whether or not it's a Pokémon from this world is a mystery. When it's in a jam, it warps away to a safe place to hide.
DescriptionEn: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.
DescriptionEs: Su cuerpo se compone de una materia gaseosa inestable. Crece poco a poco al acumular las motas de polvo que flotan en el aire.

Name: Cosmoem
Description: As it absorbs light, Cosmoem continues to grow. Its golden shell is surprisingly solid.
DescriptionEn: Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch. In the distant past, it was called the cocoon of the stars.
DescriptionEs: Permanece inmóvil, como si estuviera muerto, aunque al tocarlo se percibe un ligero calor. Antaño se le llamaba Crisálida de las Estrellas.

Name: Solgaleo
Description: In writings from the distant past, it's called by the name “the beast that devours the sun."
DescriptionEn: It is said to live in another world. The intense light it radiates from the surface of its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday.
DescriptionEs: Se cree que proviene de otro mundo. El brillo que emite su cuerpo es tal que puede hacer que la noche más profunda parezca pleno día.

Name: Lunala
Description: It sometimes summons unknown powers and life-forms here to this world from holes that lead to other worlds.
DescriptionEn: It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog. When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world.
DescriptionEs: Se dice que es la evolución final hembra de Cosmog. Su tercer ojo aparece cuando se traslada a un mundo distinto.

Name: Nihilego
Description: It appeared in this world from an Ultra Wormhole. Nihilego appears to be a parasite that lives by feeding on people and Pokémon.
DescriptionEn: One of several mysterious Ultra Beasts. People on the street report observing those infested by it suddenly becoming violent.
DescriptionEs: Un Ultraente envuelto en misterio. Se dice que las víctimas a las que posee se vuelven agresivas.

Name: Buzzwole
Description: Buzzwole goes around showing off its abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind of Ultra Beast.
DescriptionEn: This Ultra Beast appeared from another world. It shows off its body, but whether that display is a boast or a threat remains unclear.
DescriptionEs: Un Ultraente procedente de otro mundo. Se desconoce si exhibe su robusto cuerpo a modo de amenaza o para que lo admiren.

Name: Pheromosa
Description: A life-form that lives in another world, its body is thin and supple, but it also possesses great power.
DescriptionEn: One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts, it has been spotted running across the land at terrific speeds.
DescriptionEs: Uno de los temibles Ultraentes. Se dice que ha sido avistado recorriendo la superficie terrestre a velocidades de vértigo.

Name: Xurkitree
Description: They've been dubbed Ultra Beasts. Some of them stand unmoving, like trees, with their arms and legs stuck into the ground.
DescriptionEn: One of the mysterious life-forms known as Ultra Beasts. Astonishing electric shocks emanate from its entire body, according to witnesses.
DescriptionEs: Un Ultraente rodeado de misterio. Se dice que su cuerpo desprende descargas eléctricas de inmensa potencia.

Name: Celesteela
Description: One of the dangerous UBs, high energy readings can be detected coming from both of its huge arms.
DescriptionEn: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. Witnesses observed it flying across the sky at high speed.
DescriptionEs: Este Ultraente surgió de un Ultraumbral. Parece haber sido avistado surcando los cielos a velocidades vertiginosas.

Name: Kartana
Description: This Ultra Beast's body, which is as thin as paper, is like a sharpened sword.
DescriptionEn: This Ultra Beast came from the Ultra Wormhole. It seems not to attack enemies on its own, but its sharp body is a dangerous weapon in itself.
DescriptionEs: Este Ultraente surgió de un Ultraumbral. Se dice que no es muy agresivo, pero su afilado cuerpo es un arma realmente peligrosa.

Name: Guzzlord
Description: An unknown life-form called a UB. It may be constantly hungry—it is certainly always devouring something.
DescriptionEn: It has gobbled mountains and swallowed whole buildings, according to reports. It’s one of the Ultra Beasts.
DescriptionEs: Se dice que este Ultraente ha sido avistado devorando montañas enteras y tragándose prominentes edificios.

Name: Necrozma
Description: Light is the source of its energy. If it isn't devouring light, impurities build up in it and on it, and Necrozma darkens and stops moving.
DescriptionEn: Reminiscent of the Ultra Beasts, this life-form, apparently asleep underground, is thought to have come from another world in ancient times.
DescriptionEs: Se dice que yacía en el interior de la tierra. Se cree que esta criatura, parecida a un Ultraente, vino de otro mundo hace muchísimo tiempo.

Name: Magearna
Description: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.
DescriptionEn: This artificial Pokémon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak.
DescriptionEs: Pokémon artificial creado hace más de 500 años. Es capaz de entender el lenguaje humano, pero carece de la facultad del habla.

Name: Marshadow
Description: It sinks into the shadows of people and Pokémon, where it can understand their feelings and copy their capabilities.
DescriptionEn: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.
DescriptionEs: Debido a que siempre se ha ocultado en las sombras y no le gusta dejarse ver, su misma existencia es todo un misterio.

Name: Poipole
Description: An Ultra Beast that lives in a different world, it cackles wildly as it sprays its opponents with poison from the needles on its head.
DescriptionEn: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.
DescriptionEs: En su mundo, este Ultraente se considera tan entrañable como para ser elegido compañero de viaje.

Name: Naganadel
Description: One kind of Ultra Beast, it fires a glowing, venomous liquid from its needles. This liquid is also immensely adhesive.
DescriptionEn: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid inside its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.
DescriptionEs: Una de las temibles criaturas conocidas como Ultraentes. En su cuerpo almacena cientos de litros de veneno.

Name: Stakataka
Description: When stone walls started moving and attacking, the brute's true identity was this mysterious life-form, which brings to mind an Ultra Beast.
DescriptionEn: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.
DescriptionEs: Surgió de un Ultraumbral. Parece estar compuesto de varias criaturas que se han combinado para formar un solo ser.

Name: Blacephalon
Description: A UB that appeared from an Ultra Wormhole, it causes explosions, then takes advantage of opponents' surprise to rob them of their vitality.
DescriptionEn: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It’s apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.
DescriptionEs: Parece ser uno de los temibles Ultraentes. Se acerca a la gente contoneándose y hace explotar su propia cabeza súbitamente.

Name: Zeraora
Description: It approaches its enemies at the speed of lightning, then tears them limb from limb with its sharp claws.
DescriptionEn: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they’ll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.
DescriptionEs: Hace jirones al oponente con sus garras electrificadas. Aunque este esquive los golpes, acaba electrocutado por las descargas.

Name: Meltan
Description: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.
DescriptionEn: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.
DescriptionEs: Su cuerpo está compuesto de acero líquido. Funde las partículas de hierro y otros metales del subsuelo para luego absorberlas.

Name: Melmetal
Description: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.
DescriptionEn: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.
DescriptionEs: En la antigüedad se le veneraba por su poder de crear hierro. Después de tres milenios, ha regresado misteriosamente.

Name: Grookey
Description: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.
DescriptionEn: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.
DescriptionEs: Al marcar el ritmo con su baqueta especial, produce unas ondas sonoras capaces de devolver la vitalidad a la flora.

Name: Thwackey
Description: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.
DescriptionEn: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.
DescriptionEs: Los Thwackey que marcan el ritmo más contundente con sus dos baquetas son los más respetados por sus congéneres.

Name: Rillaboom
Description: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.
DescriptionEn: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.
DescriptionEs: Controla los poderes y las raíces de su singular tocón en combate golpeándolo como si fuera un tambor.

Name: Scorbunny
Description: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.
DescriptionEn: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon’s body. Once that happens, it’s ready to fight at full power.
DescriptionEs: Se pone a correr para elevar su temperatura corporal y propagar la energía ígnea por todo el cuerpo. Desata así su verdadera fuerza.

Name: Raboot
Description: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.
DescriptionEn: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.
DescriptionEs: Su suave pelaje lo protege del frío y le permite incrementar todavía más la temperatura de sus movimientos de tipo Fuego.

Name: Cinderace
Description: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.
DescriptionEn: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.
DescriptionEs: Convierte piedras en balones de fuego dándoles toques y, luego, chuta con fuerza hacia el rival para chamuscarlo.

Name: Sobble
Description: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.
DescriptionEn: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won’t be able to resist weeping.
DescriptionEs: Cuando se espanta, libera unas lágrimas con un factor lacrimógeno equivalente a 100 cebollas para hacer llorar también al rival.

Name: Drizzile
Description: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.
DescriptionEn: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.
DescriptionEs: Crea bolas de agua con el líquido que segrega por las palmas de las manos y las usa en combate de forma estratégica.

Name: Inteleon
Description: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.
DescriptionEn: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.
DescriptionEs: Esconde algunos trucos bajo la manga: puede disparar agua por los dedos o planear con las membranas de su espalda.

Name: Skwovet
Description: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.
DescriptionEn: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.
DescriptionEs: Este Pokémon se encuentra por todo Galar. No se queda tranquilo hasta que tiene ambos carrillos atiborrados de bayas.

Name: Greedent
Description: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.
DescriptionEn: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn’t notice the loss.
DescriptionEs: Se obceca tanto en acumular bayas en la cola que no se da ni cuenta de cuando tiene demasiadas y se le acaban cayendo.

Name: Rookidee
Description: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.
DescriptionEn: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.
DescriptionEs: De naturaleza valiente, planta cara a cualquier rival, por muy fuerte que sea. Los contraataques que recibe le sirven para fortalecerse.

Name: Corvisquire
Description: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.
DescriptionEn: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.
DescriptionEs: Su inteligencia le permite servirse de objetos. Por ejemplo, recoge y lanza piedras con las patas, o utiliza cuerdas para atrapar a su oponente.

Name: Corviknight
Description: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.
DescriptionEn: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.
DescriptionEs: No tiene rival en los cielos de Galar. El acero negro y lustroso de su cuerpo intimida a cualquier adversario.

Name: Blipbug
Description: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn't.
DescriptionEn: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn’t.
DescriptionEs: Siempre está recopilando información, por lo que es muy inteligente, aunque su fuerza deja bastante que desear.

Name: Dottler
Description: It barely moves, but it's still alive. Hiding in its shell without food or water seems to have awakened its psychic powers.
DescriptionEn: It barely moves, but it’s still alive. Hiding in its shell without food or water seems to have awakened its psychic powers.
DescriptionEs: Apenas se mueve, pero está vivo. Se cree que adquiere poderes psíquicos mientras permanece recluido en su caparazón sin comer ni beber.

Name: Orbeetle
Description: It's famous for its high level of intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it also possesses immense psychic power.
DescriptionEn: It’s famous for its high level of intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it also possesses immense psychic power.
DescriptionEs: Este Pokémon es conocido por su inteligencia. El gran tamaño de su cerebro es un indicio de la magnitud de sus poderes psíquicos.

Name: Nickit
Description: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.
DescriptionEn: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.
DescriptionEs: Se sustenta con el alimento que roba a otros Pokémon. Las almohadillas de sus patas son tan blandas que no hace ningún ruido al caminar.

Name: Thievul
Description: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.
DescriptionEn: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.
DescriptionEs: Marca a su presa sin ser advertido. Sigue el olor y, cuando el otro Pokémon baja la guardia, aprovecha para robarle.

Name: Gossifleur
Description: It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg, then basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.
DescriptionEn: It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg, then basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.
DescriptionEs: Si planta su única extremidad inferior en la tierra y se expone a abundante luz solar, sus pétalos cobran un color vivo.

Name: Eldegoss
Description: The seeds attached to its cotton fluff are full of nutrients. It spreads them on the wind so that plants and other Pokémon can benefit from them.
DescriptionEn: The seeds attached to its cotton fluff are full of nutrients. It spreads them on the wind so that plants and other Pokémon can benefit from them.
DescriptionEs: Las semillas que tiene entre la pelusa son muy nutritivas. Arrastradas por el viento, devuelven la vitalidad a la flora y a otros Pokémon.

Name: Wooloo
Description: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.
DescriptionEn: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.
DescriptionEs: Su lana rizada es tan acolchada que no se hace daño ni aunque se caiga por un precipicio.

Name: Dubwool
Description: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline. You'll start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.
DescriptionEn: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline. You’ll start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.
DescriptionEs: Su lana es muy flexible. Las alfombras tejidas con ella adoptan una textura similar a la de las camas elásticas.

Name: Chewtle
Description: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.
DescriptionEn: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.
DescriptionEs: Muerde todo lo que se le ponga por delante. Al parecer, lo hace para aliviar el dolor que siente cuando le crecen los incisivos.

Name: Drednaw
Description: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.
DescriptionEn: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.
DescriptionEs: Un Pokémon de temperamento feroz que atenaza a su presa con sus fuertes mandíbulas, capaces de destrozar una barra de hierro.

Name: Yamper
Description: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.
DescriptionEn: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.
DescriptionEs: Al correr, genera electricidad por la base de la cola. Es muy popular entre los pastores de Galar.

Name: Boltund
Description: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.
DescriptionEn: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.
DescriptionEs: La electricidad que genera y envía a sus patas le ayuda a desplazarse rápidamente. Puede correr sin descanso durante tres días y tres noches.

Name: Rolycoly
Description: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.
DescriptionEn: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.
DescriptionEs: Fue descubierto hace aproximadamente 400 años en una mina. Casi la totalidad de su cuerpo presenta una composición igual a la del carbón.

Name: Carkol
Description: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.
DescriptionEn: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.
DescriptionEs: Forma carbón en el interior de su cuerpo. Los antiguos habitantes de Galar lo aprovechaban para sus labores diarias.

Name: Coalossal
Description: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.
DescriptionEn: It’s usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.
DescriptionEs: Aunque es de carácter sereno, monta en cólera si ve a seres humanos dañando una mina y reduce todo a cenizas con sus llamas a 1500 °C.

Name: Applin
Description: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it's just an apple and nothing more.
DescriptionEn: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it’s just an apple and nothing more.
DescriptionEs: Habita durante toda su vida en el interior de una manzana. Finge ser una fruta para protegerse de los Pokémon pájaro, sus enemigos naturales.

Name: Flapple
Description: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.
DescriptionEn: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.
DescriptionEs: Ha evolucionado tras ingerir una manzana ácida. Las bolsas de las mejillas albergan un fluido cuya extrema acidez llega a provocar quemaduras.

Name: Appletun
Description: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.
DescriptionEn: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.
DescriptionEs: Ha evolucionado tras ingerir una manzana dulce. De ahí que el olor que emana para atraer a sus presas, los Pokémon insecto, sea tan agradable.

Name: Silicobra
Description: As it digs, it swallows sand and stores it in its neck pouch. The pouch can hold more than 17 pounds of sand.
DescriptionEn: As it digs, it swallows sand and stores it in its neck pouch. The pouch can hold more than 17 pounds of sand.
DescriptionEs: Almacena la arena que ingiere al perforar hoyos en la saca del cuello, cuya capacidad llega a alcanzar incluso los 8 kg.

Name: Sandaconda
Description: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of sand, it becomes disheartened.
DescriptionEn: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of sand, it becomes disheartened.
DescriptionEs: Se retuerce para expulsar por los orificios nasales hasta 100 kg de arena. La ausencia de esta mina su ánimo.

Name: Cramorant
Description: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.
DescriptionEn: It’s so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it’s battling midfight.
DescriptionEs: Su colosal potencia le permite machacar al rival de un solo golpe, aunque su carácter despistado lo lleva a olvidarse de su presencia.

Name: Arrokuda
Description: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.
DescriptionEn: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It’s very proud of that jaw.
DescriptionEs: Se siente muy orgulloso de su afilada mandíbula. En cuanto detecta el más mínimo movimiento, va directo al objetivo para cargar contra él.

Name: Barraskewda
Description: This Pokémon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.
DescriptionEn: This Pokémon has a jaw that’s as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda’s flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.
DescriptionEs: Su mandíbula es tan puntiaguda como una lanza y tan dura como el acero. Al parecer, su carne es sorprendentemente deliciosa.

Name: Toxel
Description: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.
DescriptionEn: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.
DescriptionEs: Secreta toxinas por la piel y las almacena en una bolsa de veneno interna. Tocarlo da calambre.

Name: Toxtricity
Description: When this Pokémon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.
DescriptionEn: When this Pokémon sounds as if it’s strumming a guitar, it’s actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.
DescriptionEs: Cuando rasga las protuberancias del pecho para generar energía eléctrica, emite un sonido similar al de una guitarra, que reverbera en el entorno.

Name: Sizzlipede
Description: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.
DescriptionEn: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.
DescriptionEs: Genera calor consumiendo el gas inflamable que almacena en su cuerpo. Los círculos amarillos del abdomen están particularmente calientes.

Name: Centiskorch
Description: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.
DescriptionEn: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.
DescriptionEs: Cuando genera calor, su temperatura corporal alcanza aproximadamente los 800 °C. Usa el cuerpo a modo de látigo para lanzarse al ataque.

Name: Clobbopus
Description: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.
DescriptionEn: It’s very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.
DescriptionEs: Emerge a tierra firme en busca de alimento. Su extrema curiosidad lo induce a golpear con los tentáculos todo lo que entra en su campo visual.

Name: Grapploct
Description: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.
DescriptionEn: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.
DescriptionEs: Todo su cuerpo es una mole de puro músculo. Utiliza los tentáculos para ejecutar técnicas de estrangulamiento con una formidable potencia.

Name: Sinistea
Description: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.
DescriptionEn: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.
DescriptionEs: Según se dice, este Pokémon surgió de un alma solitaria que poseyó una taza abandonada llena de un té ya frío.

Name: Polteageist
Description: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.
DescriptionEn: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.
DescriptionEs: Se hospeda en teteras dignas de un anticuario. Las originales son escasísimas, pero existe un gran número de burdas falsificaciones.

Name: Hatenna
Description: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.
DescriptionEn: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures’ emotions. If you don’t have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.
DescriptionEs: Percibe los sentimientos de los seres vivos con la protuberancia de la cabeza. Solo abre su corazón a quienes muestren un carácter sosegado.

Name: Hattrem
Description: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.
DescriptionEn: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.
DescriptionEs: Silencia a cualquiera que muestre una emoción intensa sin importar de quién se trate y recurre para ello a métodos a cuál más violento.

Name: Hatterene
Description: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.
DescriptionEn: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.
DescriptionEs: Para mantener alejados a los demás seres vivos, emana a su alrededor ondas psíquicas cuya potencia es capaz de provocar jaquecas.

Name: Impidimp
Description: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.
DescriptionEn: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.
DescriptionEs: Con el fin de revitalizarse, inhala por la nariz la energía negativa que desprenden tanto personas como Pokémon cuando están descontentos.

Name: Morgrem
Description: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it's trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.
DescriptionEn: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it’s trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.
DescriptionEs: Su estrategia consiste en postrarse ante el rival y fingir una disculpa para ensartarlo con el mechón que tiene en la espalda, afilado cual lanza.

Name: Grimmsnarl
Description: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.
DescriptionEn: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.
DescriptionEs: Cuando enrolla sus cabellos por todo el cuerpo, aumenta su potencia muscular. Posee una fuerza capaz de someter a Machamp.

Name: Obstagoon
Description: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout—this move is known as Obstruct.
DescriptionEn: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout—this move is known as Obstruct.
DescriptionEs: La potencia de su voz es realmente pasmosa. La técnica que usa para intimidar al rival mientras grita recibe el nombre de Obstrucción.

Name: Perrserker
Description: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.
DescriptionEn: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.
DescriptionEs: El pelo de la cabeza se le ha endurecido hasta el punto de parecer un yelmo de hierro. Posee un temperamento muy combativo.

Name: Cursola
Description: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon's core spirit.
DescriptionEn: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon’s core spirit.
DescriptionEs: Su energía espiritual ha aumentado hasta hacerlo desprenderse de su base caliza. Protege el alma del núcleo con su cuerpo espectral.

Name: Sirfetch'd
Description: Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.
DescriptionEn: Only Farfetch’d that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon’s leek withers, it will retire from combat.
DescriptionEs: Los ejemplares que superan numerosos combates evolucionan y adoptan esta forma. Abandonan el terreno de combate en cuanto el puerro se seca.

Name: Mr. Rime
Description: It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.
DescriptionEn: It’s highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.
DescriptionEs: Es un bailarín consumado de claqué. Agita su bastón de hielo mientras exhibe su destreza con gráciles pasos.

Name: Runerigus
Description: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.
DescriptionEn: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.
DescriptionEs: Una poderosa maldición pesa sobre esta antigua imagen grabada, que ha cobrado vida tras adueñarse del alma de Yamask.

Name: Milcery
Description: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.
DescriptionEn: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.
DescriptionEs: Su cremoso cuerpo surgió a partir de la unión de partículas odoríferas de dulces aromas presentes en el aire.

Name: Alcremie
Description: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.
DescriptionEn: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it’s decorated with cream.
DescriptionEs: Obsequia bayas decoradas con nata a aquellos Entrenadores en los que confía.

Name: Falinks
Description: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass's orders are absolute.
DescriptionEn: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass’s orders are absolute.
DescriptionEs: Este Pokémon consta de cinco subalternos y un líder, cuyas órdenes obedecen sin rechistar.

Name: Pincurchin
Description: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.
DescriptionEn: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.
DescriptionEs: Libera electricidad por la punta de las púas. Con sus afilados dientes raspa las algas pegadas a las rocas para ingerirlas.

Name: Snom
Description: It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.
DescriptionEn: It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.
DescriptionEs: Teje un hilo gélido que le permite aferrarse a las ramas y simula ser un carámbano mientras duerme.

Name: Frosmoth
Description: Icy scales fall from its wings like snow as it flies over fields and mountains. The temperature of its wings is less than −290 degrees Fahrenheit.
DescriptionEn: Icy scales fall from its wings like snow as it flies over fields and mountains. The temperature of its wings is less than −290 degrees Fahrenheit.
DescriptionEs: La temperatura de sus alas es de -180 °C. Sobrevuela el campo esparciendo sus gélidas escamas, como si de nieve se tratase.

Name: Stonjourner
Description: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.
DescriptionEn: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun’s descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.
DescriptionEs: Pasa el tiempo observando inmóvil el recorrido del sol sobre las extensas praderas que habita. Se especializa en técnicas de ágiles patadas.

Name: Eiscue
Description: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.
DescriptionEn: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.
DescriptionEs: La corriente lo ha transportado hasta aquí desde un lugar sumamente gélido. Utiliza el hielo para mantener la cara refrigerada en todo momento.

Name: Indeedee
Description: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.
DescriptionEn: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.
DescriptionEs: Percibe las emociones del objetivo con los cuernos de la cabeza. Los machos están atentos a cualquier cosa que necesite su Entrenador.

Name: Morpeko
Description: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.
DescriptionEn: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It’s also generating electricity.
DescriptionEs: Siempre tiene hambre. Se nutre de las semillas que guarda en una suerte de bolsillos para generar electricidad.

Name: Cufant
Description: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.
DescriptionEn: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It’s also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.
DescriptionEs: Su constitución fornida le permite transportar sin inmutarse cargas de 5 toneladas. Utiliza la trompa para excavar la tierra.

Name: Copperajah
Description: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.
DescriptionEn: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.
DescriptionEs: Su piel verdosa es resistente al agua. Proviene de tierras lejanas y presta ayuda a las personas en la realización de ciertos trabajos.

Name: Dracozolt
Description: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.
DescriptionEn: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.
DescriptionEs: La robustez de su tren inferior lo hacía invencible en la antigüedad, pero se extinguió tras comerse todas las plantas de las que se nutría.

Name: Arctozolt
Description: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.
DescriptionEn: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.
DescriptionEs: La parte superior del cuerpo está congelada y, al temblar, genera electricidad. Camina con suma dificultad.

Name: Dracovish
Description: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.
DescriptionEn: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.
DescriptionEs: Su excelente capacidad motriz y la fuerza de su mandíbula lo hacían antaño invencible, pero dar caza a todas sus presas propició su extinción.

Name: Arctovish
Description: Though it's able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.
DescriptionEn: Though it’s able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.
DescriptionEs: Atrapa a sus presas congelando su entorno, pero la ubicación de la boca encima de la cabeza le genera dificultades para deglutirlas.

Name: Duraludon
Description: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.
DescriptionEn: Its body resembles polished metal, and it’s both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.
DescriptionEs: Su cuerpo, similar a un metal pulido, es tan ligero como robusto. Sin embargo, tiene el defecto de que se oxida con facilidad.

Name: Dreepy
Description: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.
DescriptionEn: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.
DescriptionEs: Habitaba los mares en tiempos inmemoriales. Ha revivido en forma de Pokémon de tipo Fantasma para vagar por su antigua morada.

Name: Drakloak
Description: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.
DescriptionEn: It’s capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.
DescriptionEs: Vuela a una velocidad de 200 km/h. Lucha junto a un Dreepy, al que cuida hasta el momento de su evolución.

Name: Dragapult
Description: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.
DescriptionEn: When it isn’t battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.
DescriptionEs: Vive en compañía de Dreepy, a los que hospeda en el interior de sus cuernos. Los dispara a velocidad supersónica en combate.

Name: Zacian
Description: Known as a legendary hero, this Pokémon absorbs metal particles, transforming them into a weapon it uses to battle.
DescriptionEn: Known as a legendary hero, this Pokémon absorbs metal particles, transforming them into a weapon it uses to battle.
DescriptionEs: Este Pokémon está considerado como un héroe de leyenda. Absorbe el metal para transformarlo y emplearlo como armamento.

Name: Zamazenta
Description: In times past, it worked together with a king of the people to save the Galar region. It absorbs metal that it then uses in battle.
DescriptionEn: In times past, it worked together with a king of the people to save the Galar region. It absorbs metal that it then uses in battle.
DescriptionEs: Este Pokémon se erigió en salvador de Galar, tras unir fuerzas con un rey de los hombres. Absorbe el metal para utilizarlo en combate.

Name: Eternatus
Description: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.
DescriptionEn: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.
DescriptionEs: Se alimenta de la energía que brota de la tierra de Galar absorbiéndola por el núcleo del pecho.

Name: Kubfu
Description: Kubfu trains hard to perfect its moves. The moves it masters will determine which form it takes when it evolves.
DescriptionEn: Kubfu trains hard to perfect its moves. The moves it masters will determine which form it takes when it evolves.
DescriptionEs: Perfecciona su técnica mediante una estricta disciplina. Según la corriente marcial que siga, adoptará una forma u otra al evolucionar.

Name: Urshifu
Description: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.
DescriptionEn: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.
DescriptionEs: Su estilo de lucha se basa en abatir a sus rivales de un solo golpe. Se abalanza sobre ellos con su puño cincelado por el entrenamiento.

Name: Zarude
Description: Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It's incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it.
DescriptionEn: Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It’s incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it.
DescriptionEs: Viven en manada en la selva. Debido a su marcada agresividad, son muy temidos por otros Pokémon selváticos.

Name: Regieleki
Description: This Pokémon is a cluster of electrical energy. It’s said that removing the rings on Regieleki’s body will unleash the Pokémon’s latent power.
DescriptionEn: This Pokémon is a cluster of electrical energy. It’s said that removing the rings on Regieleki’s body will unleash the Pokémon’s latent power.
DescriptionEs: Su cuerpo entero es energía eléctrica. Por lo visto, quitarle los anillos que lleva libera su poder oculto.

Name: Regidrago
Description: An academic theory proposes that Regidrago’s arms were once the head of an ancient dragon Pokémon. The theory remains unproven.
DescriptionEn: An academic theory proposes that Regidrago’s arms were once the head of an ancient dragon Pokémon. The theory remains unproven.
DescriptionEs: Cierta teoría afirma que la forma de sus brazos representa la cabeza de un Pokémon dragón ancestral, aunque esto no ha podido verificarse.

Name: Glastrier
Description: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It’s also a belligerent Pokémon—anything it wants, it takes by force.
DescriptionEn: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It’s also a belligerent Pokémon—anything it wants, it takes by force.
DescriptionEs: Libera un potente vaho gélido por las pezuñas. Un ser violento que no duda en tomar a la fuerza todo cuanto desea.

Name: Spectrier
Description: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one—it doesn’t use its sense of sight. Spectrier’s kicks are said to separate soul from body.
DescriptionEn: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one—it doesn’t use its sense of sight. Spectrier’s kicks are said to separate soul from body.
DescriptionEs: Examina su entorno con todos los sentidos, salvo la vista. Se dice que sus coces son capaces de robarle el alma a quien las recibe.

Name: Calyrex
Description: Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.
DescriptionEn: Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.
DescriptionEs: Un Pokémon muy compasivo agraciado con el poder de la curación. Reinó en Galar en tiempos remotos.

Name: Wyrdeer
Description: This Pokémon is a gentle soul that doesn’t like to fight. When it’s around someone who’s hurt, it brings them flowers and lets them cry into its fur.
DescriptionEn: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.

Name: Kleavor
Description: This Pokémon is a dangerous predator. The hair on its body bristles when it’s in danger, striking fear in its opponents.
DescriptionEn: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

Name: Ursaluna
Description: This Pokémon is a gentle giant. Once it’s friendly with someone, it will let them ride on its back.
DescriptionEn: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

Name: Basculegion
Description: This Pokémon is a dangerous predator. The hair on its body bristles when it’s in danger, striking fear in its opponents.
DescriptionEn: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

Name: Sneasler
Description: This Pokémon is a gentle giant. Once it’s friendly with someone, it will let them ride on its back.
DescriptionEn: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.

Name: Overqwil
Description: This Pokémon is a dangerous predator. The hair on its body bristles when it’s in danger, striking fear in its opponents.
DescriptionEn: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

Name: Enamorus
Description: This Pokémon is a gentle giant. Once it’s friendly with someone, it will let them ride on its back.
DescriptionEn: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

Name: Sprigatito
Description: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.
DescriptionEn: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

Name: Floragato
Description: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.
DescriptionEn: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.

Name: Meowscarada
Description: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining in its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.
DescriptionEn: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.

Name: Fuecoco
Description: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining in its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.
DescriptionEn: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.

Name: Crocalor
Description: Crocalor is a Fire Pokémon. It has yet to be discovered what type of moves it will have.
DescriptionEn: The combination of Crocalor’s fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon’s head.

Name: Skeledirge
Description: Skeledirge is a Fire Pokémon. It has yet to be discovered what type of moves it will have.
DescriptionEn: The fiery bird changes shape when Skeledirge sings. Rumor has it that the bird was born when the fireball on Skeledirge’s head gained a soul.

Name: Quaxly
Description: Quaxly is a Fire & Ghost Pokémon. It has yet to be discovered what type of moves it will have.
DescriptionEn: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.

Name: Quaxwell
Description: Quaxwell is a Water Pokémon. It has yet to be discovered what type of moves it will have.
DescriptionEn: These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.

Name: Quaquaval
Description: Quaquaval is a Water Pokémon. It has yet to be discovered what type of moves it will have.
DescriptionEn: A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands.

Name: Lechonk
Description: Lechonk is a Water & Fighting Pokémon. It uses its powerful limbs to deliver devastating punches. Its thick hide provides strong defense against physical attacks.
DescriptionEn: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn’t use it for anything other than foraging.

Name: Oinkologne
Description: Oinkologne is a Normal Pokémon. It has a curious nature and is often seen exploring its surroundings with great curiosity.
DescriptionEn: Oinkologne is proud of its fine, glossy skin. It emits a concentrated scent from the tip of its tail.

Name: Tarountula
Description: Tarountula is a Normal Pokémon. It spends most of its time in the trees, weaving intricate webs to catch prey.
DescriptionEn: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon’s natural enemy.

Name: Spidops
Description: Spidops is a Bug Pokémon. It prefers dark and damp environments, where it constructs sticky webs to trap unsuspecting prey.
DescriptionEn: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.

Name: Nymble
Description: Nymble is a Bug Pokémon. It moves with incredible agility, using its slender legs to dart around and avoid predators.
DescriptionEn: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it’s in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

Name: Lokix
Description: Lokix is a Bug Pokémon. It is known for its mischievous behavior, often playing pranks on other Pokémon and humans alike.
DescriptionEn: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.

Name: Pawmi
Description: Pawmi is a Bug & Dark Pokémon. It hides in the shadows, waiting for the right moment to strike. Its sharp claws can cut through tough materials.
DescriptionEn: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.

Name: Pawmo
Description: Pawmo is an Electric Pokémon. It generates electricity in its fur, which it uses to communicate with others of its kind.
DescriptionEn: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.

Name: Pawmot
Description: Pawmot is an Electric & Fighting Pokémon. It channels electric energy into its punches, delivering powerful blows to opponents.
DescriptionEn: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

Name: Tandemaus
Description: Tandemaus is an Electric & Fighting Pokémon. It is known for its teamwork and cooperation with others of its kind, often forming strong bonds.
DescriptionEn: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.

Name: Maushold
Description: Maushold is a Normal Pokémon. It is gentle and caring, often seen nurturing younger Pokémon and offering them protection.
DescriptionEn: The two little ones just appeared one day. The group might be a family of related Pokémon, but nobody knows for sure.

Name: Fidough
Description: Fidough is a Normal Pokémon. It is known for its love of baking and often shares its delicious creations with other Pokémon.
DescriptionEn: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough’s breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon’s vicinity.

Name: Dachsbun
Description: Dachsbun is a Fairy Pokémon. It is playful and curious, often exploring its surroundings with a cheerful disposition.
DescriptionEn: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon’s body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.

Name: Smoliv
Description: Smoliv is a Fairy Pokémon. It emits a sweet fragrance from its petals, which has a calming effect on those nearby.
DescriptionEn: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

Name: Dolliv
Description: Dolliv is a Grass & Normal Pokémon. It mimics the appearance of a doll to evade predators, blending into its surroundings.
DescriptionEn: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

Name: Arboliva
Description: Arboliva is a Grass & Normal Pokémon. It is deeply rooted in the ground and draws sustenance from the soil, growing steadily over time.
DescriptionEn: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.

Name: Squawkabilly
Description: Squawkabilly is a Grass & Normal Pokémon. It is known for its melodious cries that can be heard echoing through forests. Its colorful feathers are a sight to behold.
DescriptionEn: These Pokémon prefer to live in cities. They form flocks based on the color of their feathers, and they fight over territory.

Name: Nacli
Description: Nacli is a Normal & Flying Pokémon. It is a graceful flier, often seen gliding effortlessly on air currents in search of food.
DescriptionEn: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.

Name: Naclstack
Description: Naclstack is a Rock Pokémon. It forms towering structures from compacted minerals, creating habitats for other Pokémon.
DescriptionEn: This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey’s body.

Name: Garganacl
Description: Garganacl is a Rock Pokémon. It is revered for its strength and endurance, capable of moving large boulders with ease.
DescriptionEn: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.

Name: Charcadet
Description: Charcadet is a Rock Pokémon. It has a fiery temperament and can be seen erupting with molten lava during battles.
DescriptionEn: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

Name: Armarouge
Description: Armarouge is a Fire Pokémon. It possesses a fiery mane that blazes with intense heat, intimidating foes and impressing allies.
DescriptionEn: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

Name: Ceruledge
Description: Ceruledge is a Fire & Psychic Pokémon. It can manipulate flames with its psychic powers, controlling their intensity and direction.
DescriptionEn: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

Name: Tadbulb
Description: Tadbulb is a Fire & Ghost Pokémon. It appears as a spectral flame, haunting marshlands and mysterious places.
DescriptionEn: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

Name: Bellibolt
Description: Bellibolt is an Electric Pokémon. It emits bright sparks from its body, lighting up dark places and startling unwary travelers.
DescriptionEn: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.

Name: Wattrel
Description: Wattrel is an Electric Pokémon. It generates electrical currents that flow through its fur, allowing it to communicate with others over long distances.
DescriptionEn: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

Name: Kilowattrel
Description: Kilowattrel is an Electric & Flying Pokémon. It harnesses lightning bolts to fly through stormy skies, leaving trails of sparks in its wake.
DescriptionEn: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

Name: Maschiff
Description: Maschiff is an Electric & Flying Pokémon. It uses magnetic fields to navigate and levitate, making it adept at aerial maneuvers.
DescriptionEn: It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents take it seriously, but even crying children will burst into laughter when they see Maschiff’s face.

Name: Mabosstiff
Description: Mabosstiff is a Dark Pokémon. It lurks in shadows, striking swiftly with its sharp claws and disappearing without a trace.
DescriptionEn: This Pokémon can store energy in its large dewlap. Mabosstiff unleashes this energy all at once to blow away enemies.

Name: Shroodle
Description: Shroodle is a Dark Pokémon. It conceals itself among foliage and uses its eerie cry to unsettle opponents before launching a surprise attack.
DescriptionEn: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.

Name: Grafaiai
Description: Grafaiai is a Poison & Normal Pokémon. It is known for its vibrant coloration and toxic spores that it releases when threatened.
DescriptionEn: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.

Name: Bramblin
Description: Bramblin is a Poison & Normal Pokémon. It disguises itself among thickets and bushes, using its thorny vines to deter predators.
DescriptionEn: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

Name: Brambleghast
Description: Brambleghast is a Grass & Ghost Pokémon. It haunts overgrown forests, entangling unwary travelers in its spectral vines.
DescriptionEn: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.

Name: Toedscool
Description: Toedscool is a Grass & Ghost Pokémon. It appears at dusk, emitting a soft glow from its petals that calms restless spirits.
DescriptionEn: Toedscool lives in muggy forests. The flaps that fall from its body are chewy and very delicious.

Name: Toedscruel
Description: Toedscruel is a Ground & Grass Pokémon. It uses its sturdy roots to anchor itself in sandy soils, absorbing nutrients from the earth.
DescriptionEn: These Pokémon gather into groups and form colonies deep within forests. They absolutely hate it when strangers approach.

Name: Klawf
Description: Klawf is a Ground & Grass Pokémon. Its sharp claws can tear through tough bark, allowing it to carve out burrows in arid landscapes.
DescriptionEn: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can’t remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.

Name: Capsakid
Description: Capsakid is a Rock Pokémon. It forms clusters of hardened minerals on rocky cliffsides, blending in with its environment.
DescriptionEn: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.

Name: Scovillain
Description: Scovillain is a Grass Pokémon. It is known for its spicy aroma, attracting herbivores that aid in dispersing its seeds.
DescriptionEn: The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire energy and blasts the surrounding area with a super spicy stream of flame.

Name: Rellor
Description: Rellor is a Grass & Fire Pokémon. It thrives in volcanic regions, absorbing heat energy from lava flows to fuel its growth.
DescriptionEn: This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing sand and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures its mud ball more than its own life.

Name: Rabsca
Description: Rabsca is a Bug Pokémon. It communicates through intricate dance patterns, using its antennae to convey emotions.
DescriptionEn: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.

Name: Flittle
Description: Flittle is a Bug & Psychic Pokémon. It reads the minds of other Pokémon through its antennae, predicting their actions in battle.
DescriptionEn: Flittle’s toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon’s belly.

Name: Espathra
Description: Espathra is a Psychic Pokémon. It levitates silently, observing its surroundings with its keen psychic senses.
DescriptionEn: It immobilizes opponents by bathing them in psychic power from its large eyes. Despite its appearance, it has a vicious temperament.

Name: Tinkatink
Description: Tinkatink is a Psychic Pokémon. It creates harmonious chimes by tapping its metallic body, soothing those who hear it.
DescriptionEn: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

Name: Tinkatuff
Description: Tinkatuff is a Fairy & Steel Pokémon. It defends its territory with steel-hard wings, capable of withstanding powerful attacks.
DescriptionEn: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.

Name: Tinkaton
Description: Tinkaton is a Fairy & Steel Pokémon. It forges its steel exoskeleton from minerals, granting it unparalleled defense.
DescriptionEn: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.

Name: Wiglett
Description: Wiglett is a Fairy & Steel Pokémon. It uses its delicate wings to flutter gracefully, casting shimmering reflections in the sunlight.
DescriptionEn: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

Name: Wugtrio
Description: Wugtrio is a Water Pokémon. It dwells deep in ocean trenches, using its finned appendages to navigate and communicate with others of its kind.
DescriptionEn: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.

Name: Bombirdier
Description: Bombirdier is a Water Pokémon. It dives from great heights into the sea, using its streamlined body to swiftly catch fish below.
DescriptionEn: It gathers things up in an apron made from shed feathers added to the Pokémon’s chest feathers, then drops those things from high places for fun.

Name: Finizen
Description: Finizen is a Flying & Dark Pokémon. It patrols the night skies with silent grace, its razor-sharp wings slicing through the air.
DescriptionEn: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.

Name: Palafin
Description: Palafin is a Water Pokémon. It traverses coral reefs with ease, camouflaging itself among the vibrant marine life.
